files.shabads/83/41500.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41500,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209636","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209636,"last_verse_id":209639,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209636,"page_no":null,"line_no":473,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਇ ਦਰਪਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਦੋਇ ਨਾਵ ਪਾਵ ਧਰੈ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhoi dharapan dhekhai ek sai anek roop dhoi naav paav dharai pahuchai na paar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as looking into two or more mirrors placed side by side show more than one image; and placing feet in two boats does not enable one to sail across the river. "}}},{"verse_id":209637,"page_no":null,"line_no":473,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਇ ਦਿਸਾ ਗਹੇ ਗਹਾਏ ਸੈ ਹਾਥ ਪਾਉ ਟੂਟੇ ਦੁਰਾਹੇ ਦੁਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhoi dhisaa gahe gahaae sai haath paau TooTe dhuraahe dhuchit hoi bhool pag dhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the arms or legs are put to risk of breaking when pulled from both sides at the same time; one often errs in selection of the right path at the cross-road. "}}},{"verse_id":209638,"page_no":null,"line_no":473,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਇ ਭੂਪ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਗਾਉ ਪਰਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਦੋਇ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhoi bhoop taa ko gaau parajaa na sukhee hot dhoi purakhan kee na kulaa badhoo naar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a city if ruled by two kings cannot provide peace and comfort to the subjects, nor can a woman wedded to two men can be sincere and loyal or faithful to either family. "}}},{"verse_id":209639,"page_no":null,"line_no":473,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਗਹੈ ਸਹੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੭॥","translit_en":"gursikh hoi aan dhev sev Tev gahai sahai jam dda(n)dd dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar hai ||467||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a devout Sikh of Guru worships other gods and goddesses to assuage his addiction, what to speak of his liberation, he even bears the punishment of the angels of death. His life is condemned by the world.  (467)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41499,"next":41501}}
files.shabads/83/41501.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41501,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209640","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209640,"last_verse_id":209643,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209640,"page_no":null,"line_no":474,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਰਖ ਮੂਲ ਸੀਚੀਐ ਸਲਿਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਖਾ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿਓ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau birakh mool seecheeaai salil taa te saakhaa saakhaa patr patr kar hario hoi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as by watering the roots and trunk of a tree, all its leaves and branches become green. "}}},{"verse_id":209641,"page_no":null,"line_no":474,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਕਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise patibrataa patibrat sat saavadhaan sakal kuTa(n)b suprasa(n)n dha(n)n soi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a faithful, truthful, virtuous wife remains attentive in the service of her husband, the whole family praises her, adores her very happily. "}}},{"verse_id":209642,"page_no":null,"line_no":474,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੁਆਰ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਤੁਸਟਿ ਪੁਸਟਿ ਅਵਿਲੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mukh dhuaar misaTaan paan bhojan kai a(n)g a(n)g tusaT pusaT aviloi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the mouth eats sweetmeats and all the limbs of the body feels satiated and strong. "}}},{"verse_id":209643,"page_no":null,"line_no":474,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਬਰੰ ਬ੍ਰੂਹ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੮॥","translit_en":"taise gurdhev sev ek Tek jaa(n)h taa(n)h sur nar bara(n) braooh koT madhe koi hai ||468||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the obedient disciple of the Guru who instead of other gods and goddesses is ever keen to obey the command of his Guru, everyone and all the gods praise him and call him blessed. But such an obedient and loyal disciple of the True Guru is very rare-perhaps one in a million.  (468)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41500,"next":41502}}
files.shabads/83/41502.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41502,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209644","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209644,"last_verse_id":209647,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209644,"page_no":null,"line_no":475,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee paaro khaat gaat bibidh bikaar hot soiee paaro khaat gaat hot upachaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as consuming raw mercury produces several ailments in the body but when treated with certain chemicals and purified, can cure many diseases. "}}},{"verse_id":209645,"page_no":null,"line_no":475,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸਤ ਕੰਚਨਹਿ ਸੋਖ ਲੇਤ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸ ਤਾਂਬੋ ਕਨਿਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee paaro parasat ka(n)chaneh sokh let soiee paaro paras taa(n)bo kanik dhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as gold placed in raw mercury reacts to lose its identity but when the same chemically reacted mercury mixes with copper becomes gold. "}}},{"verse_id":209646,"page_no":null,"line_no":475,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਅਗਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਥਨ ਕੈ ਗਹਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਗੁਟਕਾ ਹੁਇ ਸਿਧ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee paaro agahu na haathan kai gahio jai soiee paaro guTakaa hui sidh namasakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mercury that is so unstable and restless that it cannot be held with hands but the same becomes respectable for yogis and sidhs when converted chemically into small tablets. "}}},{"verse_id":209647,"page_no":null,"line_no":475,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੈਸੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੯॥","translit_en":"maanas janam pai jaiseeaai sa(n)gat milai taisee paavai padhavee prataap adhikaar hai ||469||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, based on the company he keeps during his life, he attains a befitting status in the world. If he remains among devotees of the True Guru, he achieves salvation; if he worships other gods, then the angels of death punsih him. (469)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41501,"next":41503}}
files.shabads/83/41503.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41503,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209648","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209648,"last_verse_id":209651,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209648,"page_no":null,"line_no":476,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂਆ ਕੋ ਮੇਢਕ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਸੰਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"kooaa ko meddak nidh jaanai kahaa saagar kee savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh mahimaa na sa(n)kh jeea jaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a frog living in well cannot know the greatness and extent of the ocean, and the hollow conch shell cannot appreciate the importance of the ambrosial drop of rain water that turns into a pearl when it falls on an oyster. "}}},{"verse_id":209649,"page_no":null,"line_no":476,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਲੂ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸੈ ਕਹਾ ਖਾਇ ਸੂਘਾ ਹਿਤ ਠਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"dhinakar jot ko udhot kahaa jaanai uloo se(n)bal sai kahaa khai sooghaa hit Thaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an owl cannot know the light of the Sun or a parrot cannot eat the insipid fruits of a silk cotton tree nor can he love them. "}}},{"verse_id":209650,"page_no":null,"line_no":476,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਇਸ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੋ ਮਰਕਟ ਮਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"bais na jaanat maraal maal sa(n)gat ko marakaT maanak heeraa na pahichaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crow cannot know the importance of the company of swans nor can a monkey appreciate the value of gems and diamonds. "}}},{"verse_id":209651,"page_no":null,"line_no":476,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਬਹਰੇ ਨ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਨਈ ॥੪੭੦॥","translit_en":"aan dhev sevak na jaanai gurdhev sev goo(n)ge bahare na keh sun man maaniee ||470||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a worshipper of other gods cannot understand the significance of serving True Guru. He is like a deaf and dumb person 'whose mind is not at all receptive to the sermons of the True Guru and therefore cannot act upon them.  (470)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41502,"next":41504}}
files.shabads/83/41504.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41504,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209652","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209652,"last_verse_id":209655,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209652,"page_no":null,"line_no":477,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਮ ਤੀਖਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਸਿਧ ਕਰਿਤ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghaam teekhan tapat at bikham baisa(n)tar bihoon sidh karit na graas kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the Sun may be very harsh and hot but one is unable to cook food without fire. "}}},{"verse_id":209653,"page_no":null,"line_no":477,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸ ਓਸ ਕੈ ਸਜਲ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nis os kai sajal hot mer tin bin jal paan na nivaarat piaas kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as dew drenches mountains and hay at night but without drinking water, that dew cannot satiate anyone's thirst. "}}},{"verse_id":209654,"page_no":null,"line_no":477,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਸੇਦ ਅੰਗ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਫੂਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise hee greekham rut pragaTai prasedh a(n)g miTat na fooke bin pavan pragaas kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as body perspires during summer season that cannot be dried by blowing at it. Fanning alone dries it and gives comfort. "}}},{"verse_id":209655,"page_no":null,"line_no":477,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਵਾ ਗੌਨ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਕੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਉ ॥੪੭੧॥","translit_en":"taise aavaa gauan na miTat na aan dhev sev gurmukh paavai nij padh ke nivaas kau ||471||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, serving gods cannot emancipate one from repeated births and deaths. One can achieve the higher spiritual state by becoming an obedient disciple of the True Guru.  (471)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41503,"next":41505}}
files.shabads/83/41505.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41505,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209656","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209656,"last_verse_id":209659,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209656,"page_no":null,"line_no":478,"gurmukhi":"ਆਂਬ ਕੀ ਸਧਰ ਕਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਆਂਬਲੀ ਖਾਏ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਨ ਪਰੋਸੀ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"aa(n)b kee sadhar kat miTat aa(n)balee khaae pitaa ko piaar na parosee peh paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can the desire of eating ripe mango be satiated by eating raw mango? One cannot receive father-like love from one's neighbour. "}}},{"verse_id":209657,"page_no":null,"line_no":478,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੋਖਰ ਸੈ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਸਰ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"saagar kee nidh kat paieeaai pokhar sai dhinakar sar dheep jot na pujaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can one find the wealth of oceans from small ponds? nor can the light of a beacon reach the brightness of the Sun. "}}},{"verse_id":209658,"page_no":null,"line_no":478,"gurmukhi":"ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਕੂਪ ਜਲ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਨ ਪਲਾਸ ਮਹਿਕਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"ei(n)dhr barakhaa samaan pujas na koop jal cha(n)dhan subaas na palaas mahikaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The water of well cannot reach the water that comes down from the clouds in the form of rain nor can Butea frondosa tree spread fragrance like sandalwood. "}}},{"verse_id":209659,"page_no":null,"line_no":478,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਿਆਲ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਮੈ  ਜੋ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਦੇ ਅਸਤ ਲਉ ਧਾਈਐ ॥੪੭੨॥","translit_en":"sree gur dhiaal kee dhiaa na aan dhev mai  jo kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd udhe asat lau dhaieeaai ||472||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, no god or goddess can have the amount of kindness that the clement True Guru showers on His Sikhs. One may wander in realms and regions from East to West in search of it.  (472)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41504,"next":41506}}
files.shabads/83/41506.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41506,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209660","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209660,"last_verse_id":209663,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209660,"page_no":null,"line_no":479,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਰਤ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਪਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਪਰ ਜਉ ਗਹੈ ਆਸਰੋ ਪਵਨ ਕਵਨਹਿ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"girat akaas te parat pirathee par jau gahai aasaro pavan kavaneh kaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person falling from the sky try to take support of the air, and that support is futile. "}}},{"verse_id":209661,"page_no":null,"line_no":479,"gurmukhi":"ਜਰਤ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਜਉ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਧੂਮ ਗਹੈ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਉਪਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jarat baisa(n)tar jau dhai dhai dhoom gahai nikasio na jai khal budh uparaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person ablaze in the fire tries to escape from its wrath by catching smoke, he cannot escape from the fire. On the contrary it only shows his foolishness. "}}},{"verse_id":209662,"page_no":null,"line_no":479,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬੂਡਤ ਜਉ ਫੇਨ ਗਹੈ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਜੈਬੇ ਕਉ ਨ ਸਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saagar apaar dhaar booddat jau fen gahai anithaa beechaar paar jaibe kau na saaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person drowning in the rapid waves of the sea try to save himself catching the surf of the water, such a thought is totally foolish since the surf is not a means of crossing the sea. "}}},{"verse_id":209663,"page_no":null,"line_no":479,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ਦੁਖਤ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਨ ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੪੭੩॥","translit_en":"taise aavaa gavan dhukhat aan dhev sev bin gur saran na mokh padh raaj hai ||473||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the cycle of birth and death cannot end by worshipping or serving any god or goddess. Without taking the refuge of the perfect True Guru, no one can achieve salvation.  (473)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41505,"next":41507}}
files.shabads/83/41507.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41507,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209664","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209664,"last_verse_id":209667,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209664,"page_no":null,"line_no":480,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੂਛੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise roop ra(n)g bidh poochhai a(n)dh a(n)dh prat aap hee na dhekhai taeh kaise kai dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a blind person asks another blind person about the features and beauty of a person, how can he tell him, when he cannot see anything? "}}},{"verse_id":209665,"page_no":null,"line_no":480,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪੂਛੇ ਬਹਰੋ ਜਉ ਬਹਰਾ ਪੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਨ ਆਪਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਮਝਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"raag naadh baadh poochhe baharo jau baharaa pai samajhai na aap taeh kaise samajhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deaf wishes to know about the tune and rhythm of a song from another person who is also deaf, then what can one who himself is deaf explain to the other deaf? "}}},{"verse_id":209666,"page_no":null,"line_no":480,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਹਿ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪੂਛੇ ਚਾਹੈ  ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gu(n)g gu(n)g peh bachan bibek poochhe chaahai  bol na sakat kaise sabadh sunaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a dumb wants to learn something from another dumb, what can anyone who himself is unable to speak, explain to the other dumb? "}}},{"verse_id":209667,"page_no":null,"line_no":480,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਜੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਆਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੭੪॥","translit_en":"bin satigur khojai braham giaan dhiaan anithaa agiaan mat aan pai na paaviee ||474||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly it is foolishness to seek spiritual knowledge from other gods and goddesses leaving the True Guru who is perfect manifestation of the Lord. No one else can impart this wisdom or knowledge.  (474)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41506,"next":41508}}
files.shabads/83/41508.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41508,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209668","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209668,"last_verse_id":209671,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209668,"page_no":null,"line_no":481,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਬਰ ਬੇਚਨ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਲਾਭ ਸਹਸੋ ਹੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)bar bechan jai dhes dhiga(n)baran ke praapat na hoi laabh sahaso hai mool ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a cloth merchant visits a place where everyone lives naked, he is not going to benefit from it. He may lose his principal goods. "}}},{"verse_id":209669,"page_no":null,"line_no":481,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ਸੀਖਿਆ ਚਾਹੈ ਜਉ ਆਂਧਨ ਪੈ ਰੰਕਨ ਪੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"ratan pareekhiaa seekhiaa chaahai jau aa(n)dhan pai ra(n)kan pai raaj maa(n)gai mithiaa bhram bhool ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a person wishes to learn the science of evaluating gems from a blind person or asks for the kingdom from paupers, that would be his foolishness and mistake. "}}},{"verse_id":209670,"page_no":null,"line_no":481,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁੰਗਾ ਪੈ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤਕ ਬੈਦਕ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਹਿਰਾ ਪੈ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਅਭੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"gu(n)gaa pai paRhan jai jotak baidhak bidhiaa bahiraa pai raag naadh anithaa abhool ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If someone wishes to learn astrology or acquire knowledge of Vedas from a dumb person, or wishes to know about music from a deaf person, this would be an utter foolish effort. "}}},{"verse_id":209671,"page_no":null,"line_no":481,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਦੋਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਮੋਖ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਜਮ ਸੂਿਲ ਕੋ ॥੪੭੫॥","translit_en":"taise aan dhev sev dhokh meT mokh chaahai bin satigur dhukh sahai jam sooil ko ||475||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if anyone tries to get rid of his sins and achieve salvation by serving and worshipping other gods, this would be an act of foolishness. Without the True Guru, he will only bear the pricks of the angels of death. (475)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41507,"next":41509}}
files.shabads/83/41509.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41509,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209672","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209672,"last_verse_id":209675,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209672,"page_no":null,"line_no":482,"gurmukhi":"ਬੀਜ ਬੋਇ ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੂਲ ਖੋਇ ਰੋਵੈ ਪੁਨ ਰਾਜੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗਈ ॥","translit_en":"beej boi kaalar mai nipajai na dhaan paan mool khoi rovai pun raaj dda(n)dd laagiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a seed sown in saline and barren land yields not even a leaf, one loses the capital (seed) and cries at the waste beside forced to pay revenue. "}}},{"verse_id":209673,"page_no":null,"line_no":482,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਲੋਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਘ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਥਨੀਆ ਹੂ ਫੋਰਿ ਤੋਰਿ ਭਾਗਈ ॥","translit_en":"salil biloi jaise nikasat naeh ghirat maTukee mathaneeaa hoo for tor bhaagiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as churning of water does not yield butter but in the process, one may break the churner and the earthenware. "}}},{"verse_id":209674,"page_no":null,"line_no":482,"gurmukhi":"ਭੂਤਨ ਪੈ ਪੂਤ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਕੋਊ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਪਰਤ ਸੰਸੋ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਹੂ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਈ ॥","translit_en":"bhootan pai poot maa(n)gai hot na sapootee kouoo jeea ko parat sa(n)so tiaagai hoo na tiaagiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a barren woman under the influence of witchcraft and black magic seeks blessings of a son from ghosts and witches, she can't bear a son but instead fears losing her own life. She endeavours to free herself from their spell but they (ghosts and witches) do not leave her. "}}},{"verse_id":209675,"page_no":null,"line_no":482,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਸੇਵ ਦੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਹੈ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੋਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਈ ॥੪੭੬॥","translit_en":"bin gurdhev sev aan sev dhukhadhaik hai lok paralok sok jaeh anuraagiee ||476||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without acquiring the teachings and wisdom from True Guru, service of other gods and goddesses give distress only. Loving them puts one in sufferings both in this world and the world hereafter.  (476)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41508,"next":41510}}
files.shabads/83/41510.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41510,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209676","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209676,"last_verse_id":209679,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209676,"page_no":null,"line_no":483,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਤਨੁ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਖਗਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਤ ਕਾਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise miragaraaj tan ja(n)buk adheen hot khagapat sut jai juhaarat kaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cub becomes subservient to a jackal or a Garud (Ardea argala) bows to a crow. "}}},{"verse_id":209677,"page_no":null,"line_no":483,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਹ ਕੇਤ ਬਸ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਮੈ  ਸੁਰਤਰੁ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਅਰਕ ਬਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raeh ket bas girahan mai  suratar sobh na arak ban rav sas laag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Sun and Moon resides in the houses of Rahu and Ketu (the two unfriendly mythological demons), or Kalapbrichh the all giving tree of heavens does not fit into the jungle of Calotropis procera. "}}},{"verse_id":209678,"page_no":null,"line_no":483,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਸੁਤ ਸੂਕਰੀ ਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਐਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਗਰਧਭ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kaamadhen sut sookaree sathan paan aairaapat sut garadhabh agrabhaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a calf of ever milk-yielding cow (Kamdhenu) sucks the teats of a she pig, or the young one of Airawat the elephant of god Inder keeps bowing before a donkey. "}}},{"verse_id":209679,"page_no":null,"line_no":483,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਤ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੭੭॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh sut aan dhev sevak hui nihafal janam jiau ba(n)s mai bajaag hai ||477||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if son of a Guru's Sikh starts worshipping gods and goddesses, his human birth would be a failure just as a son of two fathers would be in a respectable family.  (477)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41509,"next":41511}}
files.shabads/83/41511.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41511,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209680","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209680,"last_verse_id":209683,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209680,"page_no":null,"line_no":484,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਤੰੂਬਰੀ ਨਾ ਬੂਡੈ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖਮੈ ਤਊ ਨ ਤਜਤ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai ta(n)oobaree naa booddai saritaa paravaeh bikhai bikhamai tuoo na tajat hai man te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a colocynth (Tumna) does not sink in fast flowing river and it does not shed its bitterness even in sweet cold water, then what good it is? "}}},{"verse_id":209681,"page_no":null,"line_no":484,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਲਪਟੈ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਜਰੈ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਲੈ ਬੋਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਕਠੋਰਪਨ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai lapaTai paakhaan paavak jarai sootr jal mai lai borat ridhai kaThorapan te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the flame of fire cannot burn the stone, and if due to its rigid nature sinks everything along with it, then what good it is ? "}}},{"verse_id":209682,"page_no":null,"line_no":484,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਗੁਡੀ ਉਡੀ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ ਬਰਖਤ ਮੇਂਹ ਬਾਚੀਐ ਨ ਬਾਲਕਨ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai guddee uddee dhekheeat hai akaasachaaree barakhat me(n)h baacheeaai na baalakan te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A kite is seen flying in the sky like a bird, but when it starts raining it cannot be saved and retrieved by the children flying it. "}}},{"verse_id":209683,"page_no":null,"line_no":484,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਖੇਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਨਾਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਤੇ ॥੪੭੮॥","translit_en":"taise ridh sidh bhaau dhuteeaa tiragun khel gurmukh sukh fal naeh kirataghan te ||478||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, acquiring miraculous powers is a sign of duality and influence of the three trait mammon (maya). A true disciple of the Guru knows that one cannot obtain virtues and comforts from this duality and betrayal of the Guru. (478)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41510,"next":41512}}
files.shabads/83/41512.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41512,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209684","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209684,"last_verse_id":209687,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209684,"page_no":null,"line_no":485,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਡਾ ਪੈਸਾ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"kauddaa paisaa rupieeaa sunieeaa ko banaj karai ratan paarakh hoi jauharee kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one starts dealing in shells in the beginning, then in money, gold coins and then becomes evaluator of diamonds and precious stones. He is then called a jeweller. "}}},{"verse_id":209685,"page_no":null,"line_no":485,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਉਡਾ ਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੈ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਮੈ ਪਤਸਿਟਾ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jauharee kahai pun kauddaa ko banaj karai pa(n)ch paravaan mai patasiTaa ghaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But after becoming famous as a jeweller, one starts dealing in shells, he loses his respect among the elite people. "}}},{"verse_id":209686,"page_no":null,"line_no":485,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਊਚ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"aan dhev sev gurdhev ko sevak hui lok paralok bikhai uooch padh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a follower of some god comes into the service of True Guru, he acquires high status in this and the world beyond. "}}},{"verse_id":209687,"page_no":null,"line_no":485,"gurmukhi":"ਛਾਡਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਪੂਤ ਹੁਇ ਹਸਾਵਈ ॥੪੭੯॥","translit_en":"chhaadd gurdhev sev aan dhev sevak hui nihafal janam kapoot hui hasaaviee ||479||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But if someone leaves the service of the True Guru, and becomes a follower of some other god, then he wastes away his human life and he is laughed at by others being known as a bad son.  (479)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41511,"next":41513}}
files.shabads/83/41513.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41513,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209688","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209688,"last_verse_id":209691,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209688,"page_no":null,"line_no":486,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਚਾਹਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach kram kai patibrat karai jau naar taeh man bach kram chaahat bhataar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a wife discharges her duties faithfully and loyally and is devoted to her husband, such a wife is loved dearly by her husband. "}}},{"verse_id":209689,"page_no":null,"line_no":486,"gurmukhi":"ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸਕਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"abharan si(n)gaar chaar sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog sakal kuTa(n)b hee mai taa ko jai jaikaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a lady is blessed with the opportunity of adoring herself and meeting with her husband. Being virtuous she is praised and appreciated by the whole family. "}}},{"verse_id":209690,"page_no":null,"line_no":486,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਛਬਿ ਸੋਭਤ ਸੁਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj ana(n)dh sukh ma(n)gal suhaag bhaag su(n)dhar ma(n)dhar chhab sobhat suchaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She acquires the comforts of married life gently and gradually. Because of the beauty of her high merits she adores the beautiful mansions with her presence. "}}},{"verse_id":209691,"page_no":null,"line_no":486,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੦॥","translit_en":"satigur sikhan kau raakhat girasat mai saavadhaan aan dhev sev bhaau dhubidhaa nivaar hai ||480||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the Sikhs of the Guru are kept conscious and protected by the True Guru during their domestic life. The True Guru removes the duality of their devotion and worship of gods and goddesses. (40)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41512,"next":41514}}
files.shabads/83/41514.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41514,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209692","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209692,"last_verse_id":209695,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209692,"page_no":null,"line_no":487,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੇਸੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau patibrataa patibrat mai saavadhaan taahee te girahesur hui naikaa kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a loyal and faithful wife is ever conscious of fulfilling her wifely obligations, and that makes her the prime person of the family. "}}},{"verse_id":209693,"page_no":null,"line_no":487,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਭਤਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan dhan dhaam kaamanaa pujaavai sobhat si(n)gaar chaar sihajaa samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Her husband fulfils all her needs of bedding, clothing, food, wealth, house and other property, and she in returns embellishes herself to enjoy oneness with her husband on the nuptial bed, "}}},{"verse_id":209694,"page_no":null,"line_no":487,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮੈ ਸੰਪਤਾ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਲੁਡੇ ਤੇ ਲਡਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sikhan kau raakhat girahasat mai sa(n)pataa samooh sukh ludde te laddaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru keeps His devoted and obedient Sikhs lovingly in their householders life. With the blessings of ambrosial name of the Lord, he reaches the spiritual peace in their family life. "}}},{"verse_id":209695,"page_no":null,"line_no":487,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ  ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥੪੮੧॥","translit_en":"asan basan dhan dhaam kaamanaa pavitr  aan dhev sev bhaau dhuteeaa miTaaviee ||481||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the desire of the sacred name, the True Guru blesses His Sikhs with food, bedding, clothing, mansions and other worldly assets. He removes all their duality of serving and following other gods and goddesses.  (481)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41513,"next":41515}}
files.shabads/83/41515.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41515,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209696","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209696,"last_verse_id":209699,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209696,"page_no":null,"line_no":488,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"log bedh giaan upadhes hai patibrataa kau man bach kram savaiaamee sevaa adhikaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The teachings of folk traditions and Vedas lay down that a faithful and loyal wife has the sole right to serve her husband devotedly in words and actions. "}}},{"verse_id":209697,"page_no":null,"line_no":488,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਨੇਮ ਨਾ ਤਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naam isanaan dhaan sa(n)jam na jaap taap teerath barat poojaa nem naa takaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a loyal, devoted and faithful wife does not even look at all the futile rites and rituals like; meditations on various names, bathing at places of pilgrimage on specific days, charity, self-imposed discipline, penances, visit to holy places, fasting etc. "}}},{"verse_id":209698,"page_no":null,"line_no":488,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"hom jag bhog nieebedh nahee dhevee dhev sev raag naadh baadh na sa(n)baadh aan dhuaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For her, sacrificial fire, yoga, offerings, arid other rituals connected with worship of gods and goddesses are meaningless. She is not interested in any modes of singing, musical instruments, rationale and illogic or going to any other door. "}}},{"verse_id":209699,"page_no":null,"line_no":488,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਬਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੨॥","translit_en":"taise gursikhan mai ek Tek hee pradhaan aan giaan dhiaan simaran bibachaar hai ||482||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the devoted Sikhs of the True Guru must adopt the refuge of the Guru as their primary means (of happiness and peace). For them, meditating or focusing their mind on other teachings and deities is like adultery. (482)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41514,"next":41516}}
files.shabads/83/41516.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41516,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209700","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209700,"last_verse_id":209703,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209700,"page_no":null,"line_no":489,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕਉ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸ ਨ੍ਹਾਤ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise patibrataa kau pavitr ghar vaas nhaat asan basan dhan dhaam lokaachaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as living in her house, bathing, eating and sleeping etc. and discharging her worldly duties according to the social customs and traditions are all sacred for a faithful and loyal wife. "}}},{"verse_id":209701,"page_no":null,"line_no":489,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਅਭਰਨ ਸ਼ਿੰਗਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taat maat bhraat sut sujan kuTa(n)b sakhaa sevaa gur jan sukh abharan shi(n)gaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is her natural duty to embellish herself with ornaments for the happiness of her husband beside serving and respecting parents, brothers, sisters, sons, other elders in the family, friends and other social contacts. "}}},{"verse_id":209702,"page_no":null,"line_no":489,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਕਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਈ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਅਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kirat birat parasoot mal mootr dhaaree sakal pavitr joiee bibidh achaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Attending to the household chores, bearing children, bringing them up, keeping them clean and neat is all sacred for a faithful and loyal wife. "}}},{"verse_id":209703,"page_no":null,"line_no":489,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੩॥","translit_en":"taise gursikhan kau lep na girahasat mai aan dhev sev dhirag janam sa(n)saar hai ||483||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the disciples of the Guru are never blemished while leading a householder's life. Like loyal and faithful wife, they consider indulgence of worship of any other god over the True Guru as a condemnable act in the world.  (483)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41515,"next":41517}}
files.shabads/83/41517.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41517,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209704","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209704,"last_verse_id":209707,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209704,"page_no":null,"line_no":490,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿਤ ਅਉ ਸੋਮ ਭੌਮ ਬੁਧ ਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਸਪਤਿ ਸੁਕਰ ਸਨੀਚਰ ਸਾਤੋ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਂਟ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadhit aau som bhauam budh hoo(n) brahasapat sukar saneechar saato baar baa(n)T leene hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Starting from Sunday, all seven days of the week are overtaken by the gods like, Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn respectively. "}}},{"verse_id":209705,"page_no":null,"line_no":490,"gurmukhi":"ਥਿਤਿ ਪਛ ਮਾਸ ਰੁਤਿ ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦਿਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"thit pachh maas rut logan mai logaachaar ek eka(n)kaar ko na kouoo dhin dheene hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For fulfillment of all rites and rituals related to god-land, the society has further divided the time into bright and dark period. (waxing and wanning of moon) twelve months and six seasons. But not a day has been set aside for the remembrance and in the memory of One Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209706,"page_no":null,"line_no":490,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਅਸਟਮੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਉਮੀ ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਭਈ ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਦਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਏ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"janam asaTamee raam naumee ekaadhasee bhiee dhuaadhasee chaturadhasee janam e keene hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God is free of births but Janam Ashtami, Ram Naumi and Ekadashi are the birth days of Lord Krishna, Lord Rama, and god Haribasar. Duadasi is the day of Vaman god, while Chaudasi is the day of Narsinh. These days have been fixed as birthdays of these gods. "}}},{"verse_id":209707,"page_no":null,"line_no":490,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਜਾ ਉਪਾਰਜਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਿਨ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਹੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੪॥","translit_en":"parajaa upaarajan ko na kouoo paavai dhin ajonee janam dhin kahau kaise cheene hai ||484||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one can tell the day of the creation of this cosmos. Then how can one know the birthday of such Lord who is Ajuni (beyond birth) ? Thus worship of gods who are born and who die is futile. Worship of eternal Lord is only purposeful.  (484)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41516,"next":41518}}
files.shabads/83/41518.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41518,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209708","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209708,"last_verse_id":209711,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209708,"page_no":null,"line_no":491,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੈ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਜਨਮਾਸਟਮੀ ਕੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ko naam hai ajonee kaise kai janam lai kahaa jaan brat janamaasaTamee ko keeno hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose name is Ajoni (who is never born), how could He have taken birth. And on what reason has the foolish people fixed the Janam Ashtami (the birthday of Krishan Ji) as a day of fasting? "}}},{"verse_id":209709,"page_no":null,"line_no":491,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ko jagajeevan akaal abinaasee naam kaise kai badhik maario apajas leeno hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose name is Akal (beyond times), Eternal and who is the life-support of the whole world, how could a hunter had killed Him in the form of Krishan and earned infamy? "}}},{"verse_id":209710,"page_no":null,"line_no":491,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੋਪੀਨਾਥ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਹ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niramal niradhokh mokh padh jaa ke naam gopeenaath kaise hui bireh dhukh dheeno hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose name makes a person do good, whose name frees a person from all vices, who is emancipator, how could He be the Master of milkmaids in the form of Krishan and make them suffer in His separation? "}}},{"verse_id":209711,"page_no":null,"line_no":491,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਹਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਹੀਨੋ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੫॥","translit_en":"paahan kee pratimaa ke a(n)dh ka(n)dh hai poojaaree a(n)tar agiaan mat giaan gur heeno hai ||485||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are bereft of the initiation of True Guru, support ignorant mind in them. Such ignorants and blind people create the idols of the Life-giving, Imperishable, Timeless and Blemishless Lord reducing Him into gods and then become their followers and priests.  (485)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41517,"next":41519}}
files.shabads/83/41519.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41519,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209712","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209712,"last_verse_id":209715,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209712,"page_no":null,"line_no":492,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰਜ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਉਡਗਨ ਅਗਨਿਤ ਜਿਉ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sooraj pragaas naas uddagan aganit jiau aan dhev sev gurdhev ke dhiaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as with Sunrise, the stars disappear; similarly a Sikh feels unconcerned about the worship and service of gods and goddesses due to the knowledge acquired from the True Guru and practicing and focusing of the mind on his words. "}}},{"verse_id":209713,"page_no":null,"line_no":492,"gurmukhi":"ਹਾਟ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਠਾਟੁ ਘਟੈ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਭੇਦ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"haaT baaT ghaaT ThaaT ghaTai ghaTai nis dhin taiso log bedh bhedh satigur giaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the charm of shops, pathways, roads and quays reduce with time, so do the doubts and ignorance created by the worldly knowledge, rationale and illogic of Vedas diminish with the appearance of the True Guru's knowledge. "}}},{"verse_id":209714,"page_no":null,"line_no":492,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਅਉ ਜੂਆਰ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"chor jaar aau jooaar moh dhroh a(n)dhakaar praat samai sobhaa naam dhaan isanaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The activities of thieves, evil persons and gamblers thrive in the darkness of the night but on daybreak the unique influence of bathing and meditation as drilled by the True Guru in His disciples become conspicuous. "}}},{"verse_id":209715,"page_no":null,"line_no":492,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਸਰ ਮੇਡਕੁ ਸਿਵਾਲ ਘੋਘਾ  ਮਾਨਸਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥੪੮੬॥","translit_en":"aan sar meddak sivaal ghoghaa  maanasar pooran braham gur sarab nidhaan kai ||486||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Worshippers of other gods and goddesses can only be the dross of the tri-trait maya or the frogs of some pond and even useless shells in the sand. But in the Mansarover-like congregation, all treasures and invaluable commodities providing Naam, blessed by the God-like True Guru are present.  (486)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41518,"next":41520}}
files.shabads/83/41520.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41520,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209716","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209716,"last_verse_id":209719,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209716,"page_no":null,"line_no":493,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ  ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"nis dhin a(n)tar jiau a(n)tar bakhaaneeat  taise aan dhev gurdhev sev jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Serving and worshipping of gods and goddesses viz-a-viz the True Guru is like the difference between night and day. "}}},{"verse_id":209717,"page_no":null,"line_no":493,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"nis a(n)dhakaar bahu taarikaa chamatakaar dhin dhinakar eka(n)kaar pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the darkness of night (ignorance), there is much radiance of stars (gods) but with the appearance of True Guru's radiance of knowledge (with the rise of the Sun during the day) God, the Only One becomes conspicuous and obvious. "}}},{"verse_id":209718,"page_no":null,"line_no":493,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੇਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"nis a(n)dhikaaree mai bikaaree hai bikaar het praat samai neh nira(n)kaaree unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The vice and evil-doers are enamored by the evil and vicious acts, but by the knowledge of the True Guru, the devoted Sikhs contemplate on the Lord's name at ambrosial hour by becoming one with Him. "}}},{"verse_id":209719,"page_no":null,"line_no":493,"gurmukhi":"ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੀਤ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੮੭॥","translit_en":"rain sain samai Thag chor jaar hoi aneet raajaneet reet preet baasur bakhaaneeaai ||487||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"At night when the time for sleep comes, the evil designs of treacherous, deceitful and vicious people prevail. But with the daybreak at ambrosial hour (radiance of knowledge by the True Guru) the righteousness and justice of the Lord prevails. (The divine name of the Lord refulges).  (487)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41519,"next":41521}}
files.shabads/83/41521.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41521,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209720","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209720,"last_verse_id":209723,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209720,"page_no":null,"line_no":494,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੇਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nis dhuramat hui adharam karam het gurmat baasur su dharam karam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A base wisdom is full of ignorance. It encourages sin and evil deeds. The wisdom given by the True Guru is like the brightness of the day that pronounces righteous deeds. "}}},{"verse_id":209721,"page_no":null,"line_no":494,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੇ ਉਦੋਤ ਸਭ ਕਿਛ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhinakar jot ke udhot sabh kichh soojhai nis a(n)dhiaaree bhoole bhramat bharam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the emergence of Sun-like teachings of the True Guru, all that would stand in good stead becomes conspicuous. But consider any idol worship as dark night where one keeps wandering in doubts and suspicions by going wayward from the True path. "}}},{"verse_id":209722,"page_no":null,"line_no":494,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal dhib dheh dhirasaT hui aan dhev sevak hui dhirasaT charam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the virtues of Naam obtained from the True Guru an obedient Sikh becomes capable of seeing all that is not visible openly or conspicuously. Whereas the followers of gods and goddesses remain manifested with evil or sinning vision. "}}},{"verse_id":209723,"page_no":null,"line_no":494,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਮਰਮੁ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੮॥","translit_en":"sa(n)saaree sa(n)saaree sa(n)g a(n)dh a(n)dh ka(n)dh laagai gurmukh sa(n)dh paramaarath maram hai ||488||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The worldly people associate with gods in search of worldly pleasures just like a blind person holds onto the shoulder of another in search of the right path. But Sikhs acquire spiritual knowledge and awareness by uniting with the True Guru. (488)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41520,"next":41522}}
files.shabads/83/41522.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41522,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209724","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209724,"last_verse_id":209727,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209724,"page_no":null,"line_no":495,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal mil bahu baran banaasapatee cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh ban cha(n)chal karat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water gives rise to a variety of vegetation, but sandalwood conducts its fragrance to the whole forest. (Similarly, worshipping fake gods leads to rebirth into various life forms but the True Guru, like sandalwood, unites a Sikh with One True Lord)."}}},{"verse_id":209725,"page_no":null,"line_no":495,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise agan agan dhaat joiee soiee dhekheeat paaras paras jot ka(n)chan dharat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a metal shines like fire when placed in it, but in reality it is no different than what it is. But with a touch of philosopher stone, the same metal becomes gold and shines like it. "}}},{"verse_id":209726,"page_no":null,"line_no":495,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਮਿਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭੈਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taise aan dhev sev miTat nahee kuTev satigur dhev sev bhaijal tarat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the service of other gods and goddesses cannot destroy the dross of ego of many births. But successful service of the reffulgent True Guru sails one across the worldly ocean. "}}},{"verse_id":209727,"page_no":null,"line_no":495,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਉਚਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੯॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal mahaatam agaadh bodh net net net namo namo ucharat hai ||489||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Significance and the ecstasy of True Guru blessed Naam Simran is beyond explanation. That is why all supplicate and salute Him saying repeatedly-Not this, Not this and Not even this.  (489)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41521,"next":41523}}
files.shabads/83/41523.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41523,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209728","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209728,"last_verse_id":209731,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209728,"page_no":null,"line_no":496,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੈ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਕਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pragaT sa(n)saar bibichaar karai ganikaa pai taeh log bedh ar giaan kee na kaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A whore openly commits vice with other men. She has no regard and respect for the morality or code of conduct as laid down in social and religious books. "}}},{"verse_id":209729,"page_no":null,"line_no":496,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਛਾਡਿ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਇ ਲਾਛਨੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕੁਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kulaa badhoo chhaadd bharataar aan dhuaar jai laachhan lagaavai kul a(n)kus na maan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But if a lady of respectable family goes to another man tarnishes the image of her family. "}}},{"verse_id":209730,"page_no":null,"line_no":496,"gurmukhi":"ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਸਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਛਾਡੈ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kapaT sanehee bag dhiaan maan sar firai maanasar chhaaddai ha(n)s ba(n)s mai agiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An egret with false love in his heart wanders from one pond to the other. But if someone belonging to the family of swans (Sikh of the Guru) leaves the Mansarover lake like congregation of the True Guru, that ignorant person is a big fool. "}}},{"verse_id":209731,"page_no":null,"line_no":496,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੦॥","translit_en":"gurmukh manmukh dhuramat gurmat par tan dhan lep niralep dhiaan hai ||490||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient Sikh of the True Guru engrosses his mind in the consecrated words of wisdom of the True Guru, keeps himself unsullied by the evils of others' wealth and body unlike those with base wisdom who suffer separation from the True Guru. (490)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41522,"next":41524}}
files.shabads/83/41524.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41524,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209732","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209732,"last_verse_id":209735,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209732,"page_no":null,"line_no":497,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਲਉਂਗ ਚਰ ਕਾਗੈ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਬਿਗੰਧ ਖਾਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਸਿਯਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"paan kapoor lau(n)g char kaagai aagai raakhai bisaTaa biga(n)dh khaat adhik siyaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If aromatic substances like betel leaf, camphor, clove etc. are placed before a crow, even then by his notion of being wise, he will eat filth and bad smelling things. "}}},{"verse_id":209733,"page_no":null,"line_no":497,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਜਉ ਪੈ ਗੰਗਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਟਰੈ ਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਦੇਵ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baar baar savaiaan jau pai ga(n)gaa isanaan karai Tarai na kuTev dhev hot na agiaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a dog bathes in river Ganges many a time, even then he can't get over his bad habit of eating the left overs. Because of this foolishness, he cannot be of divine disposition. "}}},{"verse_id":209734,"page_no":null,"line_no":497,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਪਹਿ ਪੈ ਪਾਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਮਹਾਂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਗਲਤ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"saapeh pai paan misaTaan mahaa(n) a(n)mirat kai ugalat kaalakooT haumai abhimaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a snake is served very sweetened milk, even then intoxicated with pride, he will spill out venom. "}}},{"verse_id":209735,"page_no":null,"line_no":497,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਤਕਤ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥੪੯੧॥","translit_en":"taise maanasar saadh sa(n)gat maraal sabhaa aan dhev sevak takat bag dhiaan kai ||491||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the Mansarover lake like congregation is an assembly of Sikhs of the Guru who pick pearls from there. But if this assembly is also visited by a follower of gods and goddesses, he would be looking around at others, their wealth with evil eyes and malafide intentions, like a heron. (491) "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41523,"next":41525}}
files.shabads/83/41525.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41525,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209736","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209736,"last_verse_id":209739,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209736,"page_no":null,"line_no":498,"gurmukhi":"ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਅਹਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਭਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿਓ ਤਾਹੀ ਤਾਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"chakiee chakor eh nis sas bhaan dhiaan jaahee jaahee ra(n)g rachio taahee taahee chaahai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The attention of a Ruddy sheldrake and of Allectoris graeca is always towards Sun and Moon respectively. One loves only that in whom one's mind gets engrossed. "}}},{"verse_id":209737,"page_no":null,"line_no":498,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਨ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਲ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਟੇਵ ਓਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"meen aau pata(n)g jal paavak prasa(n)g het Taaree na Tarat Tev or nirabaahai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the context of love, fish loves water while a moth is mad over the flame of fire. Their habit of loving cannot be stopped and they live through their love till their last breath. "}}},{"verse_id":209738,"page_no":null,"line_no":498,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸਰ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਹੰਸ ਬਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਉਤਮ ਅਉ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਸਮਤਾ ਹੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"maanasar aan sar ha(n)s bag preet reet utam aau neech na samaan samataa hai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the context of love, a swan is associated with Mansarover while an egret is found in ponds and puddles. There cannot be any equality in the love of high and low. "}}},{"verse_id":209739,"page_no":null,"line_no":498,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕਨ ਭੇਦ ਸਮਸਰ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਜੀ ॥੪੯੨॥","translit_en":"taise gurdhev aan dhev sevakan bhedh samasar na hot na samu(n)dhr saritaa hai jee ||492||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, there is much difference in the love of the Sikhs of the Guru and followers of gods and goddesses. True Guru is like ocean full of divine virtues whereas gods and goddesses are like rivers and brooks. Ocean and streams can never be alike.  (492)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41524,"next":41526}}
files.shabads/83/41526.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41526,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209740","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209740,"last_verse_id":209743,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209740,"page_no":null,"line_no":499,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਪੇਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਚਕਈ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"preet bhai pekhai pratibi(n)b chakiee jiau nis gurmat aapaa aap cheen pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Ruddy sheldrake looks amorously at her shadow during moonlit nights believing it to be her beloved, so does a Sikh of the Guru recognises the existence of his dear Lord within him and engrosses himself in it. "}}},{"verse_id":209741,"page_no":null,"line_no":499,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਰ ਭਾਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਪਰਛਾਈ ਕੂਪੰਤਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bair bhai pekh parachhaiee koopa(n)tar parai si(n)gh dhuramat laag dhubidhaa kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lion sees his own shadow in the well and under the influence of his jealous feelings, considers it another lion and pounces upon it; similarly a Manmukh separated from his Guru due to his base wisdom is seen entangled in doubts. "}}},{"verse_id":209742,"page_no":null,"line_no":499,"gurmukhi":"ਗਊ ਸੁਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਸੰਗ ਹਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਬਿਰੁਧ ਜੁਧ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"guoo sut anek ek sa(n)g hil mil rahai savaiaan aan dhekhat birudh judh Thaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several calves of cow live together in harmony, so do the obedient sons (Sikhs) of the Guru live in love and brotherhood with each other. But a dog cannot stand another dog and fights with him. (So do the self-willed persons are ever ready to pick up quarrels with each other). "}}},{"verse_id":209743,"page_no":null,"line_no":499,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਅਉ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੯੩॥","translit_en":"gurmukh manmukh cha(n)dhan aau baa(n)s bidh baran ke dhokhee bikaaree upakaaree unamaaneeaai ||493||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The behaviour of Guru-conscious and self-conscious persons is like sandalwood and bamboo. Evil persons fight with others and destroy themselves as bamboos set themselves on fire. On the contrary, virtuous people are seen doing good to their companions.  (493)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41525,"next":41527}}
files.shabads/83/41527.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41527,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209744","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209744,"last_verse_id":209747,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209744,"page_no":null,"line_no":500,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਹਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਰਪ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਤ ਰਿਸਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਗਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau kouoo bulaavai keh savaiaan mirag sarap kai sunat risai dhai gaar maar dheejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a forgetful person is addressed by somebody as dog, animal or snake, he comes into rage and pounces on him as if he is going to kill him (Such a person is worst than these three species) because- "}}},{"verse_id":209745,"page_no":null,"line_no":500,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਦਹਿ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਾਨਿ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaan savaiaam kaam laag jaamanee jaagat rahai naadheh sunai mirag praan haan keejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A dog remains watchful of his master throughout the night and serves him, and a deer goes to the extent of losing his life when it hears the musical sound of Ghanda Herha. "}}},{"verse_id":209746,"page_no":null,"line_no":500,"gurmukhi":"ਧੁੰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਪੜੈ ਸਰਪ ਅਰਪ ਦੇਤ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਦੰਤ ਹੰਤ ਹੋਤ ਗੋਤ ਲਾਜ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhu(n)n ma(n)tr paRai sarap arap dhet tan man dha(n)t ha(n)t hot got laaj geh leejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bewitched by the sound of snake charmer's flute and incantation of Garud, a snake surrenders himself to the charmer. The charmer breaks his fangs and invoking him with the name of his family, catches him. "}}},{"verse_id":209747,"page_no":null,"line_no":500,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਹ ਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥੪੯੪॥","translit_en":"moh na bhagat bhaav sabadh surat heen gur upadhes bin dhirag jag jeejeeaai ||494||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who has turned himself away from the True Guru cannot have dog-like love for his Master Lord. They are even bereft of enchantment of the music (unlike deer) and without the consecration of the True Guru's incantations, their living life in the world is condemnable.  (494)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41526,"next":41528}}
files.shabads/83/41528.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41528,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209748","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209748,"last_verse_id":209751,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209748,"page_no":null,"line_no":501,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਕੂਆ ਖੋਦਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇ ਪਛੁਤਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghar laagai aag jaag kooaa khodhayo chaahai kaaraj na sidh hoi roi pachhutaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as while sleeping, someone's house catches fire and he wakes up and starts digging well, he cannot succeed in putting off the fire. Instead, he then repents and cries. "}}},{"verse_id":209749,"page_no":null,"line_no":501,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਸੀਖਿਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਦਯਾ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਉਦਮ ਜੈਤ ਪਦਵੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sa(n)graam samai seekhiyo chaahai beer bidhayaa anithaa udham jait padhavee na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone wants to learn the art of warfare when the battle is in progress, it is a futile effort. Victory cannot be achieved. "}}},{"verse_id":209750,"page_no":null,"line_no":501,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਸੰਗਾਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ  ਪਾਛੇ ਭੋਰ ਭਏ ਭਾਰ ਬਾਂਧ ਚਲੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nis sovat sa(n)gaatee chal jaat  paachhe bhor bhe bhaar baa(n)dh chale kat jaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a traveller goes to sleep at night and all his companions proceed further leaving him behind, then where will he go with all his luggage when the day breaks? "}}},{"verse_id":209751,"page_no":null,"line_no":501,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਅਵਧਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੪੯੫॥","translit_en":"taise maayaa dha(n)dh a(n)dh avadh bihai jai a(n)t kaal kaise har naam liv laieeaai ||495||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an ignorant man entangled in worldly love and attachments, spends his life accumulating wealth. How can he engross his mind in the name of the Lord when he is on his last breaths?  (495)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41527,"next":41529}}
files.shabads/83/41529.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41529,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209752","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209752,"last_verse_id":209755,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209752,"page_no":null,"line_no":502,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਚਪਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau chapal jal a(n)tar na dhekheeat pooran pragaas pratibi(n)b rav sas ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one cannot see full image of Sun or Moon in unstable and wavy water. "}}},{"verse_id":209753,"page_no":null,"line_no":502,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮਲੀਨ ਦਰਪਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਦਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਉਰਬਸਿ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau maleen dharapan mai na dhekheeat niramal badhan saroop urabas ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one cannot see the complete beauty of the face of Urvashi the divine fairy in a dirty mirror. "}}},{"verse_id":209754,"page_no":null,"line_no":502,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੀਪ ਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਕੋ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ ਭਵਨ ਭਇਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤਸ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin dheep na sameep ko bilokeeat bhavan bhiaan a(n)dhakaar traas tas ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as without the light of a lamp, one cannot even see a thing lying close by. A house in darkness looks scary and frightening beside fear of intrusion of thieves. "}}},{"verse_id":209755,"page_no":null,"line_no":502,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮ ਅਧਮ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ॥੪੯੬॥","translit_en":"taise maiaa bharam adham achhaadhio man satigur dhiaan sukh naan prem ras ko ||496||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the mind entangled in the darkness of mammon (maya). An ignorant mind cannot enjoy the unique bliss of the contemplation of True Guru and meditation on Lord's name.  (496)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41528,"next":41530}}
files.shabads/83/41530.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41530,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209756","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209756,"last_verse_id":209759,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209756,"page_no":null,"line_no":503,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਸਫਲ ਸਪਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਫੂਲ ਫਲ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਗਿਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ek samai dhraoom safal sapatr pun ek samai fool fal patr gir jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree is full of fruits and leaves at one time and then at another time, all leaves, fruits etc. fall off. "}}},{"verse_id":209757,"page_no":null,"line_no":503,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਲਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਮਾਨ ਬਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saritaa salal jaise kabahoo samaan bahai kabahoo(n) athaeh at prabal dhikhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a stream flows calmly at a place but at another place it is rapid and noisy. "}}},{"verse_id":209758,"page_no":null,"line_no":503,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੋਤ ਜੀਰਨਾਂਧਰ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਜੜੇ ਜਗਮਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek samai jaise heeraa hot jeeranaa(n)dhar mai ek samai ka(n)chan jaRe jagamagaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a diamond is wrapped in a (silk) rag at one time. but at another time, the same diamond is inlaid in gold and shines with its grandeur. "}}},{"verse_id":209759,"page_no":null,"line_no":503,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੭॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh raaj kuaar jogeesur hai maayaa dhaaree bhaaree jog jugat jagaat hai ||497||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an obedient Sikh of the Guru is a prince at one time and a supreme ascetic at another time. Even when he is wealthy, he still remains absorbed in the methods of realisation of the Lord.  (497)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41529,"next":41531}}
files.shabads/83/41531.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41531,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209760","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209760,"last_verse_id":209763,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209760,"page_no":null,"line_no":504,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਉ ਬਚਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਲੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan sa(n)g leene aau bachan keene janam lai saadh sa(n)g sree gur araadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This human being brings his food and clothing from the Lord when he takes birth and he promises Him that he will keep company of noble souls and meditate on His name. "}}},{"verse_id":209761,"page_no":null,"line_no":504,"gurmukhi":"ਈਹਾਂ ਆਏ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ਦਾਸੀ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"e'eehaa(n) aae dhaataa bisaraae dhaasee lapaTaae pa(n)ch dhoot bhoot bhram bhramat asaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But once he comes to this world, he forsakes the all-giving God and gets enamored with His maid-servant-maya.. He then wanders in the dragon net of the five demons like lust, anger etc. There is no remedy for his escape. "}}},{"verse_id":209762,"page_no":null,"line_no":504,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਚੁ ਮਰਨੋ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਮਝੈ ਨ ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saach marano bisaar jeevan mithiaa sa(n)saar samajhai na jeet haar supan samaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living in this world, a human being remains engrossed in materials which are no better than dreams."}}},{"verse_id":209763,"page_no":0,"line_no":504,"gurmukhi":"ਅਉਸਰ ਹੁਇ ਹੈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਲੀਜੀਏ ਜਨੰਮ ਜੀਤ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੮॥","translit_en":"aausar hui hai biteet leeje'ee jana(n)m jeet keejeeaai saadh sa(n)g preet agam agaadh hai ||498||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Therefore, O fellow being! the time of this life is passing by. You must win the game of life. Enjoin the holy gathering of saintly souls and develop your love for the infinite Lord.  (498)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41530,"next":41532}}
files.shabads/83/41532.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41532,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209764","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209764,"last_verse_id":209767,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209764,"page_no":null,"line_no":505,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਫਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"safal jana(n)m gur charan saran liv safal dhirasaT gur dharas aloieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Human life is successful if spent in the refuge of the True Guru remembering the Supreme Being. Vision of the eyes is purposeful if it has the desire to see Him. "}}},{"verse_id":209765,"page_no":null,"line_no":505,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਨਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"safal surat gur sabadh sunat nit jihabaa safal gunanidh gun goieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Their hearing power is fruitful who hear that creative sound of the True Guru all the time. That tongue is blessed if it keeps on uttering the virtues of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209766,"page_no":null,"line_no":505,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਹਸਤ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸਫਲ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੋਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"safal hasat gur charan poojaa pranaam safal charan paradhachhanaa ko poieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hands are blessed if they serve the True Guru and keep on praying to Him at His feet. Those feet are blessed that keep moving circumambulating the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209767,"page_no":null,"line_no":505,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਮ ਸਫਲ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਮੋਈਐ ॥੪੯੯॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gam safal saadh sa(n)gat sahaj ghar hiradhaa safal gurmat kai samoieeaai ||499||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Union with saintly congregation is blessed if it brings in a state of equipoise. The mind is blessed only when it imbibes the teachings of the True Guru.  (499)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41531,"next":41533}}
files.shabads/83/41533.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41533,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209768","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209768,"last_verse_id":209771,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209768,"page_no":null,"line_no":506,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਨਿਸਦਿਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"kat pun maanas janam kat saadh sa(n)g nisadhin keeratan samai chal jaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After wandering through eighty-four lakh species, we are blessed with this human birth. If we miss this opportunity, when will we get it again and when will we enjoy the company of the saintly persons? Therefore, we should attend the holy congregation day and night. "}}},{"verse_id":209769,"page_no":null,"line_no":506,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"kat pun dhirasaT dharas hui parasapar bhaavanee bhagat bhai sevaa liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I have face to face glimpse of the True Guru and receive His grace? Therefore I should engross my mind in the loving worship and devotion of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209770,"page_no":null,"line_no":506,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਰੀਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"kat pun raag naadh baadh sa(n)geet reet sree gur sabadh dhun sun pun gaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I get the opportunity of listening to the divine compositions of the True Guru in the accompaniment of musical instruments and sung in the classical mode of singing? Therefore I must find all possible occasions to hear and sing the praises of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209771,"page_no":null,"line_no":506,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਸ ਲੇਖ ਮਸੁਵਾਨੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੫੦੦॥","translit_en":"kat pun kar kirataas lekh masuvaanee sree gur sabadh likh nij padh paieeaai ||500||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I get a chance to write the name of the Lord on the paper-like mind with the conscious-like ink? Therefore I should write the True Guru blessed word on the paper-like heart and reach the self-realisation (through constant meditation).  (500)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41532,"next":41534}}
files.shabads/83/41534.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41534,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209772","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209772,"last_verse_id":209775,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209772,"page_no":null,"line_no":507,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਲਾਸ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਗਬੇਲ ਮੇਲ ਭਏ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau palaas patr naagabel mel bhe pahuchat kar narapat jag jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a meritless leaf of Butea frondosa when enjoins a betel leaf can reach the hands of the king and this is known the world over. "}}},{"verse_id":209773,"page_no":null,"line_no":507,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਨੀਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kucheel neel baran baran bikhai heer cheer sa(n)g niradhokh unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as blue colour is regarded dirty amongst all the colours, but a dress of that colour when enjoins a diamond is considered flawless and unadulterated. "}}},{"verse_id":209774,"page_no":null,"line_no":507,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਲਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਮੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਖ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"saalagraam sevaa samai mahaa apavitr sa(n)kh param pavitr jag bhog bikhai aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a conch is high by impious, being the skeleton of a sea worm, but its sounding at the time of worship of idols, distribution of consecrated offerings and holding of yoga is considered supreme and sacred. "}}},{"verse_id":209775,"page_no":null,"line_no":507,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਮ ਕਾਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਮਾਰ ਨ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਨੀਐ ॥੫੦੧॥","translit_en":"taise mam kaag saadh sa(n)gat maraal maal maar na uThaavat gaavat gur baaneeaai ||501||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a congregation of saintly persons in the presence of True Guru is an assembly of swans where I, person of crow- like temperament indulging in singing of Gurbani not turned out and away.  (501)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41533,"next":41535}}
files.shabads/83/41535.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41535,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209776","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209776,"last_verse_id":209779,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209776,"page_no":null,"line_no":508,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਧਿ ਮੀਨ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਜਲ ਬਿਨ ਤਲਫ ਤਲਫ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal madh meen mahimaa na jaanai pun jal bin talaf talaf mar jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fish does not understand the importance of water while swimming in it but she realises its importance when separated from it and dies yearning for are-union. "}}},{"verse_id":209777,"page_no":null,"line_no":508,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਬਸਤ ਮਹਾਤਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੁਨਿ  ਪਰ ਬਸ ਭਏ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ban basat mahaatamai na jaanai pun  par bas bhe khag mirag akulaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer and a bird living in a jungle do not realize its importance but realises its significance when caught and put in a cage by the hunter and wail for going back to the jungle. "}}},{"verse_id":209778,"page_no":null,"line_no":508,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਬਿਰਹ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pria sa(n)gam kai sukheh na jaanai triaa bichhurat bireh birathaa kai bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife does not appreciate the importance of staying with her husband when together but comes to her senses when separated from her husband. She wails and cries due to pangs of separation from him. "}}},{"verse_id":209779,"page_no":null,"line_no":508,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਤਮਾ ਅਚੇਤ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਪਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੦੨॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran aatamaa achet a(n)tar parat simarat pachhutaat hai ||502||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a seeker living in the refuge of the True Guru remains oblivious of the greatness of Guru. But when separated from Him, repents and laments.  (502)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41534,"next":41536}}
files.shabads/83/41536.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41536,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209780","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209780,"last_verse_id":209783,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209780,"page_no":null,"line_no":509,"gurmukhi":"ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੋਤ ਹੋਂ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਉਰਧਾਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥","translit_en":"bhagat vachhal sun hot ho(n) niraas ridhai patit paavan sun aasaa uradhaar ho(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, when I hear that you are beloved of those who worship you all the time, I, who is bereft of your worship become sad and disappointed.
