But on hearing that you forgive sinners and make them pious, a ray of hope kindles in my heart. "}}},{"verse_id":209781,"page_no":null,"line_no":509,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੰਪਤ ਹੋਂ ਅੰਤਰਿਗਤਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਦਯਾਲ ਸੁਨਿ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਟਾਰ ਹੋਂ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tarajaamee sun ka(n)pat ho(n) a(n)tarigat dheen kai dhayaal sun bhai bhram Taar ho(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I, the evil-doer, when hear that you are knower of innate feelings and thoughts of everyone, I tremble within. But hearing that you are clement on poor and destitutes, I shed all my fears. "}}},{"verse_id":209782,"page_no":null,"line_no":509,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲਧਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਅਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਮਲਗਾਰ ਹੌਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaladhar sa(n)gam kai afal se(n)bal dhrum cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh malagaar haua(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The silk cotton tree is well spread but doesn't bear any flower/fruit even during rainy season; but when influenced by sandalwood, it becomes equally fragrant. Similarly, an egoistic person transforms when influenced by the sandalwood-like True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":209783,"page_no":null,"line_no":509,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਠਉਰੁ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਰੋ ਸਮਾਰ ਹੌਂ ॥੫੦੩॥","translit_en":"apanee karanee kar narak hoo na paavahu Thaur tumare biradh kar aasaro samaar haua(n) ||503||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of my ill deeds, I cannot find a place even in hell. But I am leaning and depending upon your character of merciful, benevolent, clement, and corrector of the evil-doers.  (503)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41535,"next":41537}}
files.shabads/83/41537.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41537,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209784","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209784,"last_verse_id":209787,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209784,"page_no":null,"line_no":510,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਹਮ ਅਧਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਭਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau ham adham karam kai patit bhe patit paavan prabh naam pragaTaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we have fallen from your favour due to our evil and unrighteous deeds, then 0 Lord! You have made known that You bless the sinners with Your grace and make them good and pious. "}}},{"verse_id":209785,"page_no":null,"line_no":510,"gurmukhi":"ਜੌ ਭਏ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨ ਪਰਚੀਨ ਲਗਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਬਿਰਦ ਬਿਰਦਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau bhe dhukhit ar dheen paracheen lag dheen dhukh bha(n)jan biradh biradhaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we are suffering due to our ill deeds and sins of the previous births, then 0 Lord! You have made it conspicuous that You dispel the sufferings of the poor and destitudes. "}}},{"verse_id":209786,"page_no":null,"line_no":510,"gurmukhi":"ਜੌ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਏ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਜਗਤ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau grase arak sut narak nivaasee bhe narak nivaaran jagat jas gaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we are in the grip of the angels of death and become deserving of a life in hell because of our bad and evil deeds, then 0 Lord ! The whole world is singing Your paeans that You are the liberator of all from the vagaries of hell."}}},{"verse_id":209787,"page_no":null,"line_no":510,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਤੋਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੫੦੪॥","translit_en":"gun ke'ee gun sab kouoo karai kirapaa nidhaan avagun ke'ee gun tohee ban aayo hai ||504||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O store house of clemency! One. who does good to others begets good in returns. But doing good to low and evil doers like us behoves only You. (You alone can bless and forgive the sins and evil deeds of all).  (504)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41536,"next":41538}}
files.shabads/83/41538.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41538,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209788","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209788,"last_verse_id":209791,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209788,"page_no":null,"line_no":511,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਰੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਖਾਨਿ ਪਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau arog bhog bhogavai naanaa prakaar birathaava(n)t khaan paan ridhai na hitaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a healthy person eats many types of dishes and eatables but a sick man does not like eating any of them. "}}},{"verse_id":209789,"page_no":null,"line_no":511,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਖੀ ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਧੀਰਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਜਿਆ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਕਲੇਜੋ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mahakhee sahan seel kai dheeraj dhujaa ajiaa mai tanak kalejo na samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a buffalo, because of its tolerance is known to have great patience but a goat on the other hand does not have even a fraction of that patience. "}}},{"verse_id":209790,"page_no":null,"line_no":511,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਹੈ ਵੇਚੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਕਾਦਿ ਰੰਕ ਪੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਗ ਨ ਜੁਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jauharee bisaahai veche heeraa maanakaadh ra(n)k pai na raakhio parai jog na jugaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a jeweller trades in diamonds and precious stones but no valuable diamond can be kept with a pauper since he does not have the ability to keep such expensive item. "}}},{"verse_id":209791,"page_no":null,"line_no":511,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਪਚੁ ਅਪਰਚੇ ਦੁਸਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੫੦੫॥","translit_en":"taise gur parachai pavitr hai poojaa prasaadh apach aparache dhuseh dhukh paaviee ||505||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a devotee who remains engaged in the service and remembrance of the Lord, eating the offerings and consecrated food for him is justified. But he who doesn't obey the command of the Guru suffers if he consumes the worship offerings. (505)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41537,"next":41539}}
files.shabads/83/41539.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41539,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209792","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209792,"last_verse_id":209795,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209792,"page_no":null,"line_no":512,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਖਾਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਤਾਤ ਗਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀ ਬਰਖਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bikh tanak hee khaat mar jaat taat gaat murajhaat pratipaalee barakhan kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as by taking a very small quantity of poison, one dies instantly, destroying the body that had been reared and sustained over many years. "}}},{"verse_id":209793,"page_no":null,"line_no":512,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਿਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਇ ਦੂਧ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਭਰਿ ਪਰਤਿ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਕੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਾਦਿ ਨ ਰਖਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"mahikhee dhuhai dhoodh raakheeaai bhaa(n)jan bhar parat kaa(n)jee kee boo(n)dh baadh na rakhan kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a can of milk of buffalo contaminated with a drop of citric acid becomes useless and not worth keeping. "}}},{"verse_id":209794,"page_no":null,"line_no":512,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਤੂਲਿ ਰੰਚਕ ਚਿਨਗ ਪਰੇ ਹੋਤ ਭਸਮਾਤ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਅਕਰਖਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koT bhaar tool ra(n)chak chinag pare hot bhasamaat chhin mai akarakhan kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a spark of fire can burn millions of bales of cotton in a short time. "}}},{"verse_id":209795,"page_no":null,"line_no":512,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਹਰੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਖਨ ਕੀ ॥੫੦੬॥","translit_en":"taise par tan dhan dhookhanaa bikaar ke'ee harai nidh sukirat sahaj harakhan kee ||506||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the vices and sins that one acquires by associating oneself with other's wealth and beauty, one loses the much valuable commodity of happiness, good deeds and peace.  (506)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41538,"next":41540}}
files.shabads/83/41540.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41540,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209796","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209796,"last_verse_id":209799,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209796,"page_no":null,"line_no":513,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਬਸਿ ਬਾਂਸ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਆਨ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਏ ਬਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep bas baa(n)s mahimaa na jaanee aan dhrum dhoorahu bhe baasan kai bohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even while living in the close proximity of sandalwood, a bamboo has not appreciated its characteristic of spreading its fragrance whereas other trees become equally fragrant despite their distance from it. "}}},{"verse_id":209797,"page_no":null,"line_no":513,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਮੈ ਜਾਨੀ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕੈ ਬਿਮੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar sarovar mai jaanee na kamal gat madhukar man makara(n)dh kai bimohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Staying in a pond, a frog has never appreciated the characteristics of a lotus flower whereas a bumble bee is eternally attracted to its sweet smell even while staying far away from it. "}}},{"verse_id":209798,"page_no":null,"line_no":513,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਬਸਤ ਬਗੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੇਤ ਜਾਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"teerath basat bag maram na jaanio kachh saradhaa kai jaatraa het jaatree jan sohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A heron staying at holy places do not realise the spiritual importance of these places of pilgrimage whereas devoted travellers earn a good name for themselves on their return from there. "}}},{"verse_id":209799,"page_no":null,"line_no":513,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਤ ਮਮ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੀਨ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਖਿ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੈ ਪੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥੫੦੭॥","translit_en":"nikaT basat mam gur upadhes heen dhoora(n)tar sikh ur a(n)tar lai pohe hai ||507||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, like bamboo, frog and heron, I am devoid of practicing Guru's teachings despite the fact that I live near my Guru. On the contrary Sikhs residing far off acquire Guru's wisdom and lodge it in their heart to practice on.  (507)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41539,"next":41541}}
files.shabads/83/41541.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41541,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209800","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209800,"last_verse_id":209803,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209800,"page_no":null,"line_no":514,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਦਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paradhaaraa ko dharas dhirag dhekhio chaahai taise gur dharasan dhekhat hai na chaeh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a forgetful person does not desire a glimpse of his Guru with the same intensity that he uses his eyes to ogle at other women. "}}},{"verse_id":209801,"page_no":null,"line_no":514,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨੈ ਨ ਉਤਸਾਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise parani(n)dhaa sunai saavadhaan surat kai taiso gur sabadh sunai na utasaeh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a worldly man listens to the slander of other persons very attentively, he does not listen to the divine words of Guru with same fondness. "}}},{"verse_id":209802,"page_no":null,"line_no":514,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਰਨ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਧਾਵੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਉਮਾਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise par dharab haran kau charan dhaavai taise keeratan saadhasa(n)gat na umaeh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person greedy of wealth walks a distance to cheat another person of his hard earned money, he does not show the same enthusiasm of going to the divine congregation to listen to the adulations of Almighty. "}}},{"verse_id":209803,"page_no":null,"line_no":514,"gurmukhi":"ਉਲੂ ਕਾਗ ਨਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਊਚ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਪਦੁ ਗਾਹ ਕੈ ॥੫੦੮॥","translit_en":"auloo kaag naag dhiaan khaan paan kau na jaanai uooch padh paavai nahee neech padh gaeh kai ||508||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like an owl, crow and snake, I do not know the value of radiance, sweet smelling traits and relishment of Naam of the True Guru. Doing inferior deeds, I have lowered my status and can't attain a high spiritual state. (508)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41540,"next":41542}}
files.shabads/83/41542.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41542,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209804","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209804,"last_verse_id":209807,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209804,"page_no":null,"line_no":515,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਬ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਚਕਵੀ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise rain sain samai sab log mai sa(n)jog bhog chakavee biog sog bhaagaheen jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as everyone enjoys the company of their dear ones at night, but a ruddy sheldrake is considered unfortunate having been separated from its beloved. "}}},{"verse_id":209805,"page_no":null,"line_no":515,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਉਲੂ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਪਰਚੀਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhinakar kai udhot jot jagamag uloo a(n)dh ka(n)dh paracheen unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sunrise brightens up the place but an owl is seen hidden in dark allays and walls. "}}},{"verse_id":209806,"page_no":null,"line_no":515,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਵਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਜਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਰਹਤ ਬਕਬਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"saravar saritaa samu(n)dhar jal pooran hai tirakhaava(n)t chaatirak rahat bakabaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ponds, streams and oceans are seen to be full to the brim with water, but longing for rain, a rain-bird remains thirsty and keeps wailing and crying for that Swati drop. "}}},{"verse_id":209807,"page_no":null,"line_no":515,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਅਪਰਾਧਨ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਐ ॥੫੦੯॥","translit_en":"taise mil saadhasa(n)g sakal sa(n)saar tario moh aparaadhee aparaadhan bihaaneeaai ||509||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly by associating themselves with the congregation of the True Guru, the whole world is sailing across the worldly ocean but I, the sinner is spending all his life in evil deeds and vices.  (509)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41541,"next":41543}}
files.shabads/83/41543.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41543,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209808","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209808,"last_verse_id":209811,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209808,"page_no":null,"line_no":516,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਫਲ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਹੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise fal fooleh lai jai banarai prat karai abhimaan kaho kaise ban aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone takes a handful of fruits and flowers to present it to the king of the jungle where fruits and flowers abound, and then feels proud of his present, how can he be liked? "}}},{"verse_id":209809,"page_no":null,"line_no":516,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ਸਰਾਹੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਤਉ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mukataahal samu(n)dhreh dhikhaavai jai baar baar hee saraahai sobhaa tau na paavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone takes a handful of pearls to the treasure house of pearls-ocean, and praises his pearls again and again, he does not earn any appreciation. "}}},{"verse_id":209810,"page_no":null,"line_no":516,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨੀ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖਿ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kanee ka(n)chan sumer sanamukh raakh man mai garab karai baavaro kahaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone presents a small piece of gold nugget to Sumer mountain (the home of gold) and feels proud of his gold, he would be called a fool. "}}},{"verse_id":209811,"page_no":null,"line_no":516,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਠਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦੈ ਰੀਝਾਇਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੫੧੦॥","translit_en":"taise giaan dhiaan Thaan praan dhai reejhaio chaahai praanapat satigur kaise kai reejhaavai jee ||510||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly if someone talks of knowledge and contemplations and pretends to surrender himself with a view to please and entice the True Guru, he cannot succeed in his nefarious designs of pleasing the True Guru the master of all life.  (510)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41542,"next":41544}}
files.shabads/83/41544.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41544,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209812","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209812,"last_verse_id":209815,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209812,"page_no":null,"line_no":517,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਅਉ ਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਬੇਚਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬ ਦਿਸਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise choaa cha(n)dhan aau dhaan paan bechan kau poorab dhisaa lai jai kaise ban aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone takes the products grown in the East like rice, betel, sandalwood to sell there, he cannot gain anything in their trading. "}}},{"verse_id":209813,"page_no":null,"line_no":517,"gurmukhi":"ਪਛਮ ਦਿਸਾ ਦਾਖ ਦਾਰਮ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਕੇਸਰ ਲੈ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pachham dhisaa dhaakh dhaaram lai jai jaise mirag madh kesar lai utareh dhaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone takes the products grown in the West like grapes and pomegranates, and those commodities grown in the North like saffron and musk to the West and North respectively, what gain does he get out of such trading? "}}},{"verse_id":209814,"page_no":null,"line_no":517,"gurmukhi":"ਦਖਨ ਦਿਸਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਲਾਇਚੀ ਲਵੰਗ ਲਾਦਿ ਬਾਦਿ ਆਸਾ ਉਦਮ ਹੈ ਬਿੜਤੋ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhakhan dhisaa lai jai laichee lava(n)g laadh baadh aasaa udham hai biRato na paavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone takes commodities like cardamom and clove to South where these are grown, all his efforts of earning any profit would be futile. "}}},{"verse_id":209815,"page_no":null,"line_no":517,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਦਿਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੫੧੧॥","translit_en":"taise gun nidh gur saagar kai bidhimaan giaan gun pragaT kai baavaro kahaavai jee ||511||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly if someone tries to display his traits and knowledge before the True Guru who Himself is ocean of knowledge and divine traits, such a person will be called a fool.  (511)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41543,"next":41545}}
files.shabads/83/41545.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41545,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209816","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209816,"last_verse_id":209819,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209816,"page_no":null,"line_no":518,"gurmukhi":"ਛਲਨੀ ਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਵਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"chhalanee mai jaise dhekheeat hai anek chhidhr karai karavaa kee ni(n)dhaa kaise ban aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sieve has so many holes and if it slanders an earthen pot, then how can it be respected. "}}},{"verse_id":209817,"page_no":null,"line_no":518,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਖ ਬਬੂਰ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਬਹੁ ਸੂਰਨ ਸੈ ਕਮਲੈ ਕਟੀਲੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"birakh baboor bharapoor bahu sooran sai kamalai kaTeelo kahai kaahoo na sukhaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an acacia tree which is full of thorns call a lotus flower thorny, this allegation will not be appreciated by anyone. "}}},{"verse_id":209818,"page_no":null,"line_no":518,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਉਪਹਾਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਮਰਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise upahaas karai bais maraal prat chhaadd mukataahal dhruga(n)dh liv laavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as leaving pearls, a filth-eating crow cracks a joke on swan, the eater of pearls of lake Mansarover, this is nothing but his dirtiness. "}}},{"verse_id":209819,"page_no":null,"line_no":518,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹਉ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਭਰਿਓ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੫੧੨॥","translit_en":"taise hau mahaa(n) apraadhee aparaadh bhario sakal sa(n)saar ko bikaar moh bhaavai jee ||512||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly sin-filled I, am a big sinner. The sin of slandering the whole world pleases me.  (512)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41544,"next":41546}}
files.shabads/83/41546.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41546,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209820","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209820,"last_verse_id":209823,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209820,"page_no":null,"line_no":519,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"aapadhaa adheen jaise dhukhit dhuhaagan ko sahaj suhaag na suhaagan ko bhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a distressed, divorced woman cannot bear to see or tolerate the loving and happy union of another woman with her husband, "}}},{"verse_id":209821,"page_no":null,"line_no":519,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੈ ਸੰਜੋਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"birahanee bireh biog mai sa(n)jogan ko su(n)dhar si(n)gaar adhikaar na suhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman separated from her husband and bearing the pangs of separation cannot tolerate the embellishments of another woman who is united with her husband, "}}},{"verse_id":209822,"page_no":null,"line_no":519,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਮਾਂਝਿ ਬਾਂਝਿ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਸੋ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਉਤ ਕੋ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tan maa(n)jh baa(n)jh rog sog sa(n)so sram saut ko suteh pekh mahaa(n) dhukh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a distressed and fatigued woman suffering from her inability to bear a child feels much distressed on seeing the son of her co-wife, "}}},{"verse_id":209823,"page_no":null,"line_no":519,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥੫੧੩॥","translit_en":"taise par tan dhan dhookhan tiradhokh mam saadhan ko sukirat na hiradhai hitaaviee ||513||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly I am infested with three chronic ailments-namely other's women, other's wealth and slander. And that is why praise of the devoted and loving Sikhs of the True Guru does not please me.  (513)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41545,"next":41547}}
files.shabads/83/41547.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41547,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209824","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209824,"last_verse_id":209827,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209824,"page_no":null,"line_no":520,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਾਸਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਲਫ ਤਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal sai nikaas meen raakheeaai paTa(n)bar mai bin jal talaf tajat pria praan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fish removed from water, though kept in silk cloth yet dies having been separated from her beloved water. "}}},{"verse_id":209825,"page_no":null,"line_no":520,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨ ਸੈ ਪਕਰ ਪੰਛੀ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਨ ਮਨ ਓਨਮਨੋ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ban sai pakar pa(n)chhee pi(n)jaree mai raakheeaai tau bin ban man onamano unamaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bird is caught from the jungle and put in a beautiful cage with very delicious food, his mind is seen to be restless without the freedom of the jungle. "}}},{"verse_id":209826,"page_no":null,"line_no":520,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਮਨੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਤਿ ਛੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਭਵਨ ਭਇਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaamanee bhataar bichhurat at chheen dheen bilakh badhan taeh bhavan bhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a pretty woman becomes weak and grieved on separation from her husband. Her face looks perplexed and confused and she feels scared of her own home. "}}},{"verse_id":209827,"page_no":null,"line_no":520,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੪॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh bichhurat saadh sa(n)gat sai jeevan jatan bin sa(n)gat na aan hai ||514||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly separated from the saintly congregation of the True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru wails, tosses and turns, feels miserable and perplexed. Without the company of saintly souls of the True Guru, he has no other aim in life.  (514)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41546,"next":41548}}
files.shabads/83/41548.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41548,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209828","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209828,"last_verse_id":209831,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209828,"page_no":null,"line_no":521,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਨਾਗਬੇਲ ਸੈ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਜੁਗਵਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise TooTe naagabel sai bidhes jaat salal sa(n)jog chira(n)kaal jugavat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as betel leaves plucked from the creeper are sent to distant places and if kept in damp cloth remains useful for long, "}}},{"verse_id":209829,"page_no":null,"line_no":521,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂੰਜ ਬਚਰਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koo(n)j bacharaa tiaag dhisa(n)tar jaat simarat chit nirabighan rahat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crane deposits her young ones and fly out to distant land but always remember them in her mind as a result of which they remain alive and grow, "}}},{"verse_id":209830,"page_no":null,"line_no":521,"gurmukhi":"ਗੰਗੋਦਿਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਰਿ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਅਧਾਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ga(n)godhik jaise bhar bhaa(n)jan lai jaat jaatree sujas adhaar niramal nibahat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as travellers carry water of river Ganges in their container, and being of superior disposition it stays good for long, "}}},{"verse_id":209831,"page_no":null,"line_no":521,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਅਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੫॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran a(n)tar sikh sabadh sa(n)gat gur dhiaan kai jeeat hai ||515||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly if a Sikh of the True Guru somehow get separated from his Guru, he remains invigorated by virtue of holy congregation, meditation on His name and contemplating and focusing his mind in the holy feet of his True Guru.  (515)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41547,"next":41549}}
files.shabads/83/41549.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41549,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209832","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209832,"last_verse_id":209835,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209832,"page_no":null,"line_no":522,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਲਿਆਗਰ ਪਵਨ ਕਤ ਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin pavan kavan gun cha(n)dhan sai bin maliaagar pavan kat baas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sandalwood tree cannot impart its fragrance to others without breeze and without the air of malay mountain, how can the atmosphere become fragranced, "}}},{"verse_id":209833,"page_no":null,"line_no":522,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਦ ਅਵਖਦ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਿ ਹੋਤ ਅਵਖਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਦ ਰੋਗਹਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin baidh avakhadh gun gop hot avakhadh bin baidh rogeh na graas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a physician know the merit of every herb or medicine and without medicine, no physician can cure an ailing person, "}}},{"verse_id":209834,"page_no":null,"line_no":522,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਖੇਵਟ ਸੈ ਖੇਵਟ ਬਿਹੂੰਨ ਕਤ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin bohith na paar parai khevaT sai khevaT bihoo(n)n kat bohith bisavaiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as no one can cross the ocean without sailor nor can it be crossed without a ship, "}}},{"verse_id":209835,"page_no":null,"line_no":522,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੰਮ ਨ ਪਰਮਪਦੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੬॥","translit_en":"taise gur naam bin ga(n)m na paramapadh bin gur naam nihakaam na pragaas hai ||516||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly without the boon of Lord's name given by the True Guru, God cannot be realised. And without Naam the liberator from the worldly desires and blessed by the True Guru, no one can acquire spiritual effulgence.  (516)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41548,"next":41550}}
files.shabads/83/41550.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41550,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209836","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209836,"last_verse_id":209839,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209836,"page_no":null,"line_no":523,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚੋ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਗਾਤਿ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੈ ਪਿਰਾਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kaacho paaro khaat upajai bikaar gaat rom rom kai piraat mahaa dhukh paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as consuming raw mercury causes such a disorder in the body that causes pain in every limb and one feels discomfort. "}}},{"verse_id":209837,"page_no":null,"line_no":523,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਲਸਨ ਖਾਏ ਮੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਸਭਾ ਮੈ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਰਤਿ ਦੁਰਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau lasan khaae mon kai sabhaa mai baiThe pragaTai dhuraga(n)dh naeh dhurat dhuraieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as after eating garlic one may remain silent in an assembly, even then its foul odour cannot be hidden. "}}},{"verse_id":209838,"page_no":null,"line_no":523,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਖੀ ਲੀਲੇ ਹੋਤ ਉਕਲੇਦ ਖੇਦੁ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਹਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise misaTaan paan sa(n)gam kai maakhee leele hot ukaledh khedh sa(n)kaT sahaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person may swallow a fly while eating sweetmeat, he vomits immediately. He bears much suffering and distress. "}}},{"verse_id":209839,"page_no":null,"line_no":523,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਪਰਚੇ ਪਿੰਡ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਖਾਏ ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਮਲੋਕ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੫੧੭॥","translit_en":"taise hee aparache pi(n)dd sikhan kee bhikhiaa khaae a(n)takaal bhaaree hoi jamalok jaieeaai ||517||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly an ignorant person consumes the offerings made by the devotees of the True Guru. He suffers much at the time of his death. He has to face the wrath of the angels of death.  (517)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41549,"next":41551}}
files.shabads/83/41551.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41551,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209840","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209840,"last_verse_id":209843,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209840,"page_no":null,"line_no":524,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਤ ਹਰਖਤਿ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਲੋਧਾ ਲੋਨ ਗਰਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise megh barakhat harakhat hai kirasaan bilakh badhan lodhaa lon gar jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a farmer is delighted to see the rainfall but the face of a weaver becomes ashen and he feels restless and miserable. "}}},{"verse_id":209841,"page_no":null,"line_no":524,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਸੁਕਤ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਆਕ ਮੂਲ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise parafulit hui sakal banaasapatee sukat javaaso aak mool murajhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all the vegetation turns green with the fall of rain but the plant of camel thorn (Alhagi maurorum) withers while akk (Calotropis procera) dries out right from its roots. "}}},{"verse_id":209842,"page_no":null,"line_no":524,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਸਰਵਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਖ ਜਲ ਊਚ ਥਲ ਕਾਲਰ ਨ ਜਲ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khet saravar pooran kirakh jal uooch thal kaalar na jal Thahiraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as ponds and fields are filled with water when it rains, but no water can accumulate on mounds and saline land. "}}},{"verse_id":209843,"page_no":null,"line_no":524,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਕੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੮॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes paraves gursikh ridhai saakat sakat man sun sakuchaat hai ||518||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the sermon of the True Guru permeates in the mind of a Sikh. But a self-oriented person who is in the grip of the worldly attractions, remains cringed hearing the divine words of the Guru. (518)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41550,"next":41552}}
files.shabads/83/41552.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41552,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209844","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209844,"last_verse_id":209847,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209844,"page_no":null,"line_no":525,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਵਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਨੀ ਸਹੇਤ ਸਕਲ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਏਕ ਬਾਂਝ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raajaa ravat anek ravanee sahet sakal sapootee ek baa(n)jh na sa(n)taan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king loves many queens who all bear him a son, but there may be one who is barren, who cannot bear any issue. "}}},{"verse_id":209845,"page_no":null,"line_no":525,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਚਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਫਲ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"seechat salil jaise safal sakal dhrum nihafal se(n)bal salil nirabaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as irrigating the trees help them bear fruits but the cotton silk tree remains fruitless. It does not accept the influence of water. "}}},{"verse_id":209846,"page_no":null,"line_no":525,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਤਮ ਅਉ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar kamal jaise ek saravar bikhai utam aau neech keech dhinakar dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a frog and a lotus flower live in one pond but lotus is supreme since it faces Sun and frog is low since it remains engrossed in mud. "}}},{"verse_id":209847,"page_no":null,"line_no":525,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਸਕਲ ਜਗੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਂਸ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੯॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran hai sakal jag cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baa(n)s unamaan hai ||519||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the whole world comes into the refuge of the True Guru. Devoted Sikhs who obtain the elixir-like Naam from the True Guru become fragrant but a bamboo-like arrogant person remains without the fragrance. (519)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41551,"next":41553}}
files.shabads/83/41553.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41553,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209848","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209848,"last_verse_id":209851,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209848,"page_no":null,"line_no":526,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਸੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bachhuraa bilalaat maat milabe kau ba(n)dhan kai bas kachh bas na basaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a calf writhes and wriggles to meet his mother but tethered with rope makes him helpless. "}}},{"verse_id":209849,"page_no":null,"line_no":526,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਭਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਕੀਓ ਪਰ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਹੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau bigaaree chaahai bhavan gavan keeo par bas pare chitavat hee bihaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person caught in forced or unpaid labour wants to go home and spends time planning while remaining in other's control. "}}},{"verse_id":209850,"page_no":null,"line_no":526,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਾਹੇ ਲਾਜ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕਸ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਬਲ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birahanee pria sa(n)gam saneh chaahe laaj kul a(n)kas kai dhurabal gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife separated from her husband wants love and union but cannot do so for fear of family shame and thus loses her physical attraction. "}}},{"verse_id":209851,"page_no":null,"line_no":526,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਬਧ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran sukh chaahai sikh aagiaa badh rahat bidhes akulaat hai ||520||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a true disciple wants to enjoy the pleasures of the refuge of True Guru but bound by his command he wanders around dejectedly in another place.  (520)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41552,"next":41554}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41554,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209852","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209852,"last_verse_id":209855,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209852,"page_no":null,"line_no":527,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਲਛਲ ਬੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਹੀ ਕਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"par dhan par tan par apavaadh baadh balachhal ba(n)ch parapa(n)ch hee kamaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who keeps his interest in other person's wife, wealth and who indulges in other's slander, trickery and cheating, "}}},{"verse_id":209853,"page_no":null,"line_no":527,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਗੋਬਧ ਬਧੂ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬੰਸ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mitr gur savaiaam dhroh kaam krodh lobh moh gobadh badhoo bisavaiaas ba(n)s bipr ghaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who betrays a friend, Guru and master, who is caught in the vices of lust, anger, greed and attachment, who kills cow, woman, cheats, betrays his family and murders Brahmin, "}}},{"verse_id":209854,"page_no":null,"line_no":527,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਓਗ ਆਪਦਾ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਨ ਜਮ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rog sog hui biog aapadhaa dharidhr chhidhr janam maran jam lok bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who is suffering due to various ailments and distresses, who is troubled, lazy and vice-ridden who is caught in the cycle of birth and death and is in the stranglehold of the angels of death, "}}},{"verse_id":209855,"page_no":null,"line_no":527,"gurmukhi":"ਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਬਿਸਿਖ ਬਿਖਿਆਦੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੀਨ ਅਧਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਮ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੧॥","translit_en":"kirataghan bisikh bikhiaadhee koT dhokhee dheen adham asa(n)kh mam rom na pujaat hai ||521||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who is ungrateful, venomous and user of arrow-like sharp words, who is miserable due to countless sins, vices or imperfections; such countless evil-doers cannot match even a hair of my sins. I am many time more evil than them.  (521)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41553,"next":41555}}
files.shabads/83/41555.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41555,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209856","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209856,"last_verse_id":209859,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209856,"page_no":null,"line_no":528,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਨਾਰ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"besavaiaa ke si(n)gaar bibichaar ko na paar paieeaai bin bharataar kaa kee naar kai bulaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The embellishments of a whore and her relationships with many men cannot be fathomed. Without a husband, whose wife can she be known as? "}}},{"verse_id":209857,"page_no":null,"line_no":528,"gurmukhi":"ਬਗੁ ਸੇਤ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੋ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"bag set jeev ghaat kar khaat kete ko mon geh dhiaan dhare jugat na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A heron is white like a swan but it kills many living beings to appease his appetite. To do this evil act, he stands in perfect silence, but in doing so, he does not achieve the know-how of yog. "}}},{"verse_id":209858,"page_no":null,"line_no":528,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਂਡ ਕੀ ਭੰਡਾਈ ਬੁਰਵਾਈ ਨ ਕਹਤ ਆਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਸੁਕਚਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"bhaa(n)dd kee bha(n)ddaiee buravaiee na kahat aavai at hee ddiThaiee sukachat na lajaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One cannot explain the shamelessness of the actions and words used by a mimic. He does not shy away from using bad words out of sheer obstinacy. "}}},{"verse_id":209859,"page_no":null,"line_no":528,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਅਧਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਈਐ ॥੫੨੨॥","translit_en":"taise par tan dhan dhookhan tiradhokh mam adham anek ek rom na pujaieeaai ||522||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, like these low character people, I am low too. I am a chronic patient of the three diseases, that is looking at others wealth, woman and slandering others. Numerous sinners cannot match even a hair of my sinful life. I am lowest of all the low characters.  (522)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41554,"next":41556}}
files.shabads/83/41556.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41556,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209860","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209860,"last_verse_id":209863,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209860,"page_no":null,"line_no":529,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਰ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਉਬਟਾ ਮੈ ਚੁਹਟੀ ਲਗਾਇ ਛਾਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਕਹਾਂ ਮਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chor chaaheeaai chaRaio sooree chaubaTaa mai chuhaTee lagai chhaaddeeaai tau kahaa(n) maar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a thief should be crucified on a cross, but if he is just pinched and let off, it is no punishment for him, "}}},{"verse_id":209861,"page_no":null,"line_no":529,"gurmukhi":"ਖੋਟ ਸਾਰੀਓ ਨਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਨਗਰ ਹੂੰ ਸੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਰ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਹਾ ਆਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khoT saareeo nikaario chaaheeaai nagar hoo(n) sai taa kee or mor mukh baiThe kahaa aar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as manufacturer of counterfeit coins should be exiled. But if we just turn our face away from him, it is no punishment for him, "}}},{"verse_id":209862,"page_no":null,"line_no":529,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਾਂ ਬਜਰ ਭਾਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਜਉ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਰ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਛਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਉਡਾਏ ਕਹਾਂ ਭਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mahaa(n) bajar bhaar ddaario chaaheeaai jau haathee par taeh sir chhaar ke uddaae kahaa(n) bhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As an elephant may be loaded with heavy weight but if just a bit of dust is sprinkled on him, it is no burden for him, "}}},{"verse_id":209863,"page_no":null,"line_no":529,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਤਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਨ ਪਾਸੰਗ ਭਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡ ਅਉ ਨਰਕ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੩॥","translit_en":"taise hee patit pat koT na paasa(n)g bhar moh jam dda(n)dd aau narak upakaar hai ||523||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly millions of sins are not even counterweight of my sins. But to punish me with abode in hell and entrusting me to the angels of death is showing mercy on me.  (523)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41555,"next":41557}}
files.shabads/83/41557.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41557,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209864","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209864,"last_verse_id":209867,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209864,"page_no":null,"line_no":530,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਚੋਰੀ ਕੈ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਹੰਸ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਛੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai chor choree kai bataavai ha(n)s maanasar chhooT kai na jai ghar sooree chaaR maareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a thief steals and yet declare himself pious like swans of lake Mansarover, he is not forgiven but is crucified and killed. "}}},{"verse_id":209865,"page_no":null,"line_no":530,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਟ ਮਾਰ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਬਗੁ ਮੀਨ ਜਉ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਤਤਖਨ ਤਾਤਕਾਲ ਮੂੰਡ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"baaT maar baTavaaro bag meen jau bataavai tatakhan taatakaal moo(n)dd kaaT ddaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a wayside dacoit declares himself kind and good doer of the wayside travellers just as a heron feels towards the fish and frogs in a pond, his claim cannot be accepted and he should be beheaded there and then. "}}},{"verse_id":209866,"page_no":null,"line_no":530,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਭਜਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਟੁ ਕਾਨ ਨਾਕ ਖੰਡ ਡੰਡ ਨਗਰ ਨਿਕਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai par dhaaraa bhaj miragan bataavai biT kaan naak kha(n)dd dda(n)dd nagar nikaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lecherous person declares himself chaste and celibate like the deers of a jungle after committing adultery with some other woman, he is not let off on his statement. Instead his nose and ears are chopped off and he is expelled from the city. "}}},{"verse_id":209867,"page_no":null,"line_no":530,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰੀ ਬਟਵਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਨਰਕ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਡੰਡ ਦੇਤ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੫੨੪॥","translit_en":"choree baTavaaree par naaree kai tiradhokh mam narak arak sut dda(n)dd dhet haareeaai ||524||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A thief, dacoit and a lecherous man is punished so severely for one crime they commit. But I am a sufferer of all these three ailments like tuberculosis. So punishing me for all these sins, the angels of death will get tired.  (524)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41556,"next":41558}}
files.shabads/83/41558.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41558,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209868","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209868,"last_verse_id":209871,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209868,"page_no":null,"line_no":531,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਨਮਿਤ ਮਾਝ ਹੀ ਬਸਤ ਬਗ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaat hai jagatr jaise teerath jaatraa namit maajh hee basat bag mahimaa na jaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the whole world go to places of pilgrimage, but the egret living there has not appreciated the greatness of these places, "}}},{"verse_id":209869,"page_no":null,"line_no":531,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਾਸਕਰਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਲੂ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran pragaas bhaasakar jagamag jot uloo a(n)dh ka(n)dh buree karanee kamaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as bright light spreads all around when the Sun rises, but an owl has committed so many ill deeds that he remains hidden in dark caves and burrows, "}}},{"verse_id":209870,"page_no":null,"line_no":531,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ ਸਫਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਉਰ ਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau basa(n)t samai safal banaasapatee nihafal se(n)bal baddaiee ur aanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all vegetation bears flowers and fruits during spring season but a cotton silk tree who has brought in him the praise of being big and mighty, remains bereft of flowers and fruits. "}}},{"verse_id":209871,"page_no":null,"line_no":531,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਚਾਖਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤ ਬਕਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੫॥","translit_en":"moh gur saagar mai chaakhio nahee prem ras tirakhaava(n)t chaatrik jugat bakabaanee hai ||525||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite living near the vast ocean like True Guru, I, the unfortunate one, had not tasted the divine elixir obtained by His loving worship. I have only been making noise of my thirst like a rain-bird. I have only indulged in empty arguments and contemplations.  (525)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41557,"next":41559}}
files.shabads/83/41559.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41559,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209872","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209872,"last_verse_id":209875,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209872,"page_no":null,"line_no":532,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਗਾਜਿ ਮਾਰਤ ਮਨੁਖ ਸਿਰਿ ਡਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਛਾਰ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਤ ਅਰੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gajaraaj gaaj maarat manukh sir ddaarat hai chhaar taeh kahat arog jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a giant elephant trumpets, kill people and throws dust on himself, he is known to be healthy (Those who are intoxicated in their arrogance, cruel or who kick up dust are good according to the world). "}}},{"verse_id":209873,"page_no":null,"line_no":532,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮੈ ਕਹਤ ਬਨਾਇ ਬਾਤੈ ਪੇਖ ਸੁਨ ਕਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਰਾਜ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"sooaa jiau pi(n)jar mai kahat banai baatai pekh sun kahai taeh raaj gireh jog jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a parrot in a cage listens to others conversation and copies them. Those who listen and see him, opine that he is very wise and knowledgeable. He is fit to live in king's palace. (To the world, he who talks much is a wise person). "}}},{"verse_id":209874,"page_no":null,"line_no":532,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੋਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"taise sukh sa(n)pat maiaa madhon paap karai taeh kahai sukheeaa ramat ras bhog jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a person enjoys and engrosses himself in countless materialistic pleasures and commits sins. People call him happy and comfortable. (In the eyes of the world, material things are means of happiness and comfort). "}}},{"verse_id":209875,"page_no":null,"line_no":532,"gurmukhi":"ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਅਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟੋ ਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਲੋਗ ਜੀ ॥੫੨੬॥","translit_en":"jatee satee aau sa(n)tokhee saadhan kee ni(n)dhaa karai ulaTo iee giaan dhiaan hai agiaan log jee ||526||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ignorant world's perception is contrary (to the truth of Guru's words). The world slanders those who are disciplined, truthful, contented and supreme.  (526)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41558,"next":41560}}
files.shabads/83/41560.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41560,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209876","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":209876,"last_verse_id":209876,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209876,"page_no":null,"line_no":533,"gurmukhi":"ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥ ਜਉ ਗਰਬੈ ਬਹੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਿਤੰਤਰਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿੰਧ ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"savaiyaa || jau garabai bahu boo(n)dh chita(n)tar sanamukh si(n)dh sobh nahee paavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Savaiya   If a drop of water feels proud of its greatness in its mind, it does not earn a good name or praise before the vast ocean. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41559,"next":41561}}
files.shabads/83/41561.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41561,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209877","verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":209877,"last_verse_id":209879,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209877,"page_no":null,"line_no":534,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਬਹੁ ਉਡੈ ਖਗ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਲ ਪੇਖ ਅਕਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਕਚਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau bahu uddai khag dhaar mahaa bal pekh akaas ridhai sukachaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a bird flies high and far putting much effort, he is sure to feel ashamed of its effort seeing the infinitely vast expanse of the sky. "}}},{"verse_id":209878,"page_no":null,"line_no":534,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਬਿਲੋਕਤ ਗੂਲਰ ਜੰਤ ਉਡੰਤ ਲਜਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jiau brahama(n)dd pracha(n)dd bilokat goolar ja(n)t udda(n)t lajaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the fruit of a kind of fig tree (cotton boll in full bloom) sees the vast expense of the Universe after coming out of the fruit, he feels shy of his insignificant existence. "}}},{"verse_id":209879,"page_no":null,"line_no":534,"gurmukhi":"ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੋ ਪਹਿ ਬੋਲਨ ਕਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫੨੭॥","translit_en":"too(n) karataa ham ke'ee tihaare jee to peh bolan kiau ban aavai ||527||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly O True Guru, You are an epitome of the all doing Lord and we are insignificant creation.   How can we speak before you?    (527)                                                "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41560,"next":41562}}
files.shabads/83/41562.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41562,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209880","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209880,"last_verse_id":209883,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209880,"page_no":null,"line_no":535,"gurmukhi":"ਤੋਸੋ ਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਨ ਮੋਸਰਿ ਤੋਸੋ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ਨ ਮੋਸੋ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"toso na naath anaath na mosar toso na dhaanee na moso bhikhaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O  True Guru! there is no Master like You. "}}},{"verse_id":209881,"page_no":null,"line_no":535,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਸੋ ਨ ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਨ ਤੋਸਰਿ ਮੋਸੋ ਅਗਯਾਨਿ ਨ ਤੋਸੋ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"moso na dheen dhayaal na tosar moso agayaan na toso bichaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one is as miserable as I am but none is as clement as You. "}}},{"verse_id":209882,"page_no":null,"line_no":535,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਸੋ ਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਤੋਸਰਿ ਮੋਸੋ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਨ ਤੋਸੋ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"moso na patit na paavan tosar moso bikaaree na toso upakaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is no one who has fallen so low in his deeds and actions as I am. "}}},{"verse_id":209883,"page_no":null,"line_no":535,"gurmukhi":"ਮੇਰੇ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਾਤ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਓਟ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੫੨੮॥","translit_en":"mere hai avagun too gun saagar jaat rasaatal oT tihaaree ||528||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am full of faults and demerits but You are an ocean of virtues. files.shabads/83/41563.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41563,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209884","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209884,"last_verse_id":209887,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209884,"page_no":null,"line_no":536,"gurmukhi":"ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਗਤਿ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aulaT pavan man meen kee chapal gat dhasam dhuaar paar agam nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabit  - By practicing Naam Simran and breathing exercises, the fish-like sharp and wind-like fast blowing mind acquires a stable place beyond the tenth door which is inaccessible. "}}},{"verse_id":209885,"page_no":null,"line_no":536,"gurmukhi":"ਤਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਵਨ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਅਕਾਸ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"teh na paavak pavan jal pirathamee akaas naeh sas soor utapat na binaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"At that place neither the effect of five elements like air, fire etc., nor of Sun or Moon or even of creation is experienced. "}}},{"verse_id":209886,"page_no":null,"line_no":536,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naeh parakirat birat pi(n)dd praan giaan sabadh surat naeh dhirasaT na pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It experiences no effect of any material desires nor of body or life sustaining elements. It is unaware of words and sounds. No effect of any light or vision exists there. "}}},{"verse_id":209887,"page_no":null,"line_no":536,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਨਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਪਰੈ ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੯॥","translit_en":"savaiaamee naa sevak unamaan anahadh parai niraala(n)b su(n)n mai na bisam bisavaiaas hai ||529||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Beyond that divine state and in the inaccessible region, there is no master and no follower. In that non-existent realm of inactivity and hibernation, one is never in any form of wondrous state (wondrous or unusual events do not take place any more). "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41562,"next":41564}}
files.shabads/83/41564.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41564,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209888","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209888,"last_verse_id":209891,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209888,"page_no":null,"line_no":537,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਦਿ ਰਹਤ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਮਰਮੁ ਕਿਧਉ ਕਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ahinis madh rahat bhaa(n)jan bikhai jaanat na maram kidhau kavan prakaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wine remains in a bottle day and night but that bottle/ pot does not know its characteristics. "}}},{"verse_id":209889,"page_no":null,"line_no":537,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇਲੀ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਬਾਂਟਿ ਦੀਜੀਅਤ ਸਭਾ ਪਾਵਤ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise belee bhar bhar baa(n)T dheejeeat sabhaa paavat na bhedh kachh bidh na beechaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in a party, wine is distributed in cups, but that cup does not know its (wine) secret nor thinks about it. "}}},{"verse_id":209890,"page_no":null,"line_no":537,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਬੇਚਤ ਕਲਾਲ ਬੈਠੋ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhinaprat madh bechat kalaal baiTho mahimaa na jaaniee dharab hitakaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wine merchant sells wine all the time during the day but his greed of wealth does not know the significance of its intoxication. "}}},{"verse_id":209891,"page_no":null,"line_no":537,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਦੁ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur sabadh ko likh paR gaavat hai biralo a(n)mirat ras padh hitakaaree hai ||530||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly many write Gur Shabad and Gurbani, sing and read it but. a rare person among them harbours loving desire of relishing and acquiring the divine elixir from it.  (530)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41563,"next":41565}}
files.shabads/83/41565.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41565,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209892","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209892,"last_verse_id":209895,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209892,"page_no":null,"line_no":538,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਨੁ ਤਿਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਾਈਅਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਭਸਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tin tin mel jaise chhaan chhaieeat pun agan pragaas taas bhasam karat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a hut is built putting each straw and twig together but fire raises it to the ground in no time. "}}},{"verse_id":209893,"page_no":null,"line_no":538,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਧ ਕੇ ਕਿਨਾਰੇ ਬਾਲੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰਚਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਉਮਗਿ ਭਏ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"si(n)dh ke kinaare baaloo gireh baalak rachat jaise lahar umag bhe dheer na dharat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as children make houses of sand on the sea-shore, but with one wave of water all of them collapse and merge with the sand around. "}}},{"verse_id":209894,"page_no":null,"line_no":538,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਏਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਗਾਜੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ban bikhai mil baiThat anek mirag ek miragaraaj gaaje rahio na parat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many animals like deer etc. sit together but with one roar of the lion who comes there, all of them run away, "}}},{"verse_id":209895,"page_no":null,"line_no":538,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਗਲ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੧॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT sabadh ar surat dhiaan giaan pragaTe pooran prem sagal rahat hai ||531||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly focusing of eyesight at a point, reciting an incantation repeatedly and absorbing the mind in many ways of meditation and contemplations and many other forms of spiritual practices collapse like mud walls with the emergence of complete love of the True Guru.  (531)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41564,"next":41566}}
files.shabads/83/41566.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41566,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209896","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209896,"last_verse_id":209899,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209896,"page_no":null,"line_no":539,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਜੀਅਤ ਬਬੂਰ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਧਿ ਕਾਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan kee baar jaise dheejeeat baboor dhraoom ka(n)chan sa(n)paT madh kaach geh raakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a plant of acacia is protected with the twigs of sandalwood or a glass crystal is stored in a gold box for safety. "}}},{"verse_id":209897,"page_no":null,"line_no":539,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਗਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਤਿ ਭਵਨੁ ਮੈ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਭਲਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ha(n)s paas baiTh bais garab karai mirag pat bhavan mai ja(n)buk bhalaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"just as a filth-eating crow expresses pride of his beauty and life-style or a jackal expresses his desire to go into the lion's den, "}}},{"verse_id":209898,"page_no":null,"line_no":539,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਰਧਬ ਗਜ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕੋ ਚੋਰ ਡਾਂਡੇ ਦੂਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise garadhab gaj prat upahaas karai chakravai ko chor ddaa(n)dde dhoodh madh maakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a donkey makes fun of an elephant and an emperor be punished by a thief; wine expresses its anger on milk. "}}},{"verse_id":209899,"page_no":null,"line_no":539,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਨ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟੀਐ ਚਾਲ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥੫੩੨॥","translit_en":"saadhan dhurai kai asaadh aparaadh karai ulaTeeaai chaal kaleekaal bhram bhaakheeaai ||532||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These are all the contrary moves of the dark age (Kalyug). files.shabads/83/41567.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41567,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209900","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209900,"last_verse_id":209903,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209900,"page_no":null,"line_no":540,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਐ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੀਐ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin lochan bilokeeaai na roop ra(n)g sravan bihoon raag naadh na suneejeeaai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as without eyes a face cannot be seen and without ears, no musical note can be heard. "}}},{"verse_id":209901,"page_no":null,"line_no":540,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਉਚਰੈ ਬਚਨ ਅਰ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਬਿਹੂੰਨ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨ ਲੀਜੀਐ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin jihabaa na ucharai bachan ar naasikaa bihoo(n)n baas baasanaa na leejeeaai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as without tongue, no word can be spoken and without nose no fragrance can be smelled. files.shabads/83/41568.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41568,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209904","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209904,"last_verse_id":209907,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209904,"page_no":null,"line_no":541,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਫਲ ਸੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਫਲ ਅਦਿਭੁਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise fal sai birakh birakh sai hot fal adhibhut gat kachh kahan na aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a seed of the fruit gives a tree and the tree yields the same fruit; this strange phenomena hardly comes into any say or conversation, "}}},{"verse_id":209905,"page_no":null,"line_no":541,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਵਨ ਮੈ ਬਾਵਨ ਹੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baas baavan mai baavan hai baas bikhai bisam charitr kouoo maram na paavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fragrance resides in sandalwood and sandalwood lives in its fragrance, none can know the deep and wonderful secret of this phenomena, "}}},{"verse_id":209906,"page_no":null,"line_no":541,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਸਟਿ ਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਾਸਟਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਹੈ ਕਉਤਕ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaasaT mai agan agan mai kaasaT hai at asacharaj hai kautak kahaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wood houses fire and fire has wood burning in it; it is a marvellous phenomena. "}}},{"verse_id":209907,"page_no":null,"line_no":541,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੫੩੪॥","translit_en":"satigur mai sabadh sabadh mai satigur hai niragun giaan dhiaan samajhaavai jee ||534||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the name of the Lord resides in True Guru and True Guru resides in His (Lord) name. He alone can understand this mystery of the Absolute God who has obtained knowledge from True Guru and who meditates on Him.  (534)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41567,"next":41569}}
files.shabads/83/41569.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41569,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209908","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209908,"last_verse_id":209911,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209908,"page_no":null,"line_no":542,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਿਲਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੀਅਤਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise til baas baas leejeeat kusam sai taa(n) te hot hai fulel jatan kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fragrance is taken from flowers and then it is put in sesame that with some effort yields scented oil. "}}},{"verse_id":209909,"page_no":null,"line_no":542,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਉਟਾਇ ਦੂਧ ਜਾਵਨ ਜਮਾਇ ਮਥਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਤਿ ਘ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau aauTai dhoodh jaavan jamai math sa(n)jam sahat ghirat pragaT kai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as milk is boiled, converted to curd and then churned yields butter, with some more effort even clarified butter (Ghee) is obtained. "}}},{"verse_id":209910,"page_no":null,"line_no":542,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਆ ਖੋਦ ਕੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਧਸਾਇ ਕੌਰੀ ਲਾਜੁ ਕੈ ਬਹਾਇ ਡੋਲਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kooaa khodh kai basudhaa dhasai kauaree laaj kai bahai ddol kaadd jal aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as earth is excavated to dig a well and thereafter (on appearance of water) the side walls of the well are lined, then water is pulled out with the help of rope and bucket. "}}},{"verse_id":209911,"page_no":null,"line_no":542,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਤੈਸੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੫੩੫॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes taise bhaavanee bhagat bhai ghaT ghaT pooran braham pahichaaneeaai ||535||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if the sermon of the True Guru is practiced diligently, with love and devotion, with every breath, the Lord-God becomes conspicuously permeated in every living being.  (535)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41568,"next":41570}}
files.shabads/83/41570.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41570,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209912","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209912,"last_verse_id":209915,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209912,"page_no":null,"line_no":543,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋ ਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau saritaa jal kaasaTeh na borat karat chit laaj apano iee pratipaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the water of streams and rivers does not sink the wood, it (water) has the shame of the fact that it has irrigated and brought the wood up; "}}},{"verse_id":209913,"page_no":null,"line_no":543,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨਪਨ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਉਰਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau karat sut anik iaanapan tuoo na jananee avagun uradhaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son commits many mistakes but his mother who has given him birth never recounts them (she still keeps loving him). "}}},{"verse_id":209914,"page_no":null,"line_no":543,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਨ ਸੂਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau saran soor pooran pratagiaa raakhai lakh aparaadh ke'ee maar na biddaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a culprit who may have myriad vices is not killed by a brave warrior in whose refuge he may have come, the warrior protects him and thus fulfils his virtuous traits. "}}},{"verse_id":209915,"page_no":null,"line_no":543,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee param gur paaras paras gat sikhan ko kirat karam kachhoo na beechaario hai ||536||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the supreme benevolent True Guru does not dwell on any of the faults of His Sikhs. He is like touch of philosopher-stone (True Guru removes dross of the Sikhs in His refuge and makes them gold-like precious and pure).   (536)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41569,"next":41571}}
files.shabads/83/41571.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41571,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209916","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209916,"last_verse_id":209919,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209916,"page_no":null,"line_no":544,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਧੋਏ ਬਿਨ ਅੰਬਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਨ ਤੇਲ ਮੇਲੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੇਸ ਹੂੰ ਭਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal dhoe bin a(n)bar maleen hot bin tel mele taise kes hoo(n) bhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cloth not washed with water remains dirty; and the hair remains disheveled and entangled without application of oil; "}}},{"verse_id":209917,"page_no":null,"line_no":544,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin maa(n)je dharapan jot heen hot barakhaa bihoon jaise khet mai na dhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a glass not cleaned cannot let the light come through and just as no crop grows in a field without rain, "}}},{"verse_id":209918,"page_no":null,"line_no":544,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਭਵਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਲੋਣ ਘ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin dheepak bhavan a(n)dhakaar hot lon ghirat bin jaise bhojan samaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a house remains in darkness without a lamp and just as food tastes insipid without salt and ghee, "}}},{"verse_id":209919,"page_no":null,"line_no":544,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ੍ਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੭॥","translit_en":"taise bin saadh sa(n)git janam maran dhukh miTat na bhram bin gur giaan hai ||537||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly without the company of saintly souls and devotees of the True Guru, the distress of repeated births and death cannot be wiped out. Nor can worldly fears and suspicions be destroyed without practicing on the sermon of the True Guru.  (537)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41570,"next":41572}}
files.shabads/83/41572.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41572,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209920","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209920,"last_verse_id":209923,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209920,"page_no":null,"line_no":545,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਂਝ ਬੈਠੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਾਤ ਨ ਕਨਿਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maa(n)jh baiThe bin bohithaa na paar parai paaras parasai bin dhaat na kanik hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as without embarking a ship, ocean cannot be crossed and without the touch of philosopher-stone, iron, copper or other metals cannot be turned into gold. "}}},{"verse_id":209921,"page_no":null,"line_no":545,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਆਨ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin ga(n)gaa na paavan aan jal hai naar na bhataar bin sutan anik hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as no water is considered sacred other than the water of .river Ganges, and no child can be born without conjugal union of husband and wife. "}}},{"verse_id":209922,"page_no":null,"line_no":545,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਏ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਧਾਰਾ ਸੀਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bin beej boe nipajai na dhaan dhaaraa seep savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh bin mukataa na maanik hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as without sowing seeds, no crop can grow and no pearl can be formed in an oyster unless the swati drop of rain falls on it. "}}},{"verse_id":209923,"page_no":null,"line_no":545,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨ ਨ ਜਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੫੩੮॥","translit_en":"taise hee charan saran gur bheTe bin janam maran meT jan na jan kahai ||538||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly without taking refuge and consecration of True Guru, there is no other method or force that can end the repeated cycle of birth and death. One who is without the divine word of the Guru cannot be called a human being.  (538)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41571,"next":41573}}
files.shabads/83/41573.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41573,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209924","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209924,"last_verse_id":209927,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209924,"page_no":null,"line_no":546,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਕਰਉ ਨ ਅਹਾਰ ਮਾਸ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਦਉਰੇ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kahai ma(n)jaar karau na ahaar maas moosaa dhekh paachhai dhaure dheer na dharat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tom cat says that he has stopped eating meat but as soon as he sees a mouse runs after him (cannot control his desire to eat him up). "}}},{"verse_id":209925,"page_no":null,"line_no":546,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਰੀਸ ਕੈ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kuooaa rees kai maraal sabhaa jai baiThe chhaadd mukataahal dhuraga(n)dh simarat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crow goes and sit among swans but leaving aside pearls which is the food of swans, he always desires to eat filth and dross. "}}},{"verse_id":209926,"page_no":null,"line_no":546,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਿਆਰ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mon geh siaar karat anek jatan sunat siaar bhaakhiaa rahio na parat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a jackal may try myriad times to keep quiet but listening to other jackals just by the force of habit, cannot help howling. "}}},{"verse_id":209927,"page_no":null,"line_no":546,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੋ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਨ ਕਹਤ ਕੈ ਛਾਡਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਟੇਵ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੯॥","translit_en":"taiso par tan par dhan dhookhanaa tiradhokh man kahat kai chhaaddio chaahai Tev na Tarat hai ||539||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the three vices of ogling at other's wife, keeping an eye on other's wealth and slander are inhabiting in my mind like a chronic disease. Even if someone tells me to leave them, this bad habit cannot go away. (539)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41572,"next":41574}}
files.shabads/83/41574.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41574,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209928","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":209928,"last_verse_id":209928,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209928,"page_no":null,"line_no":547,"gurmukhi":"ਝੋਲਨਾ॥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਬਖਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਗਵਤ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਕਰਨ ਗੀਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"jholanaa|| si(n)mirat puraan koTaan bakhaan bahu bhaagavat bedh biaakaran geetaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Jholana  - If all the 31 Simrities, 18 Purans, Bhagvad Geeta, four Vedas and their grammar become millions and speak, "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41573,"next":41575}}
files.shabads/83/41575.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41575,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209929","verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":209929,"last_verse_id":209931,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209929,"page_no":null,"line_no":548,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਸ ਮਰਜੇਸ ਅਖਲੇਸ ਸੁਰ ਮਹੇਸ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਅਤੀਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"ses marajes akhales sur mahes mun jagat ar bhagat sur nar ateetaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If Shesh Nag of thousands of tongues, Dharamraj, Kuber and other gods, Shiva and hermits and saints of the whole world, noble men get together in millions and speak; "}}},{"verse_id":209930,"page_no":null,"line_no":548,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਕਤਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦਿ ਦਿਜ ਸੁਰਮਤਿ ਨੀਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"giaan ar dhiaan unamaan unaman ukat raag naadh dhij suramat neetaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If seekers of many type of knowledge, contemplations and wise men who discuss various subjects, people of higher spiritual state, who can speak about various skills, all the Ragas and their seven notes, knowledgeable scholars, goddess Saraswati and many statesmen become millions and then say- "}}},{"verse_id":209931,"page_no":null,"line_no":548,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਧ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਅਖਰ ਮੇਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੫੪੦॥","translit_en":"aradh lag maatr gur sabadh akhar mek agam at agam agaadh meetaa ||540||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! all the above will fall woefully short of saying the praise of a syllable of the True Guru's blessed Naam Gur Mantar. The significance of Guru's words is beyond the extent of all knowledge.  (540)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41574,"next":41576}}
files.shabads/83/41576.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41576,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209932","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":209932,"last_verse_id":209932,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209932,"page_no":null,"line_no":549,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬਿਤ ॥ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਉ ਮਨ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"kabit || dharasan dhekhio dhekhio sakal sa(n)saar kahai kavan dhirasaT sau man dharas samaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The whole world claims to have seen. But what is that marvellous sight which engrosses the mind in the looks of the Guru? "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41575,"next":41577}}
