files.shabads/83/41577.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41577,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209933","verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":209933,"last_verse_id":209935,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209933,"page_no":null,"line_no":550,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਕਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes sunio sunio sabh kouoo kahai kavan surat sun anat na dhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everyone claims to have listened to the Guru's sermon. But what is that unique voice, hearing which the mind does not wander away? "}}},{"verse_id":209934,"page_no":null,"line_no":550,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਜਪਤ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਹ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jai jaikaar japat jagat gur ma(n)tr jeeh kavan jugat jotee jot liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The whole world praises the Guru's incantations and recite it too. But what is that mean which will attach the mind in the radiant Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209935,"page_no":null,"line_no":550,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੫੪੧॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT surat giaan dhiaan saraba(n)g heen patit paavan gur mooR samajhaieeaai ||541||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fool who is devoid of such limbs and appendages that provide him with knowledge of the True Guru and contemplation, True Guru-the maker of pious people out of sinners, bless them with such divine knowledge through Naam Simran.  (541)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41576,"next":41578}}
files.shabads/83/41578.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41578,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209936","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209936,"last_verse_id":209939,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209936,"page_no":null,"line_no":551,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੀਠਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਜੀਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਦਿ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khaa(n)dd khaa(n)dd kahai mukh nahee meeThaa hoi jab lag jeebh savaiaadh khaa(n)dd nahee khaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as by saying sugar, sugar, one cannot feel sweet taste of sugar in the mouth. Unless sugar is placed on the tongue, it cannot feel its taste. "}}},{"verse_id":209937,"page_no":null,"line_no":551,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਤ ਅੰਧੇਰੀ ਮੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੀਪਕ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਮਰ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਨ ਜਰਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raat a(n)dheree mai dheepak dheepak kahai timar na jaiee jab lag na jaraieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In a dark night, saying lamp, lamp does not dispel darkness unless lamp is lit. "}}},{"verse_id":209938,"page_no":null,"line_no":551,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਯਾਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਕਹੈ ਗਯਾਨ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਕਛੁ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਗੁਰ ਗਯਾਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gayaan gayaan kahai gayaan hoo(n) na hot kachh jab lag gur gayaan a(n)tar na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just by saying Gian (Knowledge) again and again, knowledge cannot be obtained. It can only be acquired by lodging His name in the heart. "}}},{"verse_id":209939,"page_no":null,"line_no":551,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਯਾਨ ਕਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਧਯਾਨ ਹੰੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੫੪੨॥","translit_en":"taise gur dhayaan kahai gur dhayaan ha(n)oo na paavat jab lag gur dharas jai na samaieeaai ||542||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly just repeatedly asking for a glimpse of True Guru, one cannot acquire contemplation of the True Guru. This is possible only when one engrosses oneself up to the soul in the ardent desire of a glimpse of the True Guru.  (542)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41577,"next":41579}}
files.shabads/83/41579.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41579,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209940","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209940,"last_verse_id":209943,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209940,"page_no":null,"line_no":552,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਬਿਆਸ ਨੇਿਤ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਸੁਕ ਸੇਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"si(n)mirat puraan bedh saasatr bira(n)ch biaas nit net net suk sekh jas gaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the 31 Simritis, 18 Puranas, 4 Vedas, 6 Shastras, Brahma the scholar of Vedas, sage Vyas, supreme scholar Sukdev and Shesh Nag of thousand tongues sing the praises of the Lord but have not been able to fathom Him. They address Him as infinite, infinite ... "}}},{"verse_id":209941,"page_no":null,"line_no":552,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਉ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿਕ ਰਿਖੀਸੁਰਾਦਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"siau sanakaadh naaradhaadhik rikheesuraadh sur nar naath jog dhiaan mai na aaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shiv, four sons of Brahma, Narad and other sages, gods, men of substance, nine heads of Jogis could not perceive God in their contemplation and meditation. "}}},{"verse_id":209942,"page_no":null,"line_no":552,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਵਨ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gir tar teerath gavan pu(n)n dhaan brat hom jag bhog nieebedh kai na paio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They could not realise that infinite Lord even by roaming in jungles, mountains and places of pilgrimage, making charity, fasting, doing hom-yag and offering food and other delicacies to the gods. "}}},{"verse_id":209943,"page_no":null,"line_no":552,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਧਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੪੩॥","translit_en":"as vadd bhaag maiaa madh gursikhan kau pooran braham gur roop hui dhikhaio hai ||543||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such fortunate and enjoying the worldly maya are the Sikhs of the Guru who are seeing the inaccessible Lord in the manifested state of a True Guru.  (543)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41578,"next":41580}}
files.shabads/83/41580.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41580,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209944","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209944,"last_verse_id":209947,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209944,"page_no":null,"line_no":553,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਰ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੂਝਤ ਜਲ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਉ ਮੈ ਜਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"baahar kee agan boojhat jal saritaa kai naau mai jau agan laagai kaise kai bujhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fire burning outside the stream can be extinguished with the water of the stream, but if the boat in the river catches fire, how can that be extinguished? "}}},{"verse_id":209945,"page_no":null,"line_no":553,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਰ ਸੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਓਟ ਲੀਜੀਅਤ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਗੜ ਮੈ ਜਉ ਲੂਟਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਹੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"baahar sai bhaag oT leejeeat koT gaR gaR mai jau looT leejai kaho kat jaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Escaping from the attack of a robber while out in the open, one can run and take shelter in a fort or such other place but when someone robs in the fort, what can be done then? "}}},{"verse_id":209946,"page_no":null,"line_no":553,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰਨ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜਾਇ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੈ ਨਰਿੰਦ ਮਾਰੈ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਚਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"choran kai traas jai saran gahai nari(n)dh maarai maheepat jeeau kaise kai bachaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If for fear of thieves one takes refuge with a ruler and if the ruler starts punishing, then what can be done ? "}}},{"verse_id":209947,"page_no":null,"line_no":553,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਡਰ ਡਰਪਤ ਹਾਰ ਗੁਰਦੁਅਰੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਤਹਾ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਹਾ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ॥੫੪੪॥","translit_en":"maiaa ddar ddarapat haar gurdhuarai jaavai tahaa jau maiaa biaapai kahaa Thaharaieeaai ||544||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fearing the dragon-net of worldly compulsions, if one goes to the door of Guru, and if maya overpowers on him there too, then there is no escape. (544) "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41579,"next":41581}}
files.shabads/83/41581.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41581,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209948","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209948,"last_verse_id":209951,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209948,"page_no":null,"line_no":554,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਪ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੈ ਖਰਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਹਾ ਜਉ ਸਰਪ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ਕਹੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sarap kai traas saran gahai kharapat jai tahaa jau sarap grasai kaho kaise jeejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If for the fear of snake, one takes shelter of Garud and yet the snake comes and bite there, how can one survive then? "}}},{"verse_id":209949,"page_no":null,"line_no":554,"gurmukhi":"ਜੰਬੁਕ ਸੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਉ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਹਰੈ ਕਹੋ ਕਹਾਂ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ja(n)buk sai bhaag miragaraaj kee saran gahai tahaa(n) jau ja(n)buk harai kaho kahaa(n) keejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For the fear of a Jackal, if one takes refuge of a lion what can be done if jackal comes and kills there ? "}}},{"verse_id":209950,"page_no":null,"line_no":554,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮੇਰ ਸਿੰਧ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਉ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhaaridhr kai chaa(n)pai jai saran samer si(n)dh tahaa(n) jau dhaaridhr dhahai kaeh dhos dheejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Distressed by poverty if someone goes and takes refuge in a gold mine, Sumer mountain or ocean-the treasure-house of diamonds; and if he is still distressed by poverty, then who should be blamed? "}}},{"verse_id":209951,"page_no":null,"line_no":554,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਗਹੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਉਨ ਓਟ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥੫੪੫॥","translit_en":"karam bharam kai saran gurdhev gahai tahaa(n) na miTai karam kaun oT leejeeaai ||545||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In order to liberate oneself from the wandering and effect of the deeds performed, one takes the support of True Guru. And if even then the cycle of deeds and actions do not end, then whose refuge should be sought.  (545)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41580,"next":41582}}
files.shabads/83/41582.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41582,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209952","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209952,"last_verse_id":209955,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209952,"page_no":null,"line_no":555,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੋ ਸਕਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise to sakal nidh pooran samu(n)dhr bikhai ha(n)s marajeevaa nihachai prasaadh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as treasures of pearls and diamonds are found in the sea, but only a seasoned evaluator of these precious stones who can dive deep into the bottom of sea can surely enjoy the pleasure of picking them up from there. "}}},{"verse_id":209953,"page_no":null,"line_no":555,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਧ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਵਿਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise parabat heeraa maanik paaras sidh khanavaaraa khan jag vikhe pragaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as mountains have diamonds, rubies and philosopher stones those can purify metals into gold, but only an adept excavator can bring them out before the world. "}}},{"verse_id":209954,"page_no":null,"line_no":555,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਮਲਿਆਗਰ ਸੌਧਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੋਧ ਕੈ ਸੁਬਾਸੀ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਿਹਸਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ban bikhai maliaagar sauadhaa kapoor sodh kai subaasee subaas bihasaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a jungle has many aromatic trees like sandalwood, camphor etc., but only a perfumery expert can bring their fragrance out. "}}},{"verse_id":209955,"page_no":null,"line_no":555,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਕਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹੈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਪਜਾਵਈ ॥੫੪੬॥","translit_en":"taise gurbaanee bikhai sakal padhaarath hai joiee joiee khojai soiee soiee nipajaaviee ||546||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly Gurbani has all the precious items but whosoever would search and research them, he would be rewarded with those items that he so fondly desires.  (546)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41581,"next":41583}}
files.shabads/83/41583.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41583,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209956","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209956,"last_verse_id":209959,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209956,"page_no":null,"line_no":556,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਦੀਰਘ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਲਘੁ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਭਗਨੀ ਸੁਤਾ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"par triaa dheeragh samaan lagh jaavadhek jananee bhaganee sutaa roop kai nihaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So far as other women are concerned, regard elder to you as mother; one of your age as sister and younger than yourself as your daughter. "}}},{"verse_id":209957,"page_no":null,"line_no":556,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰ ਦਰਬਾਸਹਿ ਗਊ ਮਾਸ ਤੁਲਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਪਰਸੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"par dharabaaseh guoo maas tul jaan ridhai keejai na saparas aparas sidhaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Let the desire for other's wealth be treated like beef that is not to be touched, and remain away from it. "}}},{"verse_id":209958,"page_no":null,"line_no":556,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ghaT ghaT pooran braham jot ot pot avagun gun kaahoo ko na beechaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Consider the radiance of complete Lord residing in every body like warp and weft and dwell not on anybody's merits and demerits. "}}},{"verse_id":209959,"page_no":null,"line_no":556,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਮਨ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੫੪੭॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes man dhaavat baraj par dhan par tan par dhookhanaa nivaareeaai ||547||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of True Guru's sermon, keep the wandering of the mind in ten directions under control and abstain it from looking at other's woman, other's wealth and slander.  (547)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41582,"next":41584}}
files.shabads/83/41584.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41584,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209960","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209960,"last_verse_id":209963,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209960,"page_no":null,"line_no":557,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਖਗ ਜਾਤ ਉਡਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise praat samai khag jaat udd birakh sai bahur aai baiThat birakh hee mai aai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as birds flyaway from the tree in the morning and return to the tree in the evening, "}}},{"verse_id":209961,"page_no":null,"line_no":557,"gurmukhi":"ਚੀਟੀ ਚੀਟਾ ਬਿਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਧਰ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਪੈਸਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਲ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"cheeTee cheeTaa bil sai nikas dhar gavan kai bahurio paisat jaise bil hee mai jai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as ants and insects come out of their burrows and walk about on the ground and return back to the burrow after their wandering, "}}},{"verse_id":209962,"page_no":null,"line_no":557,"gurmukhi":"ਲਰ ਕੈ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਰੂਠ ਜਾਤ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਹਠ ਆਵੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"lar kai larikaa rooTh jaat taat maat san bhookh laagai tiaagai haTh aavai pachhutai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son leaves the house after an argument with his parents, and when experiences hunger gives up his obduracy and returns repentantly, "}}},{"verse_id":209963,"page_no":null,"line_no":557,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਆਸਰੋ ਤਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਕੋ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੫੪੮॥","translit_en":"taise gireh tiaag bhaag jaat udhaas baas aasaro takat pun girahasat ko dhai kai ||548||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a man forsakes life of a householder and goes to the jungle for a hermit's life. But unable to achieve spiritual happiness and after wandering here and there returns to his family (One can realise God as a householder by keeping oneself unsullied of maya).  (548)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41583,"next":41585}}
files.shabads/83/41585.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41585,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209964","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209964,"last_verse_id":209967,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209964,"page_no":null,"line_no":558,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਦਸ਼ਾ ਕੇ ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ਬਰਖਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਦਸ਼ਾ ਕੋ ਪਵਨ ਬਾਦਰ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaahoo dhashaa ke pavan gavan kai barakhaa hai kaahoo dhashaa ko pavan baadhar bilaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wind blowing from a particular direction causes rain while another direction blows the clouds away. "}}},{"verse_id":209965,"page_no":null,"line_no":558,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਰਹਤ ਅਰੋਗ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaahoo jal paan ke'ee rahat arog dhehee kaahoo jal paan biaapai birathaa bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as drinking some water keeps the body healthy while some other water causes one to fall sick. It troubles the patient no end. "}}},{"verse_id":209966,"page_no":null,"line_no":558,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਕ ਸਾਕ ਸਿਧ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਜਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaahoo gireh kee agan paak saak sidh karai kaahoo gireh kee agan bhavan jaraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the fire of a house helps in cooking but the fire raged in another house burns the house to ashes' "}}},{"verse_id":209967,"page_no":null,"line_no":558,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੪੯॥","translit_en":"kaahoo kee sa(n)gat mil jeevan mukat hui kaahoo kee sa(n)gat mil jamapur jaat hai ||549||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly someone's company liberates, while other's company leads one to hell.  (549)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41584,"next":41586}}
files.shabads/83/41586.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41586,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209968","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209968,"last_verse_id":209971,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209968,"page_no":null,"line_no":559,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਮੇਲ ਖੇਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੂੰ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"preetam ke mel khel prem nem kai pata(n)g dheepak pragaas jotee jot hoo(n) samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For meeting the dear True Guru, an obedient disciple plays the game of love and merges his self into the light divine of the True Guru in a manner as is done by a moth who perishes on his beloved flame. "}}},{"verse_id":209969,"page_no":null,"line_no":559,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj sa(n)jog ar bireh biog bikhai jal mil bichhurat meen hui dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The state of a devoted Sikh for meeting with True Guru in order to relish the spiritual ecstasy is like that of a fish in water. And one who is separated from water looks like dying with pangs of separation. "}}},{"verse_id":209970,"page_no":null,"line_no":559,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਚਕਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv thakit chakit hoi sabadh bedhee kura(n)g jugat jataaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a deer engrossed in the musical sound of Ghanda Herha, the mind of a true devotee enjoys the divine bliss engrossed in the word of the Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209971,"page_no":null,"line_no":559,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥੫੫੦॥","translit_en":"mil bichhurat ar sabadh surat liv kapaT saneh sanehee na kahaaviee ||550||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The disciple who is able to engross his mind in the divine word, and yet separates himself from True Guru, his love is false. He cannot be called a true lover.  (550)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41585,"next":41587}}
files.shabads/83/41587.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41587,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209972","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209972,"last_verse_id":209975,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209972,"page_no":null,"line_no":560,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਦੀਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਪਰਚਾ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dheep dhekh hoi na milai pata(n)g parachaa bihoon gursikh na kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a glimpse of the True Guru does not turn a disciple in a state that of a moth who is prepared to sacrifice himself unto his beloved lamp, then he cannot be called a true disciple of the Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209973,"page_no":null,"line_no":560,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਤ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਲਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sunat sabadh dhun hoi na milat mirag sabadh surat heen janam lajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hearing the melodious words of True Guru, if a disciple's state does not become like that of a deer who goes into a trance at the sound of Ghanda Herha, then without lodging of Lord's name in his deep within, he has wasted his precious life. "}}},{"verse_id":209974,"page_no":null,"line_no":560,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਬਿਸਵਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਹਸਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gur charanaamirat kai chaatirak na hoi milai ridhai na bisavaas gur dhaas hui na hasaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For the acquisition of Naam-like elixir from the True Guru if a disciple does not meet the True Guru with complete faith like the rain-bird yearning for the Swati drop, then he has no faith for the True Guru in his mind nor can he be His devoted follower. "}}},{"verse_id":209975,"page_no":null,"line_no":560,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸਿਖ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥੫੫੧॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan ek Tek sikh jal meen hui dhikhaaviee ||551||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devoted disciple of the True Guru engrosses his mind in the divine word, practices it and swims in the loving lap of the True Guru as a fish swims in water merrily and contented.  (551)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41586,"next":41588}}
files.shabads/83/41588.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41588,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209976","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209976,"last_verse_id":209979,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209976,"page_no":null,"line_no":561,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਅਰੁ ਅਧਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੁਰੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"autam madhim ar adham tirabidh jag aapano sua(n)n kaahoo buro tau na laag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as no category of society, high, middle or low class considers their son bad or evil, "}}},{"verse_id":209977,"page_no":null,"line_no":561,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤ ਕਉ ਆਪਨੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabh kouoo banaj karat laabh labhat kau aapano biauhaar bhalo jaan anuraag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as everyone do business in order to earn profit, but they all consider their own profession to be the best and therefore love it, "}}},{"verse_id":209978,"page_no":null,"line_no":561,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਇਸਟੈ ਚਾਹਤ ਸਭੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taise apane apane isaTai chaahat sabhai apane pahire sabh jagat sujaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly everyone respect and love their own deity and in their life-time, are ever ready and conscious of worshipping him, "}}},{"verse_id":209979,"page_no":null,"line_no":561,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਭਏ ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੨॥","translit_en":"sua(n)n samarath bhe banaj bikaane jaanai isaT prataap a(n)t kaal agrabhaag hai ||552||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son grows up to understand the art of trading and acquires proficiency, similarly a devoted disciple learns that the ambrosial name blessed by the True Guru can liberate from the noose of the angles of death at the final hour. (552)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41587,"next":41589}}
files.shabads/83/41589.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41589,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209980","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209980,"last_verse_id":209983,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209980,"page_no":null,"line_no":562,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮੈ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"aapano sua(n)n sabh kaahooaai su(n)dhar laagai safal su(n)dharataa sa(n)saar mai saraaheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To everyone, his/her son looks beautiful. But one whom others praise is certainly beautiful. "}}},{"verse_id":209981,"page_no":null,"line_no":562,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਬੁਰੋ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਭਲੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਾਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"aapano banaj buro laagat na kaahoo ridhai jai jag bhalo kahai soiee tau bisaaheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one dislikes his profession, but one should trade only those commodities which are praised by others. "}}},{"verse_id":209982,"page_no":null,"line_no":562,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਸਭੈ ਉਤਮ ਕਰਮੁ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"aapano karam kulaa dharam karat sabhai utam karam log bedh avagaaheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everyone follows rites and traditions of one's family, but all deeds which are as per scriptures and according to social traditions are considered supreme. "}}},{"verse_id":209983,"page_no":null,"line_no":562,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਹੀਐ ॥੫੫੩॥","translit_en":"gur bin mukat na hoi sab kouoo kahai maiaa mai udhaas raakhai soiee gur chaaheeaai ||553||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everyone says that no salvation can be achieved without a Guru, but one requires such a capable True Guru who can guide a person to salvation through His advice while living a householder's life, in a society and enjoying all material comforts.  (553)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41588,"next":41590}}
files.shabads/83/41590.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41590,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209984","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209984,"last_verse_id":209987,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209984,"page_no":null,"line_no":563,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਦ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੇਖ ਸਿਵਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bedh bira(n)ch bichaar na paavat chakirat sekh sivaadh bhe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Swaiya - Brahma studied and reflected on the Vedas yet could not fathom the beginning and the end of the infinite Lord. Sheshnag, with his thousand tongues and Shiv Ji are falling into ecstatic state singing His paeans and contemplating on His extent. "}}},{"verse_id":209985,"page_no":null,"line_no":563,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਰਾਧਤ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਤ ਨਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jog samaadh araadhat naaradh saaradh sukr sanaat ne hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sage Narad, goddess Saraswati, Shukracharya and Sanatan the sons of Brahma are bowing before Him after contemplating on Him in meditation. "}}},{"verse_id":209986,"page_no":null,"line_no":563,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾਪ ਜਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh anaadh agaadh agochar naam nira(n)jan jaap je hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who is since the beginning of the beginning, is beyond the beginning is spread beyond the comprehension of mind and senses. Such mammonless and blemishless Lord is being meditated upon by all. "}}},{"verse_id":209987,"page_no":null,"line_no":563,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਮੇਵ ਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ॥ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਏ ਭਾਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਏ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੬॥","translit_en":"sree gurdhev sumev su sa(n)gat || pairee pe bhaiee pairee pe hai ||556||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru who is engrossed in such God is absorbed and permeated in the congregation of supreme people. 0 brother! I fall, yes I fall on the holy feet of such a True Guru.  (554)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41589,"next":41591}}
files.shabads/83/41591.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41591,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209988","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209988,"last_verse_id":209991,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209988,"page_no":null,"line_no":564,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਸੀਚਿ ਸੀਚਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਮਧੂ ਆਇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਛਾਰੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise madh maakhee seech seech kai ikatr karai harai madhoo aai taa ke mukh chhaar ddaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as honey bee hops from flower to flower and collects honey, but a honey collector smokes the bees away, and takes the honey. "}}},{"verse_id":209989,"page_no":null,"line_no":564,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਛ ਹੇਤ ਗਊ ਸੰਚਤ ਹੈ ਖੀਰੁ ਤਾਹਿ  ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ਅਹੀਰੁ ਦੁਹਿ ਬਛੁਰੇ ਬਿਡਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bachh het guoo sa(n)chat hai kheer taeh  let hai aheer dhuh bachhure biddaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cow collects milk in her teats for the calf, but a milkman uses the calf to bring down her milk. He ties the calf away, milks the cow and takes it away. "}}},{"verse_id":209990,"page_no":null,"line_no":564,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰ ਖੋਦਿ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਲ ਸਾਜੈ ਮੂਸਾ ਪੈਸਤ ਸਰਪੁ ਧਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhar khodh khodh kar bil saajai moosaa paisat sarap dhai khai taeh maar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a rodent digs up earth to make a burrow but a snake enters the burrow and eats away the rodent. "}}},{"verse_id":209991,"page_no":null,"line_no":564,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਮੂੜ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥੫੫੪॥","translit_en":"taise koT paap kar maiaa jor jor mooR a(n)t kaal chhaadd chalai dhono kar jhaar kai ||554||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly an ignorant and foolish person indulges in umpteen sins, collects wealth and leaves this world empty-handed. (All his earnings and material goods prove worthless ultimately).  (555)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41590,"next":41592}}
files.shabads/83/41592.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41592,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209992","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209992,"last_verse_id":209995,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209992,"page_no":null,"line_no":565,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਫਨੰਗ ਫਨਗ੍ਰ ਭਾਰ ਧਰਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਜਨਾਥ ਕਹੇ ਕਉਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ke anik fana(n)g fanagr bhaar dharan dhaaree taeh birajanaath kahe kaun adhikaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Creator who has placed very heavy Earth on the tip of one of the thousand hoods of Sheshnag, what praise is His if we call him Girdhar because he has lifted a mountain? "}}},{"verse_id":209993,"page_no":null,"line_no":565,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਜਨਾਥ ਕਹੇ ਕਉਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ko ek baavaro bisavainaath naam kahaavai taeh birajanaath kahe kaun adhikaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shiv, a lascivious person created by the Lord who calls himself Vishwanath, if we call that Creator master of Braj Bhumi, then what praise of His it is? (The extent of His creation is limitless). "}}},{"verse_id":209994,"page_no":null,"line_no":565,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਿਕ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦਨ ਕਹੇ ਕਉਨ ਸੋਭਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"anik akaar oa(n)kaar ke birathaare jaeh taeh na(n)dh na(n)dhan kahe kaun sobhataiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who has created countless forms, to call Him son of Nand is no matter of praise for Him. "}}},{"verse_id":209995,"page_no":null,"line_no":565,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਨਤ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਅੰਧ ਮੂੜ ਐਸੇ ਅਰਾਧਬੇ ਤੇ ਮੋਨਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੫॥","translit_en":"jaanat usatat karat ni(n)dhiaa a(n)dh mooR aaise araadhabe te mon sukhadhaiee hai ||555||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ignorant and foolish devotees call it His praise. Infact they are slandering the Lord. It is better to remain silent rather than say such praises.  (556)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41591,"next":41593}}
files.shabads/83/41593.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41593,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209996","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209996,"last_verse_id":209999,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209996,"page_no":null,"line_no":566,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਕੰਚਨੈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸਤ ਸੋਖਿ ਲੇਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਡਾਰੇ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਾਰੋ ਉਡ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau ka(n)chanai paaro parasat sokh let agan mai ddaare pun paaro udd jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as mercury touching gold conceals its real colour but when put in a crucible regains its luster, while the mercury evaporates. "}}},{"verse_id":209997,"page_no":null,"line_no":566,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਲਗਿ ਅੰਬਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੋਤ  ਸਾਬਨ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mal mootr lag a(n)bar maleen hot  saaban salil mil niramal gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as clothes become dirty with filth and dust but when washed with soap and water become clean again. "}}},{"verse_id":209998,"page_no":null,"line_no":566,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਬਿਖ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਗ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਸੁ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise eh grase bikh biaapat sagal a(n)g ma(n)tr kai bikhai bikaar sabh su bilaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as snake-bite spreads poison in the whole body but with recitation of Garur jaap (a Mantra) all ill effects are destroyed. "}}},{"verse_id":209999,"page_no":null,"line_no":566,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਮੋਹਤ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਲ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੭॥","translit_en":"taise maiaa moh kai bimohat magan man gur upadhes maiaa mool murajhaat hai ||557||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly by listening to True Guru's word and meditating on it, all the effects of worldly vices and attachment are eliminated. (All the influence of worldly things (Maya) ends.)  (557)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41592,"next":41594}}
files.shabads/83/41594.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41594,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210000","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210000,"last_verse_id":210003,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210000,"page_no":null,"line_no":567,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਟ ਚਾਕੀ ਕੇ ਨ ਮੂੰਡ ਕੇ ਉਠਾਏ ਜਾਤ ਕਲਾ ਕੀਏ ਲੀਏ ਜਾਤ ਐਂਚਤ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paaT chaakee ke na moo(n)dd ke uThaae jaat kalaa ke'ee le'ee jaat aai(n)chat achi(n)t hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as grinding stone of a water grinding mill cannot be taken away by lifting on head but can be pulled away using some method or machine. "}}},{"verse_id":210001,"page_no":null,"line_no":567,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਜ ਕੇਹਰ ਨ ਬਲ ਕੀਏ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਨੀਅਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਮਤ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gaj kehar na bal ke'ee bas hot jatan kai aaneeat samat samat hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lion and an elephant cannot be controlled by force, but with the use of special methods can be brought under control conveniently. "}}},{"verse_id":210002,"page_no":null,"line_no":567,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦੇਖਤ ਭਯਾਨ ਰੂਪ ਕਿਰਵ ਮੇਂ ਚੜ੍ਹ ਪਾਰ ਉਤਰੈ ਤੁਰਤ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise saritaa prabal dhekhat bhayaan roop kirav me(n) chaRh paar utarai turat hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a flowing river look dangerous but can be crossed in a boat easily and quickly. "}}},{"verse_id":210003,"page_no":null,"line_no":567,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਜਲ ਜਲ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ ॥੫੫੮॥","translit_en":"taise dhukh sukh bahu bikham sa(n)saar bikhai gur upadhes jal jal jai kat hee ||558||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, pain and sufferings are unbearable and leave a person in an unstable state. But with the advice and initiation of a True Guru, all pain and sufferings are washed away and one becomes quiet, calm and composed.  (558)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41593,"next":41595}}
files.shabads/83/41595.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41595,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210004","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210004,"last_verse_id":210007,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210004,"page_no":null,"line_no":568,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਬੈਠਤ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau maraal maal baiThat hai maanasar mukataa amol khai khai bigasaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a flock of swans reaches lake Mansarover and feels pleased eating pearls there "}}},{"verse_id":210005,"page_no":null,"line_no":568,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਸੁਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਹੈਂ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਰਸ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sujan mil baiThat hai(n) paakasaal anik prakaar bi(n)janaadh ras khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as friends get together in a kitchen and enjoy several dainty dishes together, "}}},{"verse_id":210006,"page_no":null,"line_no":568,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੰਛੀ ਖਾਇ ਫਲ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhrum chhaayaa mil baiThat anek pa(n)chhee khai fal madhur bachan kai suhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several birds collect in the shade of a tree and eating its sweet fruits produce melodious sounds, "}}},{"verse_id":210007,"page_no":null,"line_no":568,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਦ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੫੯॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikh mil baiThat dharamasaal sahaj sabadh ras a(n)mirat aghaat hai ||559||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, faithful and obedient disciple get together in a Dharamsala and by contemplating on His elixir-like name feel happy and satisfied.  (559)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41594,"next":41596}}
files.shabads/83/41596.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41596,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210008","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210008,"last_verse_id":210011,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210008,"page_no":null,"line_no":569,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਜਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਚਿਤ ਬਿਮਲ ਅਨੰਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise banitaa bachitr abharan si(n)gaar saj bheTat bhataar chit bimal ana(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife embellished with many form of ornaments feel happy meeting her husband with all the love in her heart, "}}},{"verse_id":210009,"page_no":null,"line_no":569,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰੁਵਰ ਪਰਿਫੁਲਤ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮੁਦਤ ਮਗਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise saruvar parifulat kamal dhal madhukar mudhat magan makara(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bumble bee feels satiated drinking the elixir from the lotus flower. "}}},{"verse_id":210010,"page_no":null,"line_no":569,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹਤ ਚਕੋਰ ਦੇਖ ਧਆਨ ਧਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਹਿਤ ਚੰਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chit chaahat chakor dhekh dhaan dharai a(n)mirat kiran achavat hit cha(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Ruddy sheldrake looks at the moon with rapt attention and drinks its ambrosial rays with his heart and mind; "}}},{"verse_id":210011,"page_no":null,"line_no":569,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗਾਇਬੋ ਸੁਨਾਇਬੋ ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਂ ਮਾਨੋ ਦਾਨ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਮੂਲ ਕੰਦ ਹੈ॥੫੬੦॥","translit_en":"taise gaibo sunaibo su sabadh sa(n)gat mai(n) maano dhaan kurakhetr paap mool ka(n)dh hai||560||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, reciting and singing the supreme hymns/words of the True Guru in a congregation assembled in the presence of the True Guru is capable of destroying sins from the roots-just as it is believed that charity made in Kurukshetra destroys all the sins.  (560)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41595,"next":41597}}
files.shabads/83/41597.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41597,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210012","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210012,"last_verse_id":210015,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210012,"page_no":null,"line_no":570,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਤਾਸ ਗਰ ਜਾਤ ਜਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਰੀ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਜਲ ਮਧਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kirataas gar jaat jal boo(n)dh paree ghirat sanaba(n)dh jal madh saavadhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as paper perishes or decays when water falls on it, but when smeared with fat, tolerates the effect of water superbly. "}}},{"verse_id":210013,"page_no":null,"line_no":570,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਾਰ ਤੂਲ ਤਨਕ ਚਿਨਗ ਜਰੈ ਤੇਲ ਮੇਲਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਮੈਂ ਬਾਤੀ ਬਿਦਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koT bhaar tool tanak chinag jarai tel mel dheepak mai(n) baatee bidhamaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as millions of bales of cotton get destroyed with a spark of fire, but when associated with oil as a wick, gives out light and lives longer. "}}},{"verse_id":210014,"page_no":null,"line_no":570,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਲੋਹੋ ਬੂਡ ਜਾਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਮੈਂ ਡਾਰਤ ਹੀ  ਕਾਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਸਾਗਰ ਨ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise loho boodd jaat salil mai(n) ddaarat hee  kaasaT prasa(n)g ga(n)g saagar na maan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as iron sinks as soon as it is thrown in water, but when attached with wood, it floats and disregards the waters of river Ganges or even sea. "}}},{"verse_id":210015,"page_no":null,"line_no":570,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਜਮ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ  ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੀ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੧॥","translit_en":"taise jam kaal biaal sagal sa(n)saar graasai  satigur bheTat hee dhaasan dhaasaan hai ||561||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly death-like snake is swallowing everyone. But once consecration from the Guru in the form of Naam is obtained, then the angel of death becomes slave of the slaves.  (561)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41596,"next":41598}}
files.shabads/83/41598.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41598,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210016","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210016,"last_verse_id":210019,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210016,"page_no":null,"line_no":571,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਂਡ ਚੂਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਘਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੈ ਪਾਹੁਨਾ ਕੇ ਆਏ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਖੁਵਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khaa(n)dd choon ghirat hot ghar bikhai pai paahunaa ke aae pooree kai khuvai khaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as flour, sugar and oil are kept at home, and on arrival of some guests, sweet dishes are prepared, served and eaten. "}}},{"verse_id":210017,"page_no":null,"line_no":571,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਰ ਹਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਨਕ ਆਭਰਨ ਪੈ  ਬਿਆਹੁ ਕਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਤਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise cheer haar mukataa kanak aabharan pai  biaahu kaaj saaj tan sujan dhikhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as beautiful dresses, pearl necklace and gold jewellery are in possession but are worn on special occasions like marriage and are shown to others. "}}},{"verse_id":210018,"page_no":null,"line_no":571,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਹੋਤ ਹਾਟ ਹੀ ਮੈਂ  ਗਾਹਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਬਿੜਤਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise heeraa maanik amol hot haaT hee mai(n)  gaahakai dhikhai biRataa bisekh paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as valuable pearls and jewels are kept in the shop, but shopkeeper shows them to the customer to sell and earn profit. "}}},{"verse_id":210019,"page_no":null,"line_no":571,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਲਿਖ ਪੋਥੀ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਤ  ਮਿਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੫੬੨॥","translit_en":"taise gurbaanee likh pothee baa(n)dh raakheeat  mil gursikh paR sun liv laieeaai ||562||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly Gurbani is written in a book form, it is bound and preserved. But when the Sikhs of Guru assemble in a congregation, that book is read and heard and it helps one attach the mind in the holy feet of the Lord. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41597,"next":41599}}
files.shabads/83/41599.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41599,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210020","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210020,"last_verse_id":210023,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210020,"page_no":null,"line_no":572,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਆਹਤ ਹੈ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਤਾਂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise narapat banitaa anek biaahat hai  jaa kai sut janam havai taa(n)hee gireh raaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king marries many women, but one who gives birth to a son is honoured with bestowing of kingdom. "}}},{"verse_id":210021,"page_no":null,"line_no":572,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਧਿ ਬੋਹਥ ਬਹਾਇ ਦੇਤ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ  ਜੋਈ ਪਾਰ ਪਹੰਚੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhadh bohath bahai dhet chahoo(n) or  joiee paar paha(n)chai pooran sabh kaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many ships sail in all directions of the sea, but one that reaches the shore beyond proves profitable. "}}},{"verse_id":210022,"page_no":null,"line_no":572,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਨ ਖਨਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਖਨਵਾਰੋ ਖੋਜੈ  ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਾਜੁ ਬਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khaan khanat ana(n)t khanavaaro khojai  heeraa haath aavai jaa(n) kai taa(n) ke baaj baaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several mine diggers dig for diamonds, but one who finds a diamond enjoys the celebrations of his find. "}}},{"verse_id":210023,"page_no":null,"line_no":572,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਅਉ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਮੈ  ਜਾਂ ਪਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਤਾਂ ਕੇ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੩॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh navatan aau puraatan mai  jaa(n) par kirapaa kaTaachh taa(n) ke chhab chhaaj hai ||563||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a Sikh of the Guru whether new or old devotee who gets a look of grace of the True Guru, earns honour, glory and praise.  (563)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41598,"next":41600}}
files.shabads/83/41600.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41600,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210024","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210024,"last_verse_id":210027,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210024,"page_no":null,"line_no":573,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਰਾਰਾਧੀ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਕਹੁ ਖੁਵਾਵਤ ਮੰਗਾਇ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਆਪ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise beeraaraadhee misaTaan paan aan kahu khuvaavat ma(n)gai maa(n)gai aap naahee khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as worshipper of brave (in Sikand Puran 52 Bir's Nandi, Bhirangi, Hanuman, Bhairav, etc. are mentioned) asks for sweet, distributes to all but does not eat any himself. "}}},{"verse_id":210025,"page_no":null,"line_no":573,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਫਲ ਫਲਤ ਫਲ ਖਾਤ ਨਾਂਹਿ ਪਥਕ ਪਖੇਰੂ ਤੋਰ ਤੋਰ ਲੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhrum safal falat fal khaat naa(n)h pathak pakheroo tor tor le jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree bears sweet fruits but does not eat them itself. Instead birds, travellers pluck and eat them. "}}},{"verse_id":210026,"page_no":null,"line_no":573,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੇਰਿ ਕਾਢਤ ਸੁਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau samu(n)dhr nidh pooran sakal bidh ha(n)s marajeevaa her kaaddat sugaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as ocean is full of all sorts of precious pearls and stones but those who have swan like temperament dives in it and relish them. "}}},{"verse_id":210027,"page_no":null,"line_no":573,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸੋਭਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੪॥","translit_en":"taise nihakaam saadh sobhat sa(n)saar bikhai paraupakaar het su(n)dhar su gaat hai ||564||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, there are many saints and hermits (who have no self interest and are always ready to do good to others without any gain to themselves) their lives become successful helping others. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41599,"next":41601}}
files.shabads/83/41601.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41601,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210028","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210028,"last_verse_id":210031,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210028,"page_no":null,"line_no":574,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਤ ਸੁਖ ਗਹੇ ਕਰ ਦੁਚਿਤੁ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਭਟਕਾ ਸੋ ਭੇਟ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep jot liv laagai chale jaat sukh gahe kar dhuchit haivai bhaTakaa so bheT hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as focusing the mind in the light of a lamp helps walk steadily, but once the lamp is held in hand, one becomes unsure to step forward because the shadow of the hand caused by the lamp light impairs the vision. "}}},{"verse_id":210029,"page_no":null,"line_no":574,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਧਿ ਕੂਲ ਬੈਠਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਚੁਨਤ ਹੰਸ ਪੈਰਤ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰ ਲਹਰ ਲਪੇਟ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhadh kool baiTh mukataa chunat ha(n)s pairat na paavai paar lahar lapeT hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a swan picks pearls on the bank of lake Mansarover, but when swimming in the water, can find no pearl nor can go across. He may get caught in the waves. "}}},{"verse_id":210030,"page_no":null,"line_no":574,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਭਾਵ ਸਿਧ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਿਕਟ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nirakh agan kai madh bhaav sidh hot nikaT bikaT dhukh sahasaa na meT hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as keeping fire in the middle is more helpful to all for warding off cold, but if placed too near creates fear of burning. Thus the discomfort of cold is supplemented by the fear of burning. "}}},{"verse_id":210031,"page_no":null,"line_no":574,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਮੀਪ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਾਪ ਕੀ ਅਖੇਟ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੫॥","translit_en":"taise gur sabadh saneh kai param padh moorat sameep si(n)gh saap kee akheT hai ||565||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly loving the advice and teachings of Guru and lodging it in the consciousness, one reaches supreme state. But to focus on any form of the Guru and then expecting/longing for nearness of the Lord is like falling a prey to snake or lion. (It is a spiritual death).  (565)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41600,"next":41602}}
files.shabads/83/41602.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41602,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210032","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210032,"last_verse_id":210035,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210032,"page_no":null,"line_no":575,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਜ ਲਾਗਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੈਸੇ  ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਿਰਖ ਸਨੇਹ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaam kaaj laag sevaa karat sevak jaise  narapat nirakh saneh upajaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a worker serves the king whole-heartedly and the king feels happy to see him. "}}},{"verse_id":210033,"page_no":null,"line_no":575,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੂਤ ਚੋਚਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦਿਮਾਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਢਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise poot chochalaa karat pitaa bidhimaan dhekh dhekh sun sun aana(n)dh baddaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son shows his childish pranks to his father, seeing and hearing these father pampers and cuddles him. "}}},{"verse_id":210034,"page_no":null,"line_no":575,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਮਧਿ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਖਾਤ ਪਿਆਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paakasaalaa madh bi(n)jan parosai naar pat khaat piaar kai param sukh paavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife serves the food fondly that she had prepared so lovingly in the kitchen, her husband eats it with pleasure and that pleases her immensely. "}}},{"verse_id":210035,"page_no":null,"line_no":575,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੀਝਿ ਗਾਇਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੬॥","translit_en":"taise gur sabadh sunat srotaa saavadhaan gaavai reejh gain sahaj liv laavahee ||566||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the devoted followers of the Guru hear the divine words of the Guru with rapt attention. Then the singer of these hymns also sing with deep emotion and love that helps both the listeners and the singers absorb their mind in the essence of Guru's words.  (566)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41601,"next":41603}}
files.shabads/83/41603.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41603,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210036","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210036,"last_verse_id":210039,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210036,"page_no":null,"line_no":576,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਿਆਮ ਘਟਾ ਗਗਨ ਘਮੰਡ ਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਅਉ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pekhai siaam ghaTaa gagan ghama(n)dd ghor mor aau papeehaa subh sabadh sunaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as peacocks and rain-birds make pleasing sounds seeing the dark clouds in the sky and hearing their thunder. "}}},{"verse_id":210037,"page_no":null,"line_no":576,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ ਮਉਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਆਂਬ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau basa(n)t samai maulat anek aa(n)b kokilaa madhur dhun bachan sunaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as mango and many other trees bloom during spring season, when cuckoos become ecstatic and make very sweet sounds sitting on these trees. "}}},{"verse_id":210038,"page_no":null,"line_no":576,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਕਮਲ ਸਰੁਵਰ ਵਿਖੈ ਮਧੁਪ ਗੁੰਜਾਰਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise parafulat kamal saruvar vikhai madhup gu(n)jaarat ana(n)dh upajaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as lotus flowers bloom in a pond attracting bumble bees who come flying making pleasant sound. "}}},{"verse_id":210039,"page_no":null,"line_no":576,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨਹ ਗਾਇਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੭॥","translit_en":"taise pekh srotaa saavadhaaneh gain gaavai pragaTai pooran prem sahaj samaavahee ||567||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, seeing the listeners sitting in singular mind, the singers sing the divine hymns in deep devotion and attention that creates an atmosphere of loving tranquility absorbing both the singers and the listeners in divine state of ecstasy.  (567)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41602,"next":41604}}
files.shabads/83/41604.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41604,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210040","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210040,"last_verse_id":210043,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210040,"page_no":null,"line_no":577,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕ੍ਰੀੜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਾਵੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise eh nis a(n)dhiaaree man kaadd raakhai kreeRaa kai dhuraavai pun kaahoo na dhikhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as during dark nights, snake takes out its jewel, plays around with it and then hides it and does not show to anyone. "}}},{"verse_id":210041,"page_no":null,"line_no":577,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਭਾਤ ਤਨ ਛਾਦਨ ਛੁਪਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bar naar kar sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog hot parabhaat tan chhaadhan chhupaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a virtuous wife enjoys the pleasure of the company of her husband at night and as the day breaks, re-drapes herself. "}}},{"verse_id":210042,"page_no":null,"line_no":577,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਅਚਵਤ ਮਧ ਭੋਰ ਭਏ ਜਾਤ ਉਡ ਨਾਤੋ ਨ ਜਨਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise al kamal sa(n)paT achavat madh bhor bhe jaat udd naato na janaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bumble bee closed in the box-like lotus flower keep sucking the sweet elixir and flies away in the morning as soon as the flower blooms again without acknowledging any relationship with it. "}}},{"verse_id":210043,"page_no":null,"line_no":577,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਉਠ ਬੈਠਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੋਗ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸ ਚਾਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੮॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh uTh baiThat a(n)mirat jog sabh sudhaa ras chaakh sukh tirapataavahee ||568||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an obedient disciple of the True Guru absorbs himself in the meditation of the Lord's name and feels satiated and blissful relishing the elixir like Naam. (But he does not mention his blissful state of the ambrosial hour to anyone).  (568)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41603,"next":41605}}
files.shabads/83/41605.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41605,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210044","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210044,"last_verse_id":210047,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210044,"page_no":null,"line_no":578,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੇਲ ਜੈਸੇ  ਪਾਛੈ ਬਧੂ ਜਨਨ ਸੈ ਗਰਭ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa sa(n)jog piray prem ras khel jaise  paachhai badhoo janan sai garabh samaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a newly wedded bride uniting with her husband on the nuptial bed and after their love making lodges the seed of the child in her womb; "}}},{"verse_id":210045,"page_no":null,"line_no":578,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਗੈ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਸਭਨ ਜਗਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"pooran adhaan bhe sovai gurajan bikhai jaagai parasoot samai sabhan jagaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And on confirmation of her pregnancy sleeps in the company of other elderly ladies of the house, and on delivering the child, keeps herself and other elders awake at night; "}}},{"verse_id":210046,"page_no":null,"line_no":578,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੋ ਸਜਮ ਕਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"janamat sut khaan paan mo sajam karai taa(n) te sut sa(n)mrath havai sukheh dhikhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And on birth of a son, she observes all preventions and precautions in her eating habits so as to ensure sound development of the son who will ultimately become a source of their comforts. "}}},{"verse_id":210047,"page_no":null,"line_no":578,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਸਬਦ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੯॥","translit_en":"taise gur bheTat bhai bhai sikh sevaa karai alap ahaar ni(n)dhraa sabadh kamaavahee ||569||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly an obedient Sikh of the True Guru serves Him with complete devotion after surrendering himself before Him. He eats and sleeps a little; and in the holy congregation practices meditation on divine teachings of the True Guru. (569)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41604,"next":41606}}
files.shabads/83/41606.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41606,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210048","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210048,"last_verse_id":210051,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210048,"page_no":null,"line_no":579,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਨੁਚਰ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪਛਾਨੈਂ ਭਾਖਾ ਬੋਲਤ ਬਚਨ ਖਿਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨ ਦੇਖ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise anuchar narapat kee pachhaanai(n) bhaakhaa bolat bachan khin boojhai bin dhekh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an attendant on king waits behind him and recognises his sound and utterances without even seeing the king. "}}},{"verse_id":210049,"page_no":null,"line_no":579,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੌਹਰੀ ਪਰਖ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੈ ਰਤਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੋ ਖੋਟੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jauaharee parakh jaanat hai ratan kee dhekhat hee kahai kharo khoTo roop rekh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a gemologist knows the art of evaluating the precious stones and is able to declare whether a stone is fake or genuine by a look on its form. "}}},{"verse_id":210050,"page_no":null,"line_no":579,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਕੋ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੰਸ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਰੇਖ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kheer neer ko nibero kar jaanai ha(n)s raakheeaai milai bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kai sarekh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a swan knows how to separate milk and water and is able to do in no time. "}}},{"verse_id":210051,"page_no":null,"line_no":579,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੈ ਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਮੀ ਨ ਗਨਤ ਹੈ ਲੇਖ ਹੀ ॥੫੭੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur sabadh sunat pahichaanai sikh aan baanee kiratamee na ganat hai lekh hee ||570||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a true Sikh of the True Guru recognises which composition is fake and which one is genuine, created by the True Guru as soon as he hears it. He discards what is not genuine in no time and keeps it in no account.  (570)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41605,"next":41607}}
files.shabads/83/41607.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41607,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210052","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210052,"last_verse_id":210055,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210052,"page_no":null,"line_no":580,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਯਸ ਉਡਹ ਬਲ ਜਾਉ ਬੇਗ ਮਿਲੌ ਪੀਯ ਮਿਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"baayas uddeh bal jaau beg milau peey miTai dhukh rog sog bireh biyog ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am sacrifice unto you 0 Crow! go and convey my message to my beloved to come and meet me soon so as to allay my sufferings, distresses and pangs of separation; "}}},{"verse_id":210053,"page_no":null,"line_no":580,"gurmukhi":"ਅਵਧ ਬਿਕਟ ਕਟੈ ਕਪਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਟੁ ਦੇਖਉ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"avadh bikaT kaTai kapaT a(n)tar paT dhekhau dhin prem ras sahaj sa(n)jog ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my beloved! separated from you, the life has become hard to spend. I am living in ignorance. Then how will I ever get the opportunity of uniting with my husband Lord to relish His love for ever? "}}},{"verse_id":210054,"page_no":null,"line_no":580,"gurmukhi":"ਲਾਲ ਨਾ ਆਵਤ ਸ਼ੁਭ ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬੇਦ ਲੋਕ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"laal naa aavat shubh lagan sagan bhale hoi na bila(n)b kachh bhedh bedh lok ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Time and omen appear auspicious, yet the dear beloved is not coming. Hopefully the cause of the delay in His arrival is not my worldly attachments. "}}},{"verse_id":210055,"page_no":null,"line_no":580,"gurmukhi":"ਅਤਿਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਔਸੇਰ ਲਾਗੀ ਧੀਰਜ ਨ ਧਰੋ ਖੋਜੌ ਧਾਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ॥੫੭੧॥","translit_en":"ateh aatur bhiee adhik aauaser laagee dheeraj na dharo khojau dhaar bhekh jog ko ||571||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my dear beloved! much delay has taken place in meeting with You and I am very anxious and impatient to meet You. I can hold on to my patience no more. Should I then dress up as a (female) yogi and search You?  (571)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41606,"next":41608}}
files.shabads/83/41608.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41608,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210056","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210056,"last_verse_id":210059,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210056,"page_no":null,"line_no":581,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਨਿ ਜਰਤ ਜਲ ਬੂਡਤ ਸਰਪ ਗ੍ਰਸਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"agan jarat jal booddat sarap graseh sasatr anek rom rom kar ghaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pain in the body due to burns, drowning in water, snakebite or wounds received by the strike of weapons; "}}},{"verse_id":210057,"page_no":null,"line_no":581,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਗਤਿ  ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਔ ਸੀਤ ਬਰਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"birathaa anek apadhaa adheen dheen gat  greekham aau seet barakh maeh nis praat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sufferings of many distresses, spending days in summer, winter and even rainy seasons and bearing these discomforts; "}}},{"verse_id":210058,"page_no":null,"line_no":581,"gurmukhi":"ਗੋ ਦ੍ਵਿਜ ਬਧੂ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬੰਿਧ ਕੋਟਿ ਹਤਯਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਕ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਬਸਿ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"go dhivaij badhoo bisavaiaas ba(n)dh ba(n)idh koT hatayaa tirasanaa anak dhukh dhokh bas gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Distresses of the body due to killing of a cow, brahmin, a woman, trust, family and many such-like sins and stigmas performed under the influence of desires. "}}},{"verse_id":210059,"page_no":null,"line_no":581,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਪੀਯ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੭੨॥","translit_en":"anik prakaar jor sakal sa(n)saar sodh peey ke bichhoh pal ek na pujaat hai ||572||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the pains of the world put together cannot reach the pain of separation of the Lord even for a moment. (All worldly distresses are trivial compared to the pangs of separation of the Lord).   (572)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41607,"next":41609}}
files.shabads/83/41609.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41609,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210060","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210060,"last_verse_id":210063,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210060,"page_no":null,"line_no":582,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਦ ਸਸਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਬਰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਊਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran saradh sas sakal sa(n)saar kahai mere jaane bar baisa(n)tar kee uook hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The light of full moon is considered cool and comforting by the whole world. But to me (suffering the pangs of separation of the beloved) it is like a burning wood. "}}},{"verse_id":210061,"page_no":null,"line_no":582,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਨ ਅਗਨ ਤਨ ਮਧਯ ਚਿਨਗਾਰੀ ਛਾਡੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਉਸਾਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਫੰਨਗ ਕੀ ਫੂਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"agan agan tan madhay chinagaaree chhaaddai bireh usaas maano fa(n)nag kee fook hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This pain of separation is causing countless fiery sparks in the body. The sighs of separation are like hissing sound of a cobra, "}}},{"verse_id":210062,"page_no":null,"line_no":582,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਖਾਨ ਫੂਟਿ ਟੂਟਿ ਜਾਤ  ਛਾਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਬਰਜਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੋਇ ਟੂਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"parasat paavak pakhaan fooT TooT jaat  chhaatee at barajan hoi dhoi Took hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus fire of separation is so strong that even stones break into pieces when they touch it. Despite much effort my chest is breaking into pieces. (I can't bear the pain of separation anymore). "}}},{"verse_id":210063,"page_no":null,"line_no":582,"gurmukhi":"ਪੀਯ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਲਜਾਯੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਚਿਤ ਚੂਕ ਹੈ ॥੫੭੩॥","translit_en":"peey ke sidhaare bhaaree jeevan maran bhe janam lajaayo prem nem chit chook hai ||573||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Separation of the beloved Lord has made both living life and death burdensome. I must have made a blunder in abiding by the vows and promises of love that I had made that is sullying my human birth. (The life is going to waste).  (573)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41608,"next":41610}}
files.shabads/83/41610.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41610,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210064","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210064,"last_verse_id":210067,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210064,"page_no":null,"line_no":583,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਭਵਨ ਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਸਕਲ ਜਮ ਦੂਤ ਭੈ ਭਯਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bin piray sihajaa bhavan aan roop ra(n)g dhekheeaai sakal jam dhoot bhai bhayaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the presence of my beloved by my side, all these comfortable beds, mansions and other colourful forms look frightening like the angels/demons of death. "}}},{"verse_id":210065,"page_no":null,"line_no":583,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਆਨ ਕਥਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਨ ਤੀਛਨ ਦੁਸਹਿ ਉਰ ਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bin piray raag naadh baadh gayaan aan kathaa laagai tan teechhan dhuseh ur baan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the Lord, all modes of singing, their melodies, musical instruments and other episodes spreading knowledge touch the body as sharp arrows pierce the heart. "}}},{"verse_id":210066,"page_no":null,"line_no":583,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਖਯਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bin piray asan basan a(n)g a(n)g sukh bikhayaa bikham aau baisa(n)tar samaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without dear beloved, all delicious dishes, comfort-giving beds and other pleasures of various kind look like poison and horrible fire. "}}},{"verse_id":210067,"page_no":null,"line_no":583,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਮਾਨੋ ਮੀਨ ਸਲਿਲ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ  ਜੀਵਨ ਜਤਨ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੭੪॥","translit_en":"bin piray maano meen salil a(n)taragat  jeevan jatan bin preetam na aan hai ||574||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fish has no other aim than living in the company of its beloved water, I have no other purpose of life than living with my beloved Lord.  (574)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41609,"next":41611}}
files.shabads/83/41611.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41611,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210068","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210068,"last_verse_id":210071,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210068,"page_no":null,"line_no":584,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਦੂਤੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਤ ਹੁਤੀ ਮਾਨ ਮਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਹੂ ਮੁਖ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਤੀ ॥","translit_en":"pai laag laag dhootee benatee karat hutee maan matee hoi kaahoo mukh na lagaavatee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the maid-servant bringing the message of my dear husband used to fall on my feet and pray, I in my arrogance would not even look at or even speak with her. "}}},{"verse_id":210069,"page_no":null,"line_no":584,"gurmukhi":"ਸਜਨੀ ਸਕਲ ਕਹਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਤ ਸੀਖ ਦੇਤਿ ਹੁਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਤਰ ਨਸਾਵਤੀ ॥","translit_en":"sajanee sakal keh madhur bachan nit seekh dhet hutee prat utar nasaavatee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My friends used to ever advise me with sweet words but , I used to reply them haughtily and send them away. "}}},{"verse_id":210070,"page_no":null,"line_no":584,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਟੇਰਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਨ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਵਤੀ ॥","translit_en":"aapan manai priaa Terat hai priaa priaa sun sun mon geh naikaa kahaavatee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then, when the beloved Lord himself used to come and call me-O darling! 0 dear one! I used to keep silent just to feel important. "}}},{"verse_id":210071,"page_no":null,"line_no":584,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਲਗ ਪੂਛਤ ਨ ਬਾਤ ਕੋਊ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਸੁਨਤ ਠਾਢੀ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਵਤੀ ॥੫੭੫॥","translit_en":"bireh bichhoh lag poochhat na baat kouoo birathaa na sunat Thaaddee dhavaiaar bilalaavatee ||575||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And now when I am suffering the pangs of separation of my husband, no one even come to ask me what state I am living in. Standing on my beloved's door I am crying and wailing.  (575)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41610,"next":41612}}
files.shabads/83/41612.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41612,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210072","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210072,"last_verse_id":210075,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210072,"page_no":null,"line_no":585,"gurmukhi":"ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੀਝਤ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਹਾਥ ਆਪਨੈ ਬਨਾਇ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"yaahee masatak pekh reejhat ko praan naath haath aapanai banai tilak dhikhaavate ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My beloved master used to feel pleased seeing my forehead. Adoring it, he used to put mark of consecration on it and ask me to see it. "}}},{"verse_id":210073,"page_no":null,"line_no":585,"gurmukhi":"ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਸਤ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਨਾਵਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"yaahee masatak dhaar hasat kamal piray prem kathaa keh keh maanan manaavate ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My beloved then used to keep her soft hands on my forehead and with loving stories used to please me-the arrogant one. "}}},{"verse_id":210074,"page_no":null,"line_no":585,"gurmukhi":"ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗਤੀ ਥੀ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਹੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਲਗਾਵਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"yaahee masatak naahee naahee kar bhaagatee thee dhai dhai het kar ureh lagaavate ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I used to run away saying No! No! and chasing me, he used to hug me very lovingly resting my forehead on his chest. "}}},{"verse_id":210075,"page_no":null,"line_no":585,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਮਸਤਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੁਿਨ ਰੋਇ ਉਠੌਂ ਸ੍ਵਪਨੇ ਹੂ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਹਿ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਵਤੇ ॥੫੭੬॥","translit_en":"soiee masatak dhun dhun puin roi uThaua(n) savaipane hoo naath naeh dharas dhikhaavate ||576||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But now on separation, I lament and cry with the same forehead, but my beloved master does not even appear in my dreams.  (576)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41611,"next":41613}}
