{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41613,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210076","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210076,"last_verse_id":210079,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210076,"page_no":null,"line_no":586,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਪ੍ਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਐ ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਰਚਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau prasoot samai satr kar priaai janamat sut pun rachat si(n)gaarai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman considers her husband as her enemy at the time of undergoing labour pains, but after the birth of the child, she re-indulges in adorning and embellishing herself in order to please and entice her husband, "}}},{"verse_id":210077,"page_no":null,"line_no":586,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੰਦਸਾਲਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੂਪਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਛੂਟਤ ਹੀ ਵਾਹੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਮਹਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ba(n)dhasaalaa bikhai bhoopat kee ni(n)dhaa karai chhooTat hee vaahee savaiaam kaameh samhaarai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a well-wisher of a king is put in jail for some mistake and on his release the same courtier performs the assigned task as a true well-wisher of the king, "}}},{"verse_id":210078,"page_no":null,"line_no":586,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰ ਹਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸਹਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਕੁਟੇਵਹਿ ਨ ਡਾਰੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise har hai gai saasanaa sahat nit kabahoo(n) na samajhai kuTeveh na ddaarai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a thief when caught and imprisoned is ever lamenting but as soon as his sentence ends, re-indulges in theft not learns from his punishment, "}}},{"verse_id":210079,"page_no":null,"line_no":586,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਿਟਤ ਪੁਨ ਪਾਪਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਜੀ ॥੫੭੭॥","translit_en":"taise dhukh dhokh paapee paapeh tiaagio chaahai sa(n)kaT miTat pun paapeh beechaarai jee ||577||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a sinful man wants to leave his evil deeds because of pain and sufferings that these have caused him but as soon as the sentenced punishment period is over, re-indulges in these vices.  (577)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41612,"next":41614}}
files.shabads/83/41614.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41614,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210080","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210080,"last_verse_id":210083,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210080,"page_no":null,"line_no":587,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਲ ਤੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਈ ਕੋਸ ਚਲਿਓ ਨੈਨ ਉਘਰਤ ਵਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਹੀ ਠਿਕਾਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bail telee ko jaanat kiee kos chalio nain ugharat vaahee Thaau hee Thikaano hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a blind folded bullock of an oilman keeps going around the extractor and he thinks he has travelled many miles, but when his blindfold is removed, sees himself standing at the same place. "}}},{"verse_id":210081,"page_no":null,"line_no":587,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਟਤ ਆਂਧਰੋ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਛਰੋ ਟਟੋਰੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jevaree baTat aa(n)dharo achi(n)t chi(n)t khaat jaat bachharo TaTore pachhutaano hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a blind person keeps twisting a rope without care when at the same time, the calf is eating it. But when he feels for the work done by him so far, repents to know that much of it has been eaten away; "}}},{"verse_id":210082,"page_no":null,"line_no":587,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਓ ਧਾਵੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ  ਆਵਤ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mirag tirasanaa lo dhaavai mirag tirakhaava(n)t  aavat na saa(n)t bhram bhramat hiraano hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer keeps running towards a mirage, but the absence of water does not satiate his thirst and he feels distressed wandering. "}}},{"verse_id":210083,"page_no":null,"line_no":587,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸ੍ਵਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਗਈ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਹਾਂ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੋ ਹੈ ॥੫੭੮॥","translit_en":"taise savaipana(n)tar dhisa(n)tar bihai giee pahu(n)ch na sakio tahaa(n) jahaa(n) moh jaano hai ||578||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, wandering in the country and beyond, I have spent my life in a dream. I have not been able to reach where I had to go. (I have failed to re-unite myself with God).  (578)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41613,"next":41615}}
files.shabads/83/41615.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41615,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210084","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210084,"last_verse_id":210087,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210084,"page_no":null,"line_no":588,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਤਨ ਕੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਭਏ ਭਾਮਨਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਜਨਨੀ ਕੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"sutan ke pitaa ar bhraatan ke bhraataa bhe bhaaman bhataar het jananee ke baare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My wondrous beloved master is son of sons, brother of brothers, beloved husband of wife and mother of child. "}}},{"verse_id":210085,"page_no":null,"line_no":588,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕ ਕੈ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਰੁਨ ਸੈ ਤਰੁਨਾਈ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"baalak kai baal budh tarun sai tarunaiee biradh sai biradh bivasathaa bisathaare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is childlike with children, youngman among the youth, old with elderly people. "}}},{"verse_id":210086,"page_no":null,"line_no":588,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT kai roop ra(n)g surat kai naadh baadh naasakaa suga(n)dh ras rasanaa uchaare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is beautiful to look at, listener of the musical melodies, relishers of fragrances and utterer of sweet words with his tongue. "}}},{"verse_id":210087,"page_no":null,"line_no":588,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਨਟ ਵਟ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਕਲ ਭੂਤ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਹੈ ॥੫੭੯॥","translit_en":"ghaT avaghaT naT vaT adhabhut gat pooran sakal bhoot sabh hee te niaare hai ||579||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a performer of strange acts, the beloved master is existing in strange form both in and out of the bodies. He is present in all bodies and yet is separate from all.  (579)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41614,"next":41616}}
files.shabads/83/41616.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41616,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210088","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210088,"last_verse_id":210091,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210088,"page_no":null,"line_no":589,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜ ਤੇਲ ਕਾਢੀਅਤ ਕਸਟੁ ਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਰਾਏ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise til peeR tel kaaddeeat kasaT kai taa(n) te hoi dheepak jaraae ujiaaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as oil is extracted with much effort and when that oil is put in a lamp and lit, spreads light. "}}},{"verse_id":210089,"page_no":null,"line_no":589,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਅਜਾ ਕੋ ਤਨ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਤਾਤ ਬਾਜੈ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise rom rom kar kaaTeeaai ajaa ko tan taa(n) kee taat baajai raag raaganee so piaaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a goat's meat is cut into pieces while the strings made of its intestines are used in musical instruments that produce melodies in various Ragas. "}}},{"verse_id":210090,"page_no":null,"line_no":589,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਉਟਾਇ ਦਰਪਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਲੋਸਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਕਰ ਗਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਤ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau uTai dharapan keejai losaT setee taa(n) te kar geh mukh dhekhat sa(n)saaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lump of special sand is melted and turned into glass and the whole world holds it in hand to see their face. "}}},{"verse_id":210091,"page_no":null,"line_no":589,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੁਧ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਤਾਂ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਕੋ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥੫੮੦॥","translit_en":"taise dhookh bhookh sudh saadhan kai saadh bhe taa(n) hee te jagat ko karat nisataaro jee ||580||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, one living through tribulations obtains Naam from the True Guru; practicing penance and Naam disciplines one's mind and grants high virtues. He connects worldly people to the True Guru and helps them sail across the worldly ocean. (580)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41615,"next":41617}}
files.shabads/83/41617.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41617,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210092","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210092,"last_verse_id":210095,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210092,"page_no":null,"line_no":590,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅੰਨਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਪਰਯੰਤ ਹੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰ ਭਯੋ ਤਾਂਹੀ ਸੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau a(n)naadh aadh a(n)t paraya(n)t ha(n)t sagal sa(n)saar ko aadhaar bhayo taa(n)hee sai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as grains are beaten and crushed right from the beginning and having lost their identity they become the support and sustenance of the whole world. "}}},{"verse_id":210093,"page_no":null,"line_no":590,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਪਾਸ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਉਸਾਸ ਕਾਢੈ ਜਗਤ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਭਏ ਅੰਬਰ ਦਿਵਾਹੀ ਸੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kapaas traas dhet na usaas kaaddai jagat kee oT bhe a(n)bar dhivaahee sai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as cotton bears the pain of ginning and spinning and loses its identity to become cloth and cover the bodies of the people of the world. "}}},{"verse_id":210094,"page_no":null,"line_no":590,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਬਰਨ ਮੈਂ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਨਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਯਾਹੀ ਸੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaise aapaa khoi jal milai sabh baran mai(n) khag mirag maanas tirapat gat yaahee sai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water loses its identity and becomes one with all colours and bodies and this character of destroying its own identity makes it capable of satiating others need. "}}},{"verse_id":210095,"page_no":null,"line_no":590,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੌ ਉਧਾਰ ਅਵਗਾਹੀ ਸੈਂ ॥੫੮੧॥","translit_en":"taise man saadh saadh saadhanaa kai saadh bhe sakal sa(n)saar kau udhaar avagaahee sai(n) ||581||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, those who took consecration from the True Guru and practiced Naam Simran to discipline their minds become superior persons. They are the emancipator of the whole world by attaching them with Guru.  (581)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41616,"next":41618}}
files.shabads/83/41618.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41618,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210096","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210096,"last_verse_id":210099,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210096,"page_no":null,"line_no":591,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰ ਬਿਘਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਛਰੈ ਤੁਰਤ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਮਾਰ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)g mil chalai nir bighan pahoochai ghar bichharai turat baTavaaro maar ddaar hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a man travelling in the company of others reaches home safely but one who gets separated, is robbed by dacoits and killed. "}}},{"verse_id":210097,"page_no":null,"line_no":591,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਖੇਤ ਛੁਵਤ ਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਰ ਛੇਡੀ ਭਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਖੇਤਹਿ ਉਜਾਰਿ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baar dhe'ee khet chhuvat na mirag nar chheddee bhe mirag pa(n)khee kheteh ujaar hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fenced field cannot be touched by humans and animals but an unfenced field is destroyed by passers-by and animals. "}}},{"verse_id":210098,"page_no":null,"line_no":591,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਮੈ ਸੂਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੇਤ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਿਕਸਤਿ ਖਿਨ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pi(n)jaraa mai sooaa jaise raam naam let het nikasat khin taa(n)h grasat ma(n)jaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a parrot shouts Ram Ram when in a cage but as soon as it gets out of cage, it is pounced upon by a cat and is eaten away. "}}},{"verse_id":210099,"page_no":null,"line_no":591,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਪਹੁੰਚੈ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਪੰਚੋ ਦੂਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਿਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੨॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g mil man pahu(n)chai sahaj ghar bicharat pa(n)cho dhoot praan parihaar hai ||582||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the mind of a human being acquires higher spiritual state when it unites with God-like True Guru. But when separated from the True Guru, it wanders about and is destroyed (spiritually) by the five vices-lust, anger, avarice, attachment and pride.  (582)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41617,"next":41619}}
files.shabads/83/41619.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41619,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210100","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210100,"last_verse_id":210103,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210100,"page_no":null,"line_no":592,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਘਨੇ ਸਕਲ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਮਸਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise taat maat gireh janamat sut ghane sakal na hot samasar gun gath jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several sons are born to a parent, but all are not virtuous to the same extent. "}}},{"verse_id":210101,"page_no":null,"line_no":592,"gurmukhi":"ਚਟੀਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਆਵੈਂ ਚਟਸਾਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੜਤ ਨ ਏਕਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਹਰ ਕਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"chaTeeaa anek jaise aavai(n) chaTasaal bikhai paRat na ekase sarab har kath jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as there are several students in a school, but all of them are not proficient in understanding a subject to the same extent. "}}},{"verse_id":210102,"page_no":null,"line_no":592,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੰਥੀ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਚਲਤ ਹੈਂ ਪਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nadhee naav mil baiThat anek pa(n)thee hot na samaan sabhai chalat hai(n) path jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several passengers travel in a boat, but all of them have different destinations. Everyone goes his own way 00 leaving the boat. "}}},{"verse_id":210103,"page_no":null,"line_no":592,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਜੀ ॥੫੮੩॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran hai(n) anek sikh satigur karan kaaran samarath jee ||583||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, several Sikhs of different aptitude take refuge of the True Guru, but the cause of all causes--the capable True Guru makes them alike by bestowing on them the elixir of Naam.  (583)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41618,"next":41620}}
files.shabads/83/41620.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41620,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210104","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210104,"last_verse_id":210107,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210104,"page_no":null,"line_no":593,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਮਤ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਦਹੇਜ ਘਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਆਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪੁਨਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise janamat ka(n)niaa dheejeeaai dhahej ghano taa ke sut aagai biaahai bahu pun leejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in the marriage of daughter born in a house, much dowry is given. And when her sons are married, much dowry is received from their in-laws house; "}}},{"verse_id":210105,"page_no":null,"line_no":593,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਮ ਲਾਈਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਭ ਹੇਤ ਮਨਿ ਸਕੁਚ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhaam laieeat piratham banaj bikhai paachhai laabh het man sakuch na keejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one spends money from one's pocket at the time of commencement of a business and then to earn profit, one should not hesitate to ask enhanced price; "}}},{"verse_id":210106,"page_no":null,"line_no":593,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਸਹੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀਅਤ ਸਕਲ ਅਖਾਦ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਧ ਦੁਹਿ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise guoo sevaa kai sahet pratipaaleeat sakal akhaadh vaa ko dhoodh dhuh peejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cow is reared with love and care, she is served fodder and other items not eaten by human beings, and she yields milk that is drunk. "}}},{"verse_id":210107,"page_no":null,"line_no":593,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਅਰਪ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦਾਨ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥੫੮੪॥","translit_en":"taise tan man dhan arap saran gur dheekhiaa dhaan lai amar sadh sadh jeejeeaai ||584||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, falling in the refuge of the True Guru, one surrenders all (body, mind and wealth) to Him. Then obtaining the incantation of Naam from the True Guru, one achieves emancipation and is freed from repeated deaths and births.  (584)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41619,"next":41621}}
files.shabads/83/41621.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41621,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210108","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210108,"last_verse_id":210111,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210108,"page_no":null,"line_no":594,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਰਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਨ ਕਨ ਭਾਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਗਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise laakh kor likhat na kan bhaar laagai jaanat su sram hoi jaa(n) kai gan raakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as writing figures representing millions and billions amount involve no burden at all, but if that much money is counted and placed on someone's head, he alone knows the burden he is carrying. "}}},{"verse_id":210109,"page_no":null,"line_no":594,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat a(n)mirat kahai paieeaai na amar padh jau lau jihavaa kai suras a(n)mirat na chaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as repeatedly saying Amrit, Amrit does not bestow one with liberation unless the supreme elixir is tasted. "}}},{"verse_id":210110,"page_no":null,"line_no":594,"gurmukhi":"ਬੰਦੀ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਸੀਸ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੋਊ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬੈਠੇ ੇਜਉ ਲਉ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ba(n)dhee jan kee asees bhoopat na hoi kouoo si(n)ghaasan baiThe ejau lau chakravai na bhaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as praises showered by a Bhatt (bard) does not make a person a king unless he sits on the throne and become known as a king with vast empire. "}}},{"verse_id":210111,"page_no":null,"line_no":594,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੫੮੫॥","translit_en":"taise likhe sune kahe paieeaai naa gurmat jau lau gur sabadh kee su jugat na laakheeaai ||585||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, one cannot obtain the wisdom of True Guru by just hearing or saying unless the skill of practicing devotedly the Gurus' words obtained from the True Guru is known.  (585)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41620,"next":41622}}
files.shabads/83/41622.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41622,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210112","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210112,"last_verse_id":210115,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210112,"page_no":null,"line_no":595,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਚੰਪਕ ਬੇਲ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਤ ਫੂਲ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau cha(n)pak bel bibidh bithaar chaar baasanaa pragaT hot fool hee mai jai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Champa (Michelia champacca) creeper is spread all over but its fragrance is felt only in its flowers. "}}},{"verse_id":210113,"page_no":null,"line_no":595,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੀਰਘ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਹੋਤ ਫਲ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhrum dheeragh savairoop dhekheeaai prasidh savaiaadh ras hot fal hee mai pun aai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree is seen to spread all over but sweetness or bitterness of its character is known only from tasting its fruit. "}}},{"verse_id":210114,"page_no":null,"line_no":595,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਤ ਕਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gur giaan raag naadh hiradhai basat karat prakaas taas rasanaa rasai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the Naam incantation of the True Guru, its melody and tune resides in the heart but its radiance is present on the tongue drenched with elixir-like Naam. "}}},{"verse_id":210115,"page_no":null,"line_no":595,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੂਪ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਤਛ ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਨਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੫੮੬॥","translit_en":"taise ghaT ghaT bikhai pooran braham roop jaaneeaai pratachh mahaa(n) purakh manai kai ||586||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the Supreme Lord is residing completely in everyone's heart but He can be realised only by taking the refuge of True Guru and great souls.  (586)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41621,"next":41623}}
files.shabads/83/41623.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41623,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210116","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210116,"last_verse_id":210119,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210116,"page_no":null,"line_no":596,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੈਦ ਬੈਦ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਰੋਗ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birathaava(n)t ja(n)t poochhai baidh baidh prat jau lau na miTat rog tau lau bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a patient describes his pain and discomfort to many physicians and doctors and ask for necessary cure, and till such times he is cured and become healthy, he keeps crying and wailing due to pain. "}}},{"verse_id":210117,"page_no":null,"line_no":596,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਭੀਖ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਵੈ ਚੈਨ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਅਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bheekh maa(n)gat bhikhaaree ghar ghar ddolai tau lau nahee(n) aavai chain jau lau na aghaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a beggar wanders from door to door in search of alms and he is not satisfied till his hunger is appeased. "}}},{"verse_id":210118,"page_no":null,"line_no":596,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਸੌਨ ਸਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਸੋਧੈ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birahanee sauan sagan lagan sodhai jau lau na bhataar bheTai tau lau akulaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife separated from her husband, searches for auspicious moments, omens and remains restless till her dear husband meets her. "}}},{"verse_id":210119,"page_no":null,"line_no":596,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜੈ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੭॥","translit_en":"taise khojee khojai al kamal kamal gat jau lau na param padh sa(n)puT samaat hai ||587||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, like a bumblebee searching for lotus flowers gets arrested in the flower when sucking its nectar, a seeker desiring union with his beloved Lord searches for the Naam till he gets absorbed in the supreme spiritual state while practicing it. (587)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41622,"next":41624}}
files.shabads/83/41624.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41624,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210120","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210120,"last_verse_id":210123,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210120,"page_no":null,"line_no":597,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇਖਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰੁਖੁ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pekhat pekhat jaise ratan paarukh hot sunat sunat jaise pa(n)ddit prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one becomes an expert gemologist watching and studying gems; and listening to words full of knowledge makes one clever, wise and a scholar. "}}},{"verse_id":210121,"page_no":null,"line_no":597,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰੂਘਤ ਸੰੂਘਤ ਸੌਧਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸੁਬਾਸੀ ਹੋਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਇਨ ਗੁਨੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)ooghat sa(n)ooghat sauadhaa jaise tau subaasee hot gaavat gaavat jaise gain guneen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as smelling various fragrances, one acquires much knowledge to become a perfumist and practicing singing preludes, one becomes expert in singing. "}}},{"verse_id":210122,"page_no":null,"line_no":597,"gurmukhi":"ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖਤ ਲੇਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਲੇਖਕ ਹੋਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੋਗੀ ਰਸੁ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"likhat likhat lekh jaise tau lekhak hot chaakhat chaakhat jaise bhogee ras bheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one becomes a writer by writing essays and articles on various topics; and tasting various edible commodities, one becomes an expert taster. "}}},{"verse_id":210123,"page_no":null,"line_no":597,"gurmukhi":"ਚਲਤ ਚਲਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਹੁੰਚੈ ਠਿਕਾਨੈ ਜਾਇ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੮॥","translit_en":"chalat chalat jaise pahu(n)chai Thikaanai jai khojat khojat gur sabadh liv leen hai ||588||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as walking on a path leads one to some place, similarly, searcher of spiritual knowledge takes refuge in the feet of the True Guru who initiates him to practicing Naam Simran that introduces him to his self and then he absorbs his consciousness in the holy feet of the Lord.  (588)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41623,"next":41625}}
files.shabads/83/41625.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41625,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210124","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210124,"last_verse_id":210127,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210124,"page_no":null,"line_no":598,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਬਾਸ ਲੇਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਏਕ ਪਦਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise al kamal kamal baas let firai kaahoo(n) ek padham kai sa(n)paT samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bumble bee hops from one lotus flower to -another, but sucking nectar from anyone flower at the time of Sunset, it gets arrested in its box-like petals, "}}},{"verse_id":210125,"page_no":null,"line_no":598,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੰਛੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਖਾਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਰਹਨੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pa(n)chhee birakh birakh fal khaat firai barahane birakh baiThe rajanee bihaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bird keeps hoping from one tree to the other eating all types of fruits but spends night on a branch of any tree, "}}},{"verse_id":210126,"page_no":null,"line_no":598,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਨਜ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau biaapaaree haaT haaT kai dhekhat firai birale kee haaT baiTh banaj lai jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a trader keeps seeing commodities in every shop but purchases goods from anyone of them, "}}},{"verse_id":210127,"page_no":null,"line_no":598,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਤਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੯॥","translit_en":"taise hee gur sabadh ratan khojat khojee koT madhe kaahoo sa(n)g ra(n)g lapaTaat hai ||589||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the seeker of Guru's words searches the jewel mine: The True Guru. Amongst many fake Gurus, there is a rare saintly person in whose holy feet the seeker absorbs his mind, obtains Naam and dyes himself in the Lord's divine hue. (589)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41624,"next":41626}}
files.shabads/83/41626.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41626,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210128","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210128,"last_verse_id":210131,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210128,"page_no":null,"line_no":599,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦੀਪਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਕੈ ਜਾਰਾ ਮੈ ਪਰਤ ਜਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep dheepat pata(n)g loT pot hot kabahoo(n) kai jaaraa mai parat jar jai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a moth is enamored by the flame of a lamp, circles around it, and one day falls in the flame and burns himself. "}}},{"verse_id":210129,"page_no":null,"line_no":599,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਗ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਿ ਆਵੈ ਉਡਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦਿਨ ਫਾਸੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khag dhin prat chog chug aavai udd kaahoo dhin faasee faasai bahur na aai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bird picks grains and worms the whole day and return to his nest as the sun sets, but some day, it is caught in the net of a bird catcher and does not return to its nest. "}}},{"verse_id":210130,"page_no":null,"line_no":599,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਖੋਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise al kamal kamal prat khojai nit kabahoo(n) kamal dhal sa(n)paT samai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a black bee keep searching and smelling elixir from various lotus flowers, but one day it is caught in the boxlike flower. "}}},{"verse_id":210131,"page_no":null,"line_no":599,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮਗਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਬਦ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੫੯੦॥","translit_en":"taise gurbaanee avagaahan karat chit kabahoo(n) magan havai sabadh urajhai hai ||590||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a seeker perpetually dives in Gurbani, but some day he becomes so engrossed in Gurbani that he is absorbed in Guru's words.  (590)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41625,"next":41627}}
files.shabads/83/41627.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41627,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210132","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210132,"last_verse_id":210135,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210132,"page_no":null,"line_no":600,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੋਸਤੀ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਹਤ ਪੋਸਤ ਬੁਰੋ  ਤਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਭਇਓ ਛਾਡਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਪੈ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise posatee sunat kahat posat buro  taa(n) ke bas bhio chhaaddio chaahai pai na chhooTiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a poppy husk addict calls this addiction bad, but caught in its web, even if he wants to leave it can't do so. "}}},{"verse_id":210133,"page_no":null,"line_no":600,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੂਆ ਖੇਲ ਬਿਤ ਹਾਰ ਬਿਲਖੈ ਜੁਆਰੀ  ਤਊ ਪਰ ਜੁਆਰਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਟੂਟਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jooaa khel bit haar bilakhai juaaree  tuoo par juaaran kee sa(n)gat na TooTiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a gambler loses all his money and wails, even then he cannot leave the company of other gamblers. "}}},{"verse_id":210134,"page_no":null,"line_no":600,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰੀ ਜਾਤ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਸਹਕਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਤਜਤ ਨ ਚੋਰੀ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਸੀਸ ਹੀ ਨ ਫੂਟਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chor choree jaat hiradhai sahakat pun tajat na choree jau lau sees hee na fooTiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a thief is scared of being caught when he goes out to steal, yet he does not leave stealing till he runs into trouble (is caught, imprisoned or hanged). "}}},{"verse_id":210135,"page_no":null,"line_no":600,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸਭ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮਾਯਾ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ  ਕਾਹੂ ਪੈ ਨ ਜੀਤੀ ਪਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਈ ॥੫੯੧॥","translit_en":"taise sabh kahat sunat maayaa dhukhadhaiee  kaahoo pai na jeetee parai maiaa jag looTiee ||591||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all humans declare mammon (maya) a troublesome necessity, yet it cannot be won over by anyone. On the contrary, it is plundering the whole world. (It is entangling people in its net and taking them away from the holy feet of the Lord.)  (591)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41626,"next":41628}}
files.shabads/83/41628.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41628,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210136","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210136,"last_verse_id":210139,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210136,"page_no":null,"line_no":601,"gurmukhi":"ਤਰਵਰੁ ਗਿਰੇ ਪਾਤ ਬਹੁਰੋ ਨ ਜੋਰੇ ਜਾਤ ਐਸੋ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"taravar gire paat bahuro na jore jaat aaiso taat maat sut bhraat moh maiaa ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Leaves broken from the branches of a tree cannot be re-attached; Similarly, father, mother, son and brother are relations that, like the leaves of a tree, will not stand by you in the end. Such attachments are the dragonet of maya."}}},{"verse_id":210137,"page_no":null,"line_no":601,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਓਰਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਬਿਲਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਭਰੋਸੋ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise budhabudhaa oraa pekhat bilai jai aaiso jaan tiaagahu bharoso bhram kaiaa ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bubble of water and a hail perishes in no time, similarly, give up the belief and illusion that this body will stay for long or forever. "}}},{"verse_id":210138,"page_no":null,"line_no":601,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਰਿ ਬੂਝਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ਲਾਗੈ  ਐਸੋ ਆਵਾ ਔਧਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"tiran kee agan jar boojhat na baar laagai  aaiso aavaa aauadh jaise neh dhrum chhaiaa ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fire of hay takes no time to extinguish, and just as developing attachment with the shade of a tree is futile, so is the period of our life. Loving it is worthless. "}}},{"verse_id":210139,"page_no":null,"line_no":601,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਾਤੀ ਰਾਚਹੁ  ਸਫਲ ਅਉਸਰ ਜਗ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਆਇਆ ਕੋ ॥੫੯੨॥","translit_en":"janam jeevan a(n)t kaal ke sa(n)gaatee raachahu  safal aausar jag tab hee tau aaiaa ko ||592||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Therefore, absorb yourself in the Naam of the True Lord throughout your life-span since this is the only asset that will go with you and is the companion for ever. Only then should you consider your birth in this world a success. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41627,"next":41629}}
files.shabads/83/41629.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41629,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210140","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210140,"last_verse_id":210143,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210140,"page_no":null,"line_no":602,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਹਰ ਜੋਰੈ ਬੋਵੈ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਖੈ ਲੁਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੌਨ ਖਾਇਧੋ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo har jorai bovai kouoo raakhai lunai kouoo jaaneeaai na jai taa(n)h a(n)t kauan khaidho ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For obtaining some grains, just as someone ploughs the field, someone else sows the seed and guards it, and when the crop is ready, somebody comes and reaps it. But it cannot be known who ultimately will eat that grain. "}}},{"verse_id":210141,"page_no":null,"line_no":602,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਗੜੈ ਚਿਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਕੋਊ ਲੀਪੈ ਪੋਚੈ ਕੋਊ  ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਕੌਨ ਬਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਇਧੋ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo gaRai chinai kouoo kouoo leepai pochai kouoo  samajh na parai kauan basai gireh aaidho ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as someone digs the foundation of a house, somebody else lays the bricks and plasters it, but no one knows who would come to live in that house. "}}},{"verse_id":210142,"page_no":null,"line_no":602,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਚੁਨੈ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਊ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਤੈ ਬੁਨੈ ਕੋਊ  ਬੁਝੀਐ ਨ ਓਢੈ ਕੌਨ ਅੰਗ ਸੈ ਬਨਾਇਧੋ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo chunai loRai kouoo kouoo kaatai bunai kouoo  bujheeaai na oddai kauan a(n)g sai banaidho ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as before getting the cloth ready, someone picks cotton, someone ginns and spins it, while some other person prepares the cloth. But it cannot be known whose body will adorn the dress made of this cloth. "}}},{"verse_id":210143,"page_no":null,"line_no":602,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਪਾ ਕਾਛਿ ਕਾਛਿ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਛੈ  ਕਵਨ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮਾਇਧੋ ॥੫੯੩॥","translit_en":"taise aapaa kaachh kaachh kaamanee sagal baachhai  kavan suhaagan havai sihajaa samaidho ||593||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, all seekers hope for union with God and prepare for it in multiple ways. But no one knows which seekers would ultimately get his blessing and share the mind like nuptial bed, and become one with the Husband Lord. (593)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41628,"next":41630}}
files.shabads/83/41630.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41630,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210144","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210144,"last_verse_id":210147,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210144,"page_no":null,"line_no":603,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਜਾਈ ਜਾਗਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee prabh bhaavai taeh sovat jagaavai jaiee jaagat bihaavai jaeh taeh na bulaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A woman-like seeker whom He likes, Lord goes and wakes her up. But one who spends the night awake, He does not go and talk to her. "}}},{"verse_id":210145,"page_no":null,"line_no":603,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਧਾਇ  ਸੇਵਕ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee prabh bhaavai taeh maanan manaavai dhai  sevak savairoop sevaa karat na bhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman who is liked by Him, and even if she is proud and arrogant, He rushes to please her and bring her around. On the other hand, a seeker woman may be seen doing service outwardly, she may not be liked by Him even then. "}}},{"verse_id":210146,"page_no":null,"line_no":603,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਰੀਝ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਆਪਾ  ਕਾਛਿ ਕਾਛਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਗ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee prabh bhaavai taeh reejh kai reejhaavai aapaa  kaachh kaachh aavai taeh pag na lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman whom Lord likes and becomes kind upon her, He pleases her but one who adorns herself and come to Him with ego-filled mind, He does not even let her touch His feet. "}}},{"verse_id":210147,"page_no":null,"line_no":603,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਬੈ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ  ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਕਹਤ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੫੯੪॥","translit_en":"joiee prabh bhaavai taeh sabai ban aavai taa kee  mahimaa apaar na kahat ban aaviee ||594||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A seeker woman whom He likes, all efforts and labour bear fruit. Her grandeur is beyond and difficult to express.  (594)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41629,"next":41631}}
files.shabads/83/41631.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41631,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210148","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210148,"last_verse_id":210151,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210148,"page_no":null,"line_no":604,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਬਿਖੈ ਬੋਹਥੋ ਬਹਾਇ ਦੀਜੈ  ਕੀਜੈ ਨ ਭਰੋਸੋ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਪਹੁੰਚੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਕੌ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau samu(n)dh bikhai bohatho bahai dheejai  keejai na bharoso jau lau pahu(n)chai na paar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a ship is set to sail in the sea, but no one can know its fate till the time it reaches the shore beyond. "}}},{"verse_id":210149,"page_no":null,"line_no":604,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨ ਖੇਤ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਤੈ ਬੋਵੈ  ਮਾਨਤ ਕੁਸਲ ਆਨਿ ਪੈਠੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਕੌ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kirasaan khet het kar jotai bovai  maanat kusal aan paiThe gireh dhavaiaar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a farmer happily and delightfully ploughs the field, sows the seed, but he celebrates his happiness only when the harvested grain is brought home. "}}},{"verse_id":210150,"page_no":null,"line_no":604,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਹੋਤ ਗਰ ਹਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ  ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਤ ਕੇ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਕੌ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pir sa(n)gam kai hot gar haar naar  karat hai preet pekh sut ke lilaar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife comes close to her husband to please him, but she considers her love a success only when she bears a son and he loves her. "}}},{"verse_id":210151,"page_no":null,"line_no":604,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਧੌ ਕੈਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਰ ਕੌ ॥੫੯੫॥","translit_en":"taise usatat ni(n)dhaa kareeaai na kaahoo keree jaaneeaai dhau kaiso dhin aavai a(n)t kaar kau ||595||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, no one should be praised or slandered before time. Who knows what sort of a day may dawn in the end that all his labour may bear fruit or not. (One may tread a wrong path and wander or will be accepted by the Guru ultimately).  (595)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41630,"next":41632}}
files.shabads/83/41632.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41632,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210152","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210152,"last_verse_id":210155,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210152,"page_no":null,"line_no":605,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੂਨੋ ਖਾਂਡ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ  ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise choono khaa(n)dd savaiet ek se dhikhaiee dhet  paieeaai tau savaiaadh ras rasanaa kai chaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as both sugar and flour being white look alike, but can only be identified when tasted (one is sweet, the other insipid). "}}},{"verse_id":210153,"page_no":null,"line_no":605,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੀਤ ਬਰਨ ਹੀ ਹੇਮ ਅਰੁ ਪੀਤਰ ਹੁਇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਹਤ ਪਾਰਖਦ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise peet baran hee hem ar peetar hui jaaneeaai mahat paarakhadh agr raakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as brass and gold bear the same colour, but when both are placed before an examiner, the value .of gold is known. "}}},{"verse_id":210154,"page_no":null,"line_no":605,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੋਨੋ ਖਗ ਸਿਆਮ ਤਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਅਸੁਭ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kuooaa kokilaa hai dhono khag siaam tan boojheeaai asubh subh sabadh su bhaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as both a crow and a cuckoo is black in colour, but they can be distinguished by their voice. (One is sweet to the ears while the other is noisy and irritating). "}}},{"verse_id":210155,"page_no":null,"line_no":605,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਚਿਹਨ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ  ਕਰਨੀ ਕਰਤੂਤ ਲਗ ਲਛਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੫੯੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh chihan kai samaan hot  karanee karatoot lag lachhan kai laakheeaai ||596||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, outer signs of a real and a fake saint look alike but their actions and characteristics can reveal who is genuine among them. (Only then can one know who is good and who is bad).  (596)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41631,"next":41633}}
files.shabads/83/41633.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41633,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210156","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210156,"last_verse_id":210159,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210156,"page_no":null,"line_no":606,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਪੂਰ ਲੋਨ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ  ਕੇਸਰ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਸਮਸਰ ਅਰੁਨਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise karapoor lon ek se dhikhaiee dhet  kesar kasu(n)bh samasar arunaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a camphor and salt being white look alike, petals of saffron and safflower (Carthamus tinctorious) being red, look the same. "}}},{"verse_id":210157,"page_no":null,"line_no":606,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪੋ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਦੋਨੋ ਜੈਸੇ ਉਜਲ ਬਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਕਾਜਰ ਔ ਚੋਆ ਹੈ ਸਮਾਨ ਸਿਆਮਤਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"roopo kaa(n)see dhono jaise ujal baran hot kaajar aau choaa hai samaan siaamataiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as silver and bronze shine alike, collyrium and incense stick ash mixed with oil have the same blackness. "}}},{"verse_id":210158,"page_no":null,"line_no":606,"gurmukhi":"ਇੰਦਰਾਇਨ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪੀਤ ਸਮ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਉ ਫਟਕ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"ei(n)dharain fal a(n)mirat fal peet sam heeraa aau faTak sam roop hai dhikhaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as colocynth (Tuma) and mango both being yellow look alike, a diamond and a marble bear the same hue. "}}},{"verse_id":210159,"page_no":null,"line_no":606,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਖਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੈਂ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸਮ ਦੇਹ ਬੂਝਤ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਲ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੫੯੭॥","translit_en":"taise khal dhirasaT mai(n) asaadh saadh sam dheh boojhat bibekee jal jugat samaiee kai ||597||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, in the eyes of a foolish person, good and bad men are seen the same, but one who is a knowledgeable person with Guru's teachings, knows how to separate milk from water like a swan. He has the ability to distinguish between a saint and a sinner.  (597)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41632,"next":41634}}
files.shabads/83/41634.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41634,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210160","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210160,"last_verse_id":210163,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210160,"page_no":null,"line_no":607,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈਂ ਬੋਏ ਬੀਜ ਉਪਜੈ ਨ ਪਾਨ ਧਾਨ ਖੇਤ ਮੈਂ ਡਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਨਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaalar mai(n) boe beej upajai na paan dhaan khet mai(n) ddaare su taa(n) te adhik anaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as seed sown in saline land does not grow even a leaf, but if this land is treated with gypsum salt, it gives much yield. "}}},{"verse_id":210161,"page_no":null,"line_no":607,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਲਰ ਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਸਬਾਰ ਜਮ ਸਾ ਊਸੁ ਤਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਤਪ ਤੇਜ ਉਪਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaalar sai karat sabaar jam saa uoos tau paavak prasa(n)g tap tej uparaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Saline, when mixed with water vaporises and then condenses, but when brought near fire produces a blast. "}}},{"verse_id":210162,"page_no":null,"line_no":607,"gurmukhi":"ਜਸਤ ਸੰਯੁਕਤ ਹੁਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਹੈ ਸੀਤ ਜਲ ਅਚਵਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jasat sa(n)yukat hui milat hai seet jal achavat saa(n)t sukh tirakhaa bhram bhaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The same saline salt when brought in contact with zinc container cools the water that gives peace and comfort when drunk. It satiates the craving and thirst. "}}},{"verse_id":210163,"page_no":null,"line_no":607,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਅਚੇਤ ਸੰਗਤ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਹੇਤ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਕਿਤ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਸਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੫੯੮॥","translit_en":"taise aatamaa achet sa(n)gat subhaav het sakat sakit gat siv siv saaj hai ||598||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a human soul under the influence of good and bad company and developing love and attachment with consciousless maya becomes consciousless. And by loving the conscious benevolent Lord, it also becomes benevolent and conscientious.  (598)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41633,"next":41635}}
files.shabads/83/41635.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41635,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210164","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210164,"last_verse_id":210167,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210164,"page_no":null,"line_no":608,"gurmukhi":"ਕੇਹਰਿ ਅਹਾਰ ਮਾਸ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਅਧਾਰ ਘਾਸ ਮਧੁਪ ਕਮਲ ਬਾਸ ਲੇਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kehar ahaar maas surahee adhaar ghaas madhup kamal baas let sukh maanahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as meat is the food of a lion, grass-that of a cow, while a bumble bee feels happy with the fragrance of a lotus flower. Just as a fish likes living in water, a child has support of milk for sustenance and cold breeze is considered friend of a snake. "}}},{"verse_id":210165,"page_no":null,"line_no":608,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਨੀਰ ਬਾਲਕ ਅਧਾਰ ਖੀਰ ਸਰਪਹ ਸਖਾ ਸਮੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"meeneh nivaas neer baalak adhaar kheer sarapeh sakhaa sameer jeevan kai jaanahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just a ruddy sheldrake loves the moon, a peacock is enamored by the black clouds while the rain-bird is always craving for the Swati drop. "}}},{"verse_id":210166,"page_no":null,"line_no":608,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਘਨਹਰ ਘਟਾ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dheh chaahai chakor ghanahar ghaTaa mor chaatirak boo(n)dhan savaiaa(n)t dharat dhiaan hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a scholar indulges in discourse and exposition while a worldly person is involved in worldly affairs, just as the whole world is immersed in the love of mammon (maya), "}}},{"verse_id":210167,"page_no":null,"line_no":608,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਲੋਕਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ  ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀ ॥੫੯੯॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ddit bedh beechaar lokan mai lokaachaar  maiaa moh mai sa(n)saar giaan gur giaan hee ||599||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a Guru-conscious and Guru aware person remains engrossed in the elixir-like name of the Lord blessed by the True Guru. (Practicing of Naam becomes then his life's support).  (599)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41634,"next":41636}}
files.shabads/83/41636.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41636,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210168","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210168,"last_verse_id":210171,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210168,"page_no":null,"line_no":609,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੀਤ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਸਿਆਮ ਅਰੁਨ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਂਧਰੋ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਦੇਖ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise peet savaiet siaam arun varan roop agrabhaag raakhai aa(n)dharo na kachhoo dhekh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as yellow, red, black and white coloured articles placed before a blind person means nothing to him. He can not see them. "}}},{"verse_id":210169,"page_no":null,"line_no":609,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਅਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਆਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਨ ਬਹਰੋ ਪਰੇਖ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raag raaganee aau naadh baadh aan gun gaavat bajaavat na baharo parekh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deaf cannot judge the expertise of a person who plays musical instruments, sings or performs other singing related acts. "}}},{"verse_id":210170,"page_no":null,"line_no":609,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਆਗੈ  ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚਿਤ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ras bhog bahu bi(n)jan parosai aagai  birathaava(n)t ja(n)t naeh ruchit bisekh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sick person when served with dainty dishes, pays scant attention towards them. "}}},{"verse_id":210171,"page_no":null,"line_no":609,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਬਚਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਧਮ ਅਭੇਖ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur dharas bachan prem nem nidh mahimaa na jaanee moh adham abhekh hai ||600||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, I who is low and wear a hypocrite garb have not appreciated the value of the words of True Guru which are priceless treasure for fulfilling the pledges and promises of love.  (600)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41635,"next":41637}}
files.shabads/83/41637.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41637,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210172","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210172,"last_verse_id":210175,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210172,"page_no":null,"line_no":610,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨ ਭਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਕਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਏ ਕਉਨ ਪਤਿਤਾਈ ਕੈ॥","translit_en":"kavan bhakat kar bhakat vachhal bhe patit paavan bhe kaun patitaiee kai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O  Lord! what is that worship that has made You the beloved of the worshippers? Which is that apostasy that has made You the forgiver and purifier of the sinners?"}}},{"verse_id":210173,"page_no":null,"line_no":610,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁ ਕਉਨ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਕੈ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀ ਭਏ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheen dhukh bha(n)jan bhe su kaun dheenataa kai garab prahaaree bhe kavan baddaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Which is that humility that has made You the allayer of the sufferings of the poor? Which is that ego-filled praise that has made You the destroyer of the pride and arrogance?"}}},{"verse_id":210174,"page_no":null,"line_no":610,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਥ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਹਾਈ ਭਏ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਣ ਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਅਸੁਰਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kavan sevaa kai naath sevak sahaiee bhe asur sa(n)ghaaran hai kaun asuraiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Which is that service of Your slave that has made You his master and You have helped him? Which is that devilish and demonic trait that has made You the destroyer of the demons."}}},{"verse_id":210175,"page_no":null,"line_no":610,"gurmukhi":"ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਘ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਗਰਬ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਨ ਬਿਰਦ ਮਿਲਉ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੬੦੧॥","translit_en":"bhagat jugat agh dheenataa garab sevaa jaanau na biradh milau kavan kamaiee kai ||601||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my Lord! I have not been able to fathom Your duty and nature. Please be kind and tell me by what form of worship and service that can bring humility in me, destroy my ego and apostasy, can I reach you?  (601)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41636,"next":41638}}
files.shabads/83/41638.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41638,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210176","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210176,"last_verse_id":210179,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210176,"page_no":null,"line_no":611,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਵਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਜਗ ਮੋਹਨ ਬਿਮੋਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kaun gun gai kai reejhaieeaai gun nidhaan kavan mohan jag mohan bimoheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Singing what virtues of the treasure-house of merits can we please Him? With what pleasant actions can we enamor the bewitcher of the world?"}}},{"verse_id":210177,"page_no":null,"line_no":611,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਨ ਸੁਖ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣ ਗਹੌਂ ਭੂਖਨ ਕਵਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kaun sukh dhai kai sukh saagar saran gahaua(n) bhookhan kavan chi(n)taaman man moheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What comfort can be offered to the sea of comforts that would provide us His refuge? With what embellishments can we captivate the mind of the Lord who fulfils all desires?"}}},{"verse_id":210178,"page_no":null,"line_no":611,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੇ ਨਾਯਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਹੁਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਉਨ ਉਕਤਿ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"koT brahamaa(n)dd ke naayak kee naayakaa hui kaise a(n)tarajaamee kaun ukat kai boheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can one become the wife of the Lord-Master of millions of Universes? With what means and methods can the knower of inner things be apprised of the anguish of the mind?"}}},{"verse_id":210179,"page_no":null,"line_no":611,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ॥੬੦੨॥","translit_en":"tan man dhan hai sarabas bisavai jaa(n) kai bas kaise bas aavai jaa(n) kee sobhaa lag soheeaai ||602||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who has the mind, body, wealth and the world in His control, involvement in whose praise one becomes adorable; how can such a Lord be brought in one's favour?  (602)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41637,"next":41639}}
files.shabads/83/41639.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41639,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210180","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210180,"last_verse_id":210183,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210180,"page_no":null,"line_no":612,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ  ਚੰਦਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal mil dhrum safal naanaa prakaar  cha(n)dhan milat sabh cha(n)dhan subaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all trees and plants yield many types of fruits and flowers by their union with water, but the nearness with sandalwood makes the entire vegetation fragrant like sandalwood."}}},{"verse_id":210181,"page_no":null,"line_no":612,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਢਰਤ ਪੁਨ ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਰੂਪ ਕੰਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mil paavak ddarat pun soiee dhaat paaras paras roop ka(n)chan prakaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as union with fire melts many metals and on cooling remains the metal that it was, but when touched with philosopher's stone, that metal becomes gold."}}},{"verse_id":210182,"page_no":null,"line_no":612,"gurmukhi":"ਅਵਰ ਨਖਤ੍ਰ ਬਰਖਤ ਜਲ ਜਲ ਮਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿੰਧ ਮਿਲ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"avar nakhatr barakhat jal jal miee savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh si(n)dh mil mukataa bigaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as rain falling outside the specific period (Nakshatra) according to the position of stars and planets is just falling of water drops, but when it rains during Swati Nakshatras, and a drop falls on the oyster in the sea, it becomes a pearl. "}}},{"verse_id":210183,"page_no":null,"line_no":612,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਅਉ ਨਿਵਿਰਤ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਦੋਊ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੩॥","translit_en":"taise paravirat aau nivirat jo savaibhaav dhouoo gur mil sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree abhiaas hai ||603||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, engrossed in maya and liberated of maya's influence are two tendencies in the world. But whatever intentions and inclinations one goes to the True Guru, he acquires the trait of worldly or divinely accordingly.  (603)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41638,"next":41640}}

Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210184,"page_no":null,"line_no":613,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bibidh prakaar karat si(n)gaar naar bheTat bhataar ur haar na suhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife makes over many type of embellishments in order to attract her husband, but once in the embrace of her husband, she does not like even the necklace in her neck."}}},{"verse_id":210185,"page_no":null,"line_no":613,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਸੁਰਤ ਸਮਾਰ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baalak achet jaise karat anek leelaa surat samaar baal budh bisaraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an innocent child plays many types of games as a child, but as soon as he grows up, he forgets all his childhood preoccupations."}}},{"verse_id":210186,"page_no":null,"line_no":613,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਜਸ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pirayaa sa(n)gam sujas naikaa bakhaanai sun sun sajanee sakal bigasaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife praises before her friends the meeting that she had with her husband and her friends feel happy listening to her details."}}},{"verse_id":210187,"page_no":null,"line_no":613,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦੈ ਉਡ ਕਰਮ ਉੇਡਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੪॥","translit_en":"taise khaT karam dharam sram giaan kaaj giaan bhaan udhai udd karam ueddaat hai ||604||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the six righteous deeds performed so laboriously for acquisition of knowledge, all of them disappear with the radiance of Guru's teachings and Naam like the stars disappear with the brightness of the Sun."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41639,"next":41641}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41641,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210188","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210188,"last_verse_id":210191,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210188,"page_no":null,"line_no":614,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਿਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise simar simar priaa prem ras bisam hoi sobhaa dhet mon gahe man musakaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife recalls her experience of pleasure with her husband and feels happy, becomes quiet and chuckles in her mind exhuming prettiness;"}}},{"verse_id":210189,"page_no":null,"line_no":614,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੋਦਤ ਹੈ  ਗੁਰਜਨ ਮੁਦਤ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran adhaan parasoot samai rodhat hai  gurajan mudhat hui taahee lapaTaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as on completion of her pregnancy, she goes into labour and cries due to pain but the elders of the house feel happy seeing the child and they shower love on him time and again;"}}},{"verse_id":210190,"page_no":null,"line_no":614,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਵਤੀ ਮਾਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਅਮਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਇ ਚੁਪ ਹੁਲਸਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maanavatee maan tiaag kai amaan hoi prem ras pai chup hulasaat gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an honoured pretty woman sheds her pride and arrogance and becomes humble, and on receipt of her husband's love when united with him becomes quiet and smiles within."}}},{"verse_id":210191,"page_no":null,"line_no":614,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਜਾਸ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੫॥","translit_en":"taise gurmukh prem bhagat prakaas jaas bolat bairaag mon gahai bahu suhaat hai ||605||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an obedient disciple of True Guru who experiences light divine as a result of his loving, perpetual meditation on Naam blessed by the Guru, he earns much respect and praise whether he speaks in a detached mood or goes silent in ecstasy.  (605)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41640,"next":41642}}
files.shabads/83/41642.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41642,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210192","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210192,"last_verse_id":210195,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210192,"page_no":null,"line_no":615,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਦਿਪਤ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਖਿ  ਅਨਿਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਗੁੰਜਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise a(n)dhakaar bikhai dhipat dheepak dhekh  anik pata(n)g ot pot hui gu(n)jaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as seeing a lamp lit in the dark, several moths start rumbling around it like warp and weft."}}},{"verse_id":210193,"page_no":null,"line_no":615,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਕਾਨ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਮੈਂ  ਰਾਖਤ ਹੀ ਚੀਟੀ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise misaTaan paan jaan kaan bhaa(n)jan mai(n)  raakhat hee cheeTee lobh lubhat apaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sweetmeats kept in best possible way to protect them from encroachers, yet avarice bewitched ants reach it from all sides."}}},{"verse_id":210194,"page_no":null,"line_no":615,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਦ ਸੌਰਭ ਕਮਲ ਓਰ ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ  ਮਧੁਪ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਾਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise miradh sauarabh kamal or dhai jai  madhup samooh subh sabadh uchaarahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as attracted by the fragrance, a bunch of bumble bees invade lotus flowers resoundingly."}}},{"verse_id":210195,"page_no":null,"line_no":615,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ  ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੀ ॥੬੦੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee nidhaan gur giaan paravaan jaa mai  sagal sa(n)saar taa charan namasakaar hee ||606||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an obedient Sikh who is accepted (by the Guru) and in whose mind the words and knowledge of the True Guru the supreme treasure, gets lodged, that Sikh's feet are bowed at by the whole world.  (606)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41641,"next":41643}}
files.shabads/83/41643.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41643,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210196","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210196,"last_verse_id":210199,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210196,"page_no":null,"line_no":616,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੀਝੈ ਰੂਪਵੰਤ ਹੀ ਰਿਝਾਇ ਲੇਹਿ  ਬਲ ਕੈ ਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"roop ke jo reejhai roopava(n)t hee rijhai leh  bal kai ju milai balava(n)t geh raakhahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If God-the husband Lord could be enticed by some form of beauty, then beautiful people would have enticed Him. And had He been reached by force, then great warriors would have overpowered Him."}}},{"verse_id":210197,"page_no":null,"line_no":616,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਬ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਬੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ  ਕਬਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਬੀਸ੍ਵਰ ਅਭਿਲਾਖਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"dharab kai jo paieeaai dharabesavair le jaeh taeh  kabitaa kai paieeaai kabeesavair abhilaakhahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If He could be acquired by money and wealth, rich people would have purchased Him. And if he could be obtained by recitation of a poems then great poets desirous of reaching Him would have reached Him through their art."}}},{"verse_id":210198,"page_no":null,"line_no":616,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਟਾ ਮੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੋਗੀ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਚਾਖਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jog kai jo paieeaai jogee jaTaa mai dhurai raakhai bhog kai jo paieeaai bhogee bhog ras chaakhahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the Lord could be reached by Yogic practices, then the Yogis would have hidden Him in their big tresses. And if he was reachable through consummation of materials, then materialistic people would have reached Him through their relishments."}}},{"verse_id":210199,"page_no":null,"line_no":616,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਜਤਨ ਪਾਨ ਪਰਤ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ  ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਤਿ ਏਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਭਾਖਹੀ ॥੬੦੭॥","translit_en":"nigreh jatan paan parat na praan maan  praan pat ek gur sabadh su bhaakhahee ||607||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord dearest than life is not captured or overpowered by controlling or giving up the use of senses or any other efforts. He can only be reached by meditating upon the words of the True Guru.  (607)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41642,"next":41644}}
files.shabads/83/41644.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41644,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210200","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210200,"last_verse_id":210203,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210200,"page_no":null,"line_no":617,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਫਲ  ਅਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise fal te birakh birakh te hot fal  adhabhut gat kachh kahat na aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree is born out of fruit and fruit grows on the tree this act is wonderous and cannot be explained."}}},{"verse_id":210201,"page_no":null,"line_no":617,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਵਨ ਮੈ ਬਾਵਨ ਹੈ ਬਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ  ਬਿਸਮ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baas baavan mai baavan hai baas bikhai  bisam charitr kouoo maram na paavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fragrance is in sandalwood and sandalwood is in fragrance, no one can know secret of this astonishing display."}}},{"verse_id":210202,"page_no":null,"line_no":617,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਸ ਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਜੈਸੇ  ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਯ ਮਯ ਕੌਤਕ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaas mai agan ar agan mai kaasaT jaise  at asacharay may kauatak kahaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fire exists in wood and wood is fire. This play is no less amazing."}}},{"verse_id":210203,"page_no":null,"line_no":617,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੈ  ਨਿਗੁਨ ਸਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੬੦੮॥","translit_en":"satigur meh sabadh sabadh meh satigur hai  nigun sagun giaan dhiaan samajhaavai jee ||608||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru has word (Naam) and True Guru resides in it. The True Guru alone explains us the focusing of mind on the absolute and transcendental form of divine knowledge.  (608)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41643,"next":41645}}
files.shabads/83/41645.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41645,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210204","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210204,"last_verse_id":210207,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210204,"page_no":null,"line_no":618,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਿਲ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਲੀਜੀਅਤ ਕੁਸਮ ਤੇ  ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise til baas baas leejeeat kusam te  taa(n) te hot hai fulel jatan kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as perfume is extracted from flowers and it is mixed in sesame oil and then with some effort, fragrant oil is prepared."}}},{"verse_id":210205,"page_no":null,"line_no":618,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਉਟਾਇ ਦੂਧ ਜਾਮਨ ਜਮਾਇ ਮਥਿ  ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਤ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau aauTai dhoodh jaaman jamai math  sa(n)jam sahat ghirat pragaTai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as milk is hard boiled, cooled and a small quantity of coagulant is added to turn it into curd. This curd is churned and butter obtained. The butter is then turned into ghee (clarified butter)."}}},{"verse_id":210206,"page_no":null,"line_no":618,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਆ ਖੋਦ ਕਰਿ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਧਸਾਇ ਕੋਠੀ  ਲਾਜ ਕੋਉ ਬਹਾਇ ਡੋਲ ਕਾਢਿ ਜਲ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kooaa khodh kar basudhaa dhasai koThee  laaj koau bahai ddol kaadd jal aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as earth is dug up to dig a well and then a frame of the size and shape of the well is pushed in, whence a bucket tied with long rope is used to pull out water."}}},{"verse_id":210207,"page_no":null,"line_no":618,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਤੈਸੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਕਤ ਭਾਇ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੬੦੯॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes taise bhaavanee bhakat bhai  ghaT ghaT pooran braham pahichaaneeaai ||609||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if the precept of the True Guru when practiced devotedly and lovingly with every breath, then the perfect Lord becomes imminent in His splendour in everybody and all forms.  (609)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41644,"next":41646}}
files.shabads/83/41646.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41646,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210208","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210208,"last_verse_id":210211,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210208,"page_no":null,"line_no":619,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਿ ਧਨੁਖ ਚਲਾਈਅਤ ਬਾਨ ਤਾਨਿ  ਚਲਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhar dhanukh chalaieeat baan taan  chalio jai tit hee kau jit hee chalaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an arrow is placed in a bow, the bowstring is pulled and arrow released in the direction in which it is intended to go."}}},{"verse_id":210209,"page_no":null,"line_no":619,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਲਗਾਏ ਤਨ ਤੇਜ ਕਰਿ  ਦੌਰਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਆਤੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਦਉਰਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise asavai chaabuk lagaae tan tej kar  dhauario jai aatur hui jit hee dhauraieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a horse is whipped to make it run faster and agitated, it keeps running in the direction it is made to run"}}},{"verse_id":210210,"page_no":null,"line_no":619,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਠਾਂਢੀ ਰਹੈ  ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਪਠਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhaasee naikaa kai agrabhaag Thaa(n)ddee rahai  dhaavai tit hee taeh jit hee paThaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an obedient maid-servant keeps standing in attention in front of her mistress, and she hastes away to the direction she is sent,"}}},{"verse_id":210211,"page_no":null,"line_no":619,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਭੂਮ  ਜਤ ਜਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ॥੬੧੦॥","translit_en":"taise praanee kirat sa(n)jog lag bhramai bhoom  jat jat khaan paan tahee jai khaieeaai ||610||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an individual keeps wandering on this Earth according to the deeds that he had performed (in previous birth). He goes where he is destined to sustain himself.  (610)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41645,"next":41647}}
files.shabads/83/41647.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41647,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210212","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210212,"last_verse_id":210215,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210212,"page_no":null,"line_no":620,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਰ ਬੋਲ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਗੁਨੀਆ ਮਾਨ ਲੇਤ ਗੁਨ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khar bol sun saguneeaa maan let gun avagun taa(n) ko kachhoo na bichaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a believer of omens, regards braying of a donkey as a good omen, but pays no attention to the donkey's good or bad qualities."}}},{"verse_id":210213,"page_no":null,"line_no":620,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਹੈ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦੇਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise mirag naadh sun sahai sanamukh baan praan dhet badhik biradh na samaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer, attracted by the music of Ghanda Hehra rushes towards its source and is killed by the hunter's arrow, but it does not ponder over his killer qualities. "}}},{"verse_id":210214,"page_no":null,"line_no":620,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਜੈਸੇ ਜੂਝੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਧ ਸਮੈ ਢਾਡੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਉਰ ਧਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sunat jujhaauoo jaise joojhai jodhaa judh samai ddaaddee ko na baran chihan ur dhaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a battle warrior rushes into the battlefield on hearing the sound of war-drums that fills him with excitement, but he does not bring the form or colour of the drummer in his mind."}}},{"verse_id":210215,"page_no":null,"line_no":620,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਠਗੋ ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰ ਹੀ ॥੬੧੧॥","translit_en":"taise gur sabadh sunai gai sikh Thago bhekh dhaaree jaan moh maar na biddaar hee ||611||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, I a cheat different from inside and outside swindle gullible Sikhs by singing to them the sacred hymns of the Guru. But those Sikhs enamoured by the sweetness of Gurbani and of very generous nature, don't even scold me despite them knowing that I am a fake Sikh.  (611)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41646,"next":41648}}
