{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41648,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210216","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210216,"last_verse_id":210219,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210216,"page_no":null,"line_no":621,"gurmukhi":"ਰਿਧ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਪਾਰਸ ਕਲਪ-ਤਰੁ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਲਛਮੀ ਸ੍ਵਮੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"ridh sidh nidh sudhaa paaras kalapa-tar kaamadhen chi(n)taaman lachhamee savaimev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All wealths, miraculous powers, so-called elixirs, philosopher stones, heavenly-trees and cows, pearl that frees a person from all worries and even goddess Lakshami (goddess of wealth) are paltry,"}}},{"verse_id":210217,"page_no":null,"line_no":621,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਸੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਨ ਭੁਕਤ ਜੁਕਤ ਮਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"chatur padhaarath subhaav seel roop gun bhukat jukat mat alakh abhev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The four elements, piety of character, righteousness, beautiful form, virtues, relishment of material wisdom and means of uniting with inaccessible and indiscriminating Lord are also paltry,"}}},{"verse_id":210218,"page_no":null,"line_no":621,"gurmukhi":"ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਛਬਿ ਤੇਜ ਤਪ ਕਾਂਤਿ ਬਿਭੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"javaiaalaa jot jai jaikaar keerat prataap chhab tej tap kaa(n)t bibhai sobhaa saadh sev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shining miraculous intellect, praise of the world, glory and grandeur, power, penance, revolutionary praise, luxurious living and service of the holy-men is also no match."}}},{"verse_id":210219,"page_no":null,"line_no":621,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਕਲ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ ॥੬੧੨॥","translit_en":"ana(n)dh sahaj sukh sakal prakaas koT ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa jaa(n)h gurdhev kee ||612||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A momentary glimpse of grace by the True Guru provides a slave Sikh with all the bliss, ecstasy, happiness and millions of radiances, who has been blessed with consecration of Lord's name by the Guru.  (612)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41647,"next":41649}}
files.shabads/83/41649.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41649,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210220","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210220,"last_verse_id":210223,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210220,"page_no":null,"line_no":622,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਨਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes praat samai isanaan kar jihavaa japat gurma(n)tr jaise jaanahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The obedient Sikhs of the True Guru bathe themselves in the ambrosial hour, sit in meditation and recitation of Lord's name as they know and as taught to them by the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":210221,"page_no":null,"line_no":622,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਪਾਇ ਪਰਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"tilak lilaar pai parat parasapar sabadh sunai gai sun unamaan hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the congregation of the Sikhs of the Guru, they shower respect and love upon each, sing, listen and reflect on Lord's praises while the marks of acceptance of such acts become conspicuous on their forehead."}}},{"verse_id":210222,"page_no":null,"line_no":622,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਜਨ ਤਜਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat bhajan tajan dhuramat kahai giaan dhiaan gursikh pa(n)ch paravaan hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The path of Guru's wisdom teaches us adopting and practicing Guru's teachings and shedding base wisdom. Guru-blessed knowledge and concentrating mind on the True Guru is only acceptable."}}},{"verse_id":210223,"page_no":null,"line_no":622,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਉ ਕਹਤ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਭਲੋ ਰਹਤ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਹੀ ॥੬੧੩॥","translit_en":"dhekhat sunat aau kahat sab kouoo bhalo rahat a(n)taragat satigur maanahee ||613||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Outwardly, everyone sees, listens to and describes this Guru defined path. But those who have adopted this path innately are accepted ultimately at the door of the True Guru."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41648,"next":41650}}
files.shabads/83/41650.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41650,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210224","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210224,"last_verse_id":210227,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210224,"page_no":null,"line_no":623,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਧੋਬੀ ਸਾਬਨ ਲਗਾਇ ਪੀਟੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਸੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਬਸਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhobee saaban lagai peeTai paathar sai niramal karat hai basan maleen kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a washerman applies soap to a dirty cloth and then beats it time and again on a slab to make it clean and bright."}}},{"verse_id":210225,"page_no":null,"line_no":623,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤੳ ਸੁਨਾਰ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਢਾਰ  ਕਰਤ ਅਸੁਧ ਸੁਧ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ta sunaar baara(n) baar gaar gaar ddaar  karat asudh sudh ka(n)chan kuleen kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a goldsmith heats the gold time and again to remove its impurity and makes it pure and shining."}}},{"verse_id":210226,"page_no":null,"line_no":623,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਵਨ ਝਕਝੋਰਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਮਿਲ ਮਲਯ ਗੰਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau pavan jhakajhorat birakh mil malay ga(n)dh karat hai cha(n)dhan prabeen kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fragrant breeze of Malay mountain shakes other plants violently making them sweet-smelling like sandalwood."}}},{"verse_id":210227,"page_no":null,"line_no":623,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਚੀਨ ਕਉ ॥੬੧੪॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikhan dhikhai kai birathaa bibek maiaa mal kaaT karai nij padh cheen kau ||614||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru makes His Sikhs aware of the troublesome ailments and destroys the dross of maya with His knowledge, words and Naam, and then makes them aware of their self.  (614)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41649,"next":41651}}
files.shabads/83/41651.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41651,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210228","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210228,"last_verse_id":210231,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210228,"page_no":null,"line_no":624,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਤਰ ਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸੀਅਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਠਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"paatar mai jaise bahu bi(n)jan paroseeat bhojan kai ddaareeat paavai naeh Thaam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as several eatables are served in a big leaf but after eating these dishes, the leaf is thrown away. Then it has no place in one's scheme of things."}}},{"verse_id":210229,"page_no":null,"line_no":624,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤਮੋਲ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਡਾਰੀਐ ਉਗਾਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਆਢ ਦਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise hee tamol ras rasanaa rasai khai ddaareeaai ugaar naeh rahai aadd dhaam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as betel leaf extract is obtained by masticating the leaf and after enjoying the extract, the residue is thrown away. It is not worth even half a shell."}}},{"verse_id":210230,"page_no":null,"line_no":624,"gurmukhi":"ਫੂਲਨ ਕੋ ਹਾਰ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਜੈਸੇ  ਪਾਛੈ ਡਾਰ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਹੈ ਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"foolan ko haar ur dhaar baas leejai jaise  paachhai ddaar dheejai kahai hai na kaahoo kaam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a garland of flowers is worn around the neck and sweet smell of the flowers is enjoyed, but once these flowers wither away, these are thrown away saying that they are no good now."}}},{"verse_id":210231,"page_no":null,"line_no":624,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੇਸ ਨਖ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੂਤ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਮ ਕੋ ॥੬੧੫॥","translit_en":"jaise kes nakh thaan bhirasaT na suhaat kaahoo piray bichhurat soiee soot bhio baam ko ||615||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as hair and nails if plucked from their actual place are very uncomfortable and painful, such is the state of a woman separated from love of her husband.  (615)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41650,"next":41652}}
files.shabads/83/41652.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41652,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210232","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210232,"last_verse_id":210235,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210232,"page_no":null,"line_no":625,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵਨੀ ਸੁਤਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰਿ ਮਧਿ  ਜਾਤਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise asavainee suteh chhaadd a(n)dhakaar madh  jaat pun aavat hai surat saneh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mare leaves the house with her master to help him do his work leaving her colt back home and returns home remembering its young one."}}},{"verse_id":210233,"page_no":null,"line_no":625,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਵੰਤ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ  ਬੋਲਤ ਘਟੰਤਰ ਚੈਤੰਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੇਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ni(n)dhraava(n)t supana(n)tar dhisa(n)tar mai  bolat ghaTa(n)tar chaita(n)n gat geh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sleeping person visits many cities and countries in his dream, mumbles in his throat, but once out of his sleep performs his household duties attentively."}}},{"verse_id":210234,"page_no":null,"line_no":625,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਰੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਿਆਗ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ  ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਕਰ ਗਿਰੈ ਤਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੇਹ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau parevaa tirayaa tiaag hui akaasachaaree  dhekh parakar girai tan boo(n)dh meh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a he-pigeon leaves his mate and flies in the sky but seeing his mate, he comes down towards her at such a fast pace as a drop of rain falls from the sky,"}}},{"verse_id":210235,"page_no":null,"line_no":625,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਬਿਖੈ  ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਕੈ ॥੬੧੬॥","translit_en":"taise man bach kram bhagat jagat bikhai  dhekh kai sanehee hot bisam bidheh kai ||616||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a devotee of the Lord lives in this world and his family but when he sees his beloved Satsangis, he becomes ecstatic of mind, words and deeds. (He becomes absorbed in the loving state that the Lord blesses him with through Naam). "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41651,"next":41653}}
files.shabads/83/41653.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41653,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210236","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210236,"last_verse_id":210239,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210236,"page_no":null,"line_no":626,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਧ ਸਮੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jodhaa judh same sasatr sanaeh saaj lobh moh tiaag beer khet bikhai jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a brave warrior goes to the battlefield wearing his armour and his weapons, renouncing all his love and attachments."}}},{"verse_id":210237,"page_no":null,"line_no":626,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ  ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਭਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sunat jujhaauoo ghor mor gat bigasaat  pekhat subhaT ghaT a(n)g na samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the inspiring music of battle songs he blooms like flower and feels happy and proud seeing the army spread like dark clouds in the sky."}}},{"verse_id":210238,"page_no":null,"line_no":626,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੂਝ ਮਰੈ  ਕੈ ਤਉ ਰਣ ਜੀਤ ਬੀਤੀ ਕਹਤ ਜੁ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"karat sa(n)graam savaiaam kaam laag joojh marai  kai tau ran jeet beetee kahat ju gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Serving his master the king, he is performing his duties and is killed or else if alive, returns to narrate all the happenings of the battlefield."}}},{"verse_id":210239,"page_no":null,"line_no":626,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਮਤ ਭੇਟਤ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਔ ਸਬਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੧੭॥","translit_en":"taise hee bhagat mat bheTat jagat pat mon aau sabadh gadh gadh musakaat hai ||617||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a traveller of the path of devotion and worship becomes consciously one with the master of the world. He either becomes totally silent or singing His praises and paeans, remains in a state of ecstasy.  (617)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41652,"next":41654}}
files.shabads/83/41654.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41654,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210240","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210240,"last_verse_id":210243,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210240,"page_no":null,"line_no":627,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਨਰਿੰਦ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਪ੍ਰਯੰਕ ਪਰ ਚਾਰੋ ਖੂਟ ਸੈ ਦਰਬ ਦੇਤ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau nari(n)dh chaReh baiThat praya(n)k par chaaro khooT sai dharab dhet aan aan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as when a king comes and sits on his throne, people from all over come to him with their problems and petitions or offerings,"}}},{"verse_id":210241,"page_no":null,"line_no":627,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਰਿਸਾਇ ਆਗਿਆ ਕਰਤ ਜਉ ਮਾਰਬੇ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਕਾਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaahoo kau risai aagiaa karat jau maarabe kee taatakaal maar ddaareeat praan haan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And if the king angrily orders killing of a culprit, that person is executed at once."}}},{"verse_id":210242,"page_no":null,"line_no":627,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਵਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੁਰਤ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਗਣ ਦੇਤਿ ਆਨ ਮਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaahoo kau prasa(n)n hui dhivaavat hai laakh koT turat bha(n)ddaaree gan dhet aan maan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And pleased with some noble and virtuous person, he orders giving millions of rupees to the honoured person, the cashier obeys the order and brings the required money immediately."}}},{"verse_id":210243,"page_no":null,"line_no":627,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੇਤ ਲੇਤ ਹੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਲੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪਤ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥੬੧੮॥","translit_en":"taise dhet let het net kai braham giaanee lep na lipat hai braham giaan siaan kai ||618||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king remains impartial while passing judgment on a culprit or a noble person, so does an enlightened person remain aloof of these comforts and tribulations being a knower of the Lord's nature and dispensation of His justice. (618)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41653,"next":41655}}
files.shabads/83/41655.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41655,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210244","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210244,"last_verse_id":210247,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210244,"page_no":null,"line_no":628,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਭੈ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਚਾਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਚਾਰੋ ਕੁੰਟ ਰਾਜਤ ਰਾਜਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"anabhai bhavan prem bhagat mukat dhavaiaar chaaro bas chaaro ku(n)T raajat raajaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The door of the True Guru is perpetual source of knowledge, a place where His slaves are ever involved in His loving worship and His loving maids are praying for salvation."}}},{"verse_id":210245,"page_no":null,"line_no":628,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸ੍ਵਪਨ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਚਲਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaagrat savaipan dhin rain uTh baiTh chal simaran sravan sukirat paravaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That human being is ever accepted at the door of the True Guru who utters and listens to His divine name awake, sleeping, sitting, standing or walking. This for him is the supreme task for him."}}},{"verse_id":210246,"page_no":null,"line_no":628,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਮਾਨੋ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee joiee aavai soiee bhaavai paavai naam nidh bhagat vachhal maano baajat neesaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All those who come to the door of the True Guru with devotion and love are accepted by the True Guru. He acquires the invaluable treasure of Name. It seems the proclamation of Him being the lover of the worshippers is being sounded on His door in the form of drum beating."}}},{"verse_id":210247,"page_no":null,"line_no":628,"gurmukhi":"ਜਵਿਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਵਤ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਛਬਿ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੧੯॥","translit_en":"javin mukat saam raaj sukh bhogavat adhabhut chhab at hee biraajamaan hai ||619||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All those human beings who take refuge on the door of the king of kings, they enjoy the wondrous comforts of the treasure of Name and becomes liberated while alive. Such wondrous beauty of the court of the True Guru is becoming well adorned.  (619)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41654,"next":41656}}
files.shabads/83/41656.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41656,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210248","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210248,"last_verse_id":210251,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210248,"page_no":null,"line_no":629,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੋਦ ਕਉਤਕ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"lochan bilok roop ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab sahaj binodh modh kautak dhikhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The eyes of a Sikh of the Guru are seeing the adornment of the every limb, colour and form of the True Guru. The bliss of the spiritual knowledge and its wondrous effect is evident."}}},{"verse_id":210249,"page_no":null,"line_no":629,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਜਸ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sravan sujas ras rasik rasaal gun sun sun surat sa(n)dhes pahuchaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ears of a Gursikh have become relishers of the virtues of the True Guru having heard them perpetually, and they are reaching the messages of His wondrous deeds to his consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":210250,"page_no":null,"line_no":629,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa sabadh raag naadh savaiaadh binatee kai naasikaa suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh samajhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tongue of a Gursikh is uttering the words blessed by the True Guru. Its music is sounding in the tenth door and the pleasure so generated is reaching his consciousness in the form of prayer and the fragrance of Naam Simran is also being conveyed by the nostrils to it. "}}},{"verse_id":210251,"page_no":null,"line_no":629,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਾਨੋ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੬੨੦॥","translit_en":"saritaa anek maano sa(n)gam samu(n)dhr gat ridhai piray prem nem tirapat na paavahee ||620||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many rivers fall in the sea and yet its thirst is never satiated. So is the love of his dear beloved in the heart of Gursikh where multi-waves of Naam are propagating yet its loving thirst is never satiated.  (620)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41655,"next":41657}}
files.shabads/83/41657.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41657,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210252","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210252,"last_verse_id":210255,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210252,"page_no":null,"line_no":630,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਅਵਲੋਕਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan kirapan avalokat anoop roop param nidhaan jaan tirapat na aaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the desire of a miser for money is never satiated, so are the eyes of a Sikh of the Guru who have realised that the form of True Guru is a unique treasure seeing which one never feels satisfied."}}},{"verse_id":210253,"page_no":null,"line_no":630,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਅਚਵਤਿ ਸੁਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sravan dhaaridhree sun a(n)mirat bachan piray achavat surat piaas na miTaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as hunger of a pauper is never satiated, so are the ears of a Gursikh which are ever desirous of hearing the ambrosial words of the True Guru. And yet hearing those elixir-like words, the thirst of his consciousness is not quenched."}}},{"verse_id":210254,"page_no":null,"line_no":630,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਰਟਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਗ੍ਰਨੀਵ ਗੂੜ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਅਘਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa raTat gun guroo agraneev gooR chaatirak jugat gat mat na aghaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tongue of a Gursikh keeps recalling the prime traits of the True Guru and like a rain-bird who keeps shouting for more, it is never satiated."}}},{"verse_id":210255,"page_no":null,"line_no":630,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬਢਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੬੨੧॥","translit_en":"pekhat sunat simarat bisamaadh ras rasik pragaas prem tirasan baddaiee hai ||621||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The inner self of a Sikh is getting enlightened with blissful light through seeing, hearing and uttering of the wondrous form of True Guru-a treasure-house-nay the fountain-head of all the virtues. Yet the thirst and hunger of such a Gursikh never wanes.  (621)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41656,"next":41658}}
files.shabads/83/41658.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41658,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210256","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210256,"last_verse_id":210259,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210256,"page_no":null,"line_no":631,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੌ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਹੂ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਪਰਮ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhiragan mai dhekhat hau dhirag hoo jo dhekhayo chaahai param anoop roop su(n)dhar dhikhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my True Guru! I am seeing your beautiful face in my eyes, and if I ever attempt to see anything else with them, then bless me with your wonderful form for me to see all the times."}}},{"verse_id":210257,"page_no":null,"line_no":631,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"sravan mai sunat ju sravan hoo(n) sunayo chaahai anahadh sabadh prasa(n)n hui sunaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am listening your elixir-like words in my ears; and if I ever desire to hear anything else with these ears, then bless me with hearing of unstruck tune of Naam Simran perpetually. "}}},{"verse_id":210258,"page_no":null,"line_no":631,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਮੈ ਰਟਤ ਜੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਹੂੰ ਰਸੈ ਚਾਹੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੁਆਇ ਕੈ ਚਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa mai raTat ju rasanaa hoo(n) rasai chaahai prem ras a(n)mirat chuaai kai chakhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My tongue is continuously recalling Lord's name and if my tongue desires to relish some other elixir, then please bless me with perpetual flow of elixir-like Naam (in my tenth door). "}}},{"verse_id":210259,"page_no":null,"line_no":631,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਯਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੬੨੨॥","translit_en":"man meh basahu mal mayaa keejai mahaaraaj dhaavat baraj unaman liv laieeaai ||622||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my Great True Guru! Be clement on me and reside in my heart for ever. Please stop my wandering mind going all over and then engross it in high spiritual state.  (622)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41657,"next":41659}}
files.shabads/83/41659.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41659,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210260","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210260,"last_verse_id":210263,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210260,"page_no":null,"line_no":632,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਧਉ ਜਾਇ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਧਉ ਖਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਜਰਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ni(n)dhraa mai kahaa dhau jai khudhiaa mai kahaa dhau khai tirakhaa mai kahaa jarai kahaa jal paan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where does a man reach while asleep? How does he eat when hungry? When thirst flares up, how does it satisfy it ? And where does the water consumed creates calmness?"}}},{"verse_id":210261,"page_no":null,"line_no":632,"gurmukhi":"ਹਸਨ ਰੋਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਨਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਕਹਾਂ ਭਯ ਭਾਉ ਭੀਰ ਕਹਾ ਧਉ ਭਯਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"hasan rovan kahaa kahaa pun chi(n)taa chaau kahaa(n) bhay bhaau bheer kahaa dhau bhayaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How does it cry or laugh? Then what is worry and glee or elation? What is fear and what is love? What is cowardice and to what extent is dreadfulness?"}}},{"verse_id":210262,"page_no":null,"line_no":632,"gurmukhi":"ਹਿਚਕੀ ਡਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਖੰਘਾਰ ਜੰਮਹਾਈ ਛੀਕ ਅਪਸਰ ਗਾਤ ਖੁਜਲਾਤ ਕਹਾ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"hichakee ddakaar aau kha(n)ghaar ja(n)mahaiee chheek apasar gaat khujalaat kahaa aan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where and how does hiccups, belching, phlegm, yawn, sneeze, passing of wind, scratching of body and many other such-like things happen?"}}},{"verse_id":210263,"page_no":null,"line_no":632,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਤ ਅਉ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੨੩॥","translit_en":"kaam krodh lobh moh aha(n)mev Tev kahaa(n) sat aau sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam na jaan hai ||623||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What is the nature of lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride? Similarly reality of truth, contentment, kindness and righteousness cannot be known.  (623)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41658,"next":41660}}
files.shabads/83/41660.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41660,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210264","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210264,"last_verse_id":210267,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210264,"page_no":null,"line_no":633,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲ ਪਿੰਡ ਲੋਕ ਬੇਦ ਕਹੈਂ  ਪਾਂਚੋ ਤਤ ਕਹੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਰਚਤ ਭੇ ਆਦਿ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ch tat mel pi(n)dd lok bedh kahai(n)  paa(n)cho tat kaho kaahe bhaa(n)t rachat bhe aadh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Common knowledge, Vedas and other religious scriptures say that body is made of five elements. But tell me, how have these five elements come into existence?"}}},{"verse_id":210265,"page_no":null,"line_no":633,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੇ ਸੇ ਧਰਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਧੀਰਜ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਿਥਾਰੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਿਉਂ ਗੜਿਓ ਅਕਾਸ ਠਾਢੋ ਬਿਨ ਪਾਦ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaahe se dharan dhaaree dheeraj kaise bithaaree kaahe siau(n) gaRio akaas Thaaddo bin paadh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How is Earth supported and how is patience spread in it? How is sky secured and how is it existing without any support?"}}},{"verse_id":210266,"page_no":null,"line_no":633,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਹੇ ਸੌਂ ਸਲਿਲ ਸਾਜੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਪਵਨ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਪਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaahe saua(n) salil saaje seetal pavan baaje agan tapat kaahe at bisamaadh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How is water made? How does breeze blow? How is fire hot? All this is very wondrous."}}},{"verse_id":210267,"page_no":null,"line_no":633,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨਾਥ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਕਨੋ ਹੈ ਬਾਦ ਜੀ ॥੬੨੪॥","translit_en":"kaaran karan dhev alakh abhev naath un kee bhee ohee jaanai bakano hai baadh jee ||624||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The effulgent Lord is beyond comprehension. No one can know His secret. He is the cause of all happenings. He alone knows the secret of all these things. So it is futile for us to make any statement in connection with creation of Universe.  (624)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41659,"next":41661}}
files.shabads/83/41661.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41661,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210268","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210268,"last_verse_id":210271,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210268,"page_no":null,"line_no":634,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਸਿੰਚ ਸਿੰਚ ਕਾਸਟ ਸਮਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਲ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਪੁਨਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal si(n)ch si(n)ch kaasaT samath keene jal sanaba(n)dh pun bohithaa bisavaiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wood is strengthened by drenching it in water for long and then its relation with water by which a faith develops that water will not sink the wood since it has brought it, up; ships are made with it that sail across the sea."}}},{"verse_id":210269,"page_no":null,"line_no":634,"gurmukhi":"ਪਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਸਟ ਸ੍ਰੀ-ਖੰਡ ਹੋਤ ਮਲਯਾ ਗਿਰ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁ ਮੰਡ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pavan prasa(n)g soiee kaasaT sree-kha(n)dd hot malayaa gir baasanaa su ma(n)dd paragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fragrance of sandalwood of Malay mountain causes happiness. The woods and plants that have been touched by that fragrant breeze also acquire the fragrance of sandalwood."}}},{"verse_id":210270,"page_no":null,"line_no":634,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਵਕ ਪਰਸ ਭਸਮੀ ਕਰਤ ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ  ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paavak paras bhasamee karat dheh geh  mitr satr sagal sa(n)saar hee binaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The same wood reduces houses to ashes when it unites with fire. It also consumes friends, enemies and the whole world."}}},{"verse_id":210271,"page_no":null,"line_no":634,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ॥੬੨੫॥","translit_en":"taise aatamaa tiragun tirabidh sakal siv saadh sa(n)g bheTat hee saadh ko abhiaas hai ||625||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wood interacts with water, wind, and fire differently, the human soul deals with Rajo, Tamo, and Sato differently. But by meeting with the True Guru and practicing his teachings, one becomes perfect and blissful. (625)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41660,"next":41662}}
files.shabads/83/41662.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41662,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210272","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210272,"last_verse_id":210275,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210272,"page_no":null,"line_no":635,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ  ਕਵਨ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kavan a(n)jan kar lochan bilokeeat  kavan ku(n)ddal kar sravan suneejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the use of which collyrium in the eyes can one see the beloved Lord? What ear-rings can help hear his sound?"}}},{"verse_id":210273,"page_no":null,"line_no":635,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨ ਤੰਮੋਲ ਕਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਰਸੈ  ਕਉਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਕਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kavan ta(n)mol kar rasanaa sujas rasai  kaun kar ka(n)kan namasakaar keejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Which betel leaf when chewed can help the tongue repeat the supreme praise of the beloved Lord? What bangles should be worn in the hands to greet and salute Him?"}}},{"verse_id":210274,"page_no":null,"line_no":635,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਹਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਅਤ  ਕਉਨ ਅੰਗੀਆ ਸੁ ਕਰ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kavan kusam haar kar ur dhaareeat  kaun a(n)geeaa su kar a(n)kamaal dheejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What flower garland can make Him reside in the heart? What bodice should be worn to embrace Him with hands?"}}},{"verse_id":210275,"page_no":null,"line_no":635,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਨ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਪੇਟ ਲੀਜੈ  ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥੬੨੬॥","translit_en":"kaun heer cheer lapaTai kai lapeT leejai  kavan sa(n)jog pirayaa prem ras peejeeaai ||626||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What dress and diamond can be worn to entice Him? With what method can the union of the beloved be relished? The crux of the whole thing is that all embellishments are worthless. Relishing His love can only unite one with Him.  (626)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41661,"next":41663}}
files.shabads/83/41663.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41663,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210276","verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":210276,"last_verse_id":210281,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210276,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਗਵਰਿ ਮਹੇਸ ਅਉ ਗਨੇਸ ਸੇ ਸਹਸਰਸੁ ","translit_en":"gavar mahes aau ganes se sahasaras ","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(In this Kabitt, Bhai Sahib has used the metaphor of a Hindu maid who is seeking blessings of various gods and goddesses for a suitable union in marriage)"}}},{"verse_id":210277,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ਹੁਇ ॥","translit_en":"poojaa kar benatee bakhaanio hit cheet hui ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Parbati, Shiv ji, Ganesh Ji, Surya god, I pray and beg you to be kind to me, be my well-wishers."}}},{"verse_id":210278,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਗੁਨ ਲਗਨ ਗ੍ਰਹ  ਸੁਭ ਦਿਨ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਨੀਤ ਹੁਇ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ddit jotik sodh sagun lagan greh  subh dhin saahaa likh dheh bedh neet hui ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Priest, 0 astrologer! tell me of an auspicious day according to vedas."}}},{"verse_id":210279,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਾੜਹੁ ਤਿਲਕ ਤੇਲ ਮਾਥੈ ਰਸ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੁਇ ॥","translit_en":"sagal kuTa(n)b sakhee ma(n)gal gaavahu mil chaaRahu tilak tel maathai ras reet hui ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O all my relatives and friends! sing wedding songs, put oil in my hair and anoint me with saffron as is the customs in a marriage."}}},{"verse_id":210280,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਦੀ ਰਚਿ ਗਾਂਠ ਜੋਰ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਅਸੀਸ ਮੋਹਿ","translit_en":"bedhee rach gaa(n)Th jor dheejeeaai asees moh","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Raise and decorate the Bedi (sacred place where Hindu marriage rites are performed) for my marriage and bless me that I may have full devotion and love for my beloved Lord Husband, when I meet Him."}}},{"verse_id":210281,"page_no":null,"line_no":636,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤ ਹੁਇ ॥੬੨੭॥","translit_en":"sihajaa sa(n)jog mai prateet preet reet hui ||627||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(In essence the Kabbit invokes blessings of friends for a seeker woman who is craving to get married to her Lord-husband.)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41662,"next":41664}}
files.shabads/83/41664.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41664,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210282","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210282,"last_verse_id":210285,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210282,"page_no":null,"line_no":637,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੋਚਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"sees gur charan karan upadhes dheekhiaa lochan dharas avilok sukh paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O True Guru! be kind and let my head be in the feet of the True Guru, my ears be always attentive to listen to the words divine, my eyes be seeing your glimpse and thus bless me with true happiness."}}},{"verse_id":210283,"page_no":null,"line_no":637,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਗੁਰ ਹਸਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਡੰਡੌਤ  ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa sabadh gur hasat sevaa dda(n)ddauat  ridhai gur giaan unaman liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O True Guru! be kind and bless me that my tongue may ever repeat and utter the ambrosial words that Guru has blessed me with, the hands may indulge in the service and salutation, the words of wisdom may remain installed in my mind and thus fix my consciousness in higher state of spirituality."}}},{"verse_id":210284,"page_no":null,"line_no":637,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਗਵਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਮਾ ਲਉ  ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"charan gavan saadh sa(n)gat parakramaa lau  dhaasan dhaasaan mat ni(n)mrataa samaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May my feet advance towards holy Sangat and circumambulate them, and thus absorb my mind in the humility possessed by slaves of the servants. "}}},{"verse_id":210285,"page_no":null,"line_no":637,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਜਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਦੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੈਜ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਈਐ ॥੬੨੮॥","translit_en":"sa(n)t ren majan bhagat bhaau bhojan dhai sree gur kirapaa kai prem paij pragaTaieeaai ||628||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O True Guru! enlighten in me the loving respect by Your grace, making me dependent upon those holy and noble souls whose support is Lord's name. Grant me their company and food of loving devotion to survive on.  (628)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41663,"next":41665}}
files.shabads/83/41665.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41665,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210286","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210286,"last_verse_id":210289,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210286,"page_no":null,"line_no":638,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਾ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਬਰਖੈ ਸਮਾਨ  ਊਚੋ ਤਜ ਨੀਚੈ ਥਲ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise megh barakhaa sarabatr barakhai samaan  uoocho taj neechai thal gavan kai jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as rain falls alike all over, and the water falling on higher ground flow down to lower ground automatically."}}},{"verse_id":210287,"page_no":null,"line_no":638,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਪਰਬ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਚਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੇਤ ਦੇਤ ਦਾਨ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"teerath parab jaise jaat hai jagat chal jaatraa het dhet dhaan at bigasaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as on festivals people go to places of pilgrimage and feels happy making charities."}}},{"verse_id":210288,"page_no":null,"line_no":638,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਬੈਠਿਓ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਪੈ  ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੇ ਦਰਬ ਆਵੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nirap sobhat hai baiThio si(n)ghaasan pai  chahoo(n) or te dharab aavai dhin raat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king sits on throne and earns admirations, he receives gifts and offerings from all sides both during day and night."}}},{"verse_id":210289,"page_no":null,"line_no":638,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਚਲ ਆਵਤ ਜੁਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੨੯॥","translit_en":"taise nihakaam dhaam saadh hai sa(n)saar bikhai asan basan chal aavat jugaat hai ||629||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the house of God-like True Guru is without desires. Like the rain water, charity at places of pilgrimage and the king, food items, clothes and money of Daswandh keep pouring in the house of the True Guru. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41664,"next":41666}}
files.shabads/83/41666.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41666,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210290","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210290,"last_verse_id":210293,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210290,"page_no":null,"line_no":639,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਨ ਧਨੁਖ ਸਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਜ ਬਸ ਛੂਟਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਤਨ ਸੈ ਹਾਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baan dhanukh sahit hui nij bas chhooTat na aavai fun jatan sai haath jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an arrow is in full control (of the warrior) as long as it remains in the bow, but once released cannot come back howsoever one may try."}}},{"verse_id":210291,"page_no":null,"line_no":639,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਘ ਬੰਦਸਾਲਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਂਧਿੳੋ ਰਹੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਖੁਲੈ ਤਉ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਸਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baagh ba(n)dhasaalaa bikhai baa(n)dhiuo rahai pun khulai tau na aavai bas baseh na saath jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lion remains in a cage, but when released cannot be brought under control. Once out of control, it cannot be tamed."}}},{"verse_id":210292,"page_no":null,"line_no":639,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਦਾਵਾਨਲ ਭਏ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਦੁਰੈ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep dhipat na jaaneeaai bhavan bikhai dhaavaanal bhe na dhuraae dhurai naath jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the heat of a lit lamp is not felt by anybody in the house, but if it becomes the fire of the jungle (spreads in the house) then it becomes uncontrollable."}}},{"verse_id":210293,"page_no":null,"line_no":639,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਮਧ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਸਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਖੈ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਥ ਜੀ ॥੬੩੦॥","translit_en":"taise mukh madh baanee basat na kouoo lakhai boleeaai bichaar gurmat gun gaath jee ||630||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, like an arrow released from the bow, words spoken cannot be taken back. Therefore one should always think and reflect on what one is about to say and all conversation should be in accordance with the wisdom bestowed by the Guru. (630)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41665,"next":41667}}
files.shabads/83/41667.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41667,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210294","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210294,"last_verse_id":210297,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210294,"page_no":null,"line_no":640,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੁ ਪੋਈਅਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰ ਕੈ  ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੰਖਿਆ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maalaa mer poieeat sabh uoopar kai  simaran sa(n)khiaa mai na aavat baddaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as main bead in a rosary is always put in the string first but being at higher place is not considered along with the other beads when the rosary is turned."}}},{"verse_id":210295,"page_no":null,"line_no":640,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਖਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਸੇਬਲ ਊਚੋ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਭਇਓ ਸੋਊ ਅਤਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birakhan bikhai pekheeaai sebal uoocho nihafal bhio souoo at adhikaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The silk cotton tree is the tallest and mighty among the trees yet it bears useless fruits."}}},{"verse_id":210296,"page_no":null,"line_no":640,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਲ ਪੰਛੀਨ ਮੈ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ  ਹੇਰੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਿੰਜਰਨ ਊਚੈ ਮਤੁ ਪਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise cheel pa(n)chheen mai uddat akaasachaaree  herai mirat pi(n)jaran uoochai mat paiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as of all the birds that fly high, an eagle is supreme but when flying high, it only looks for dead bodies. What use is its ability to fly high?"}}},{"verse_id":210297,"page_no":null,"line_no":640,"gurmukhi":"ਗਾਇਬੋ ਬਜਾਇਬੋ ਸੁਨਾਇਬੋ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਤੈਸੇ  ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੬੩੧॥","translit_en":"gaibo bajaibo sunaibo na kachhoo taise  gur upadhes binaa dhirag chaturaiee kai ||631||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, without the teachings of True Guru, arrogant, cleverness is condemnable. Loud singing, playing or recitation of such a person is meaningless.  (631)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41666,"next":41668}}
files.shabads/83/41668.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41668,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210298","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210298,"last_verse_id":210301,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210298,"page_no":null,"line_no":641,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਤਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਨਵਨ ਮਨ  ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਉਤਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਤ ਸਭ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paa(n)cho tat bikhai basudhaa navan man  taa(n) mai utapat hui samaat sabh taahee mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Earth is most humble out of the five elements. That is why it produces so much and all that goes back to it."}}},{"verse_id":210299,"page_no":null,"line_no":641,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਆਂਗੁਰੀ ਮੈ ਸੂਖਮ ਕਨੁੰਗ੍ਰੀਆ ਹੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਖਚਤ ਨਗ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paa(n)cho aa(n)guree mai sookham kanu(n)greeaa hai ka(n)chan khachat nag sobhat hai vaahee mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the little finger of the hand is smallest and frail looking, yet a diamond ring is worn in it."}}},{"verse_id":210300,"page_no":null,"line_no":641,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਚ ਜੋਨ ਗਨੀਅਤ ਅਤਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਮਧੁ ਉਪਜਤ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise neech jon ganeeat at maakhee kiram heer cheer madh upajat sukh jaahee mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as fly and other insects are counted among the low species, yet some of them produce such valuable things like silk, pearls, honey etc;"}}},{"verse_id":210301,"page_no":null,"line_no":641,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਦਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਹੀਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥੬੩੨॥","translit_en":"taise ravidhaas naamaa bidhar kabeer bhe heen jaat uooch padh paae sabh kaahee mai ||632||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, saints like Bhagat Kabir, Namdev Ji, Bidar and Ravi Das Ji being low born have attained a much higher spiritual level who have blessed humanity with their precept that have made their life peaceful and comfortable."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41667,"next":41669}}
files.shabads/83/41669.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41669,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210302","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210302,"last_verse_id":210305,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210302,"page_no":null,"line_no":642,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਨ ਬੈਦ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਬਿਨ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਾਧ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise rog rogee ko dhikhaieeaai na baidh prat bin upachaar chhin chhin hui asaadh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the ailment of a patient if not told to a physician becomes beyond treatment with every passing moment."}}},{"verse_id":210303,"page_no":null,"line_no":642,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਉਦਮ ਅਦਿਆਉ ਬਿਨ ਮੂਲ ਅਉ ਬਿਆਜ ਬਢੈ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਆਧ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise rin dhin dhin udham adhiaau bin mool aau biaaj baddai upajai biaadh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the interest on the borrowed money increases every day if the principle amount is not returned leading to greater problem."}}},{"verse_id":210304,"page_no":null,"line_no":642,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਬਿਨ ਪਲ ਪਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੁਇ ਕਰਤ ਉਪਾਧ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise satr saasanaa sa(n)graam kar saadhe bin pal pal prabal hui karat upaadh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the enemy though warned, if not sorted out in time, makes him powerful with every passing day, can raise rebellion one day."}}},{"verse_id":210305,"page_no":null,"line_no":642,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉਂ ਜਿਉਂ ਭੀਜੈ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਤਿਉਂ ਤਿਉਂ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ  ਬਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਜੀ ॥੬੩੩॥","translit_en":"jiau(n) jiau(n) bheejai kaamaree tiau(n) tiau(n) bhaaree hot jaat  bin satigur ur basai aparaadh jee ||633||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, without obtaining true precept from the True Guru, sin resides in the mind of a mammon-effected human being. This sin increases further if not controlled.  (633)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41668,"next":41670}}
files.shabads/83/41670.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41670,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210306","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210306,"last_verse_id":210309,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210306,"page_no":null,"line_no":643,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੇਲਾ ਬਸਤ ਬਬੂਰ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਸਾਲਤ ਹੈਂ ਸੂਰੈਂ ਆਪਾ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਬਚਾਇ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kelaa basat baboor kai nikaT taa(n)h saalat hai(n) soorai(n) aapaa sakai na bachai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as leaves of a plaintain tree are torn by the thorns of an acacia tree growing within its proximity, it can not free itself from the hold of the thorns without damaging itself."}}},{"verse_id":210307,"page_no":null,"line_no":643,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਸੂਆ ਪੜਤ ਗਾਥਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pi(n)jaree mai sooaa paRat gaathaa anek dhin prat herat bilaiee a(n)t khai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a parrot in a small cage learns much but he is watched by a cat who one day catches it and eats it up."}}},{"verse_id":210308,"page_no":null,"line_no":643,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰ ਮੁਦਤ ਮਨ ਹੋਤ ਮੀਨ ਮਾਸ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਲੇਤ ਬਨਛੀ ਲਗਾਇ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal a(n)tar mudhat man hot meen maas lapaTai let banachhee lagai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fish feels happy living in water but an angler throws the bait tied at the end of a strong thread and the fish is enticed to eat it. When the fish bites the bait, it bites the hook as well making it convenient for the angler to pull it out."}}},{"verse_id":210309,"page_no":null,"line_no":643,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੬੩੪॥","translit_en":"bin satigur saadh milat asaadh sa(n)g a(n)g a(n)g dhuramat gat pragaTai jee ||634||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, without meeting the God-like True Guru, and keeping company of base people, one acquires base wisdom that becomes the cause of his falling in the hands of angels of death.  (634)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41669,"next":41671}}
files.shabads/83/41671.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41671,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210310","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210310,"last_verse_id":210313,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210310,"page_no":null,"line_no":644,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਾਜੈ ਜਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੁਤ ਨ ਖਿਲਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koT parakaar naar saajai jau si(n)gaar chaar bin bharataar bheTai sut na khilai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A woman may adore herself with very attractive embellishments but without surrendering to her husband, cannot enjoy the pleasure of playing with her son."}}},{"verse_id":210311,"page_no":null,"line_no":644,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਚੀਐ ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਮੂਲ ਫੁਲ ਨ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਿਨ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"si(n)cheeaai salil nis baasur birakh mool ful na basa(n)t bin taas pragaTai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a tree is watered day and night, it can not bloom with flowers in any other season than spring."}}},{"verse_id":210312,"page_no":null,"line_no":644,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਵਨ ਸਮੈ ਕਿਸਾਨ ਖੇਤ ਜੋਤ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਵੈ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤ ਨਾਜ ਨਿਪਜਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saavan samai kisaan khet jot beej bovai barakhaa bihoon kat naaj nipajai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a farmer ploughs his field and sows seed in it even in the month of Sawan, then without rain the seed cannot sprout. "}}},{"verse_id":210313,"page_no":null,"line_no":644,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪ ਨ ਜਗਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੬੩੫॥","translit_en":"anik prakaar bhekh dhaar praanee bhramai bhoom bin gur ur giaan dheep na jagai hai ||635||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a man may dress himself in any number of disguises and wander the world over. Even then he cannot acquire the radiance of knowledge without the initiation of the True Guru and receiving His precept.  (635)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41670,"next":41672}}
files.shabads/83/41672.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41672,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210314","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210314,"last_verse_id":210317,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210314,"page_no":null,"line_no":645,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰ ਖੀਰ ਅੰਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਖੁਵਾਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਰੋ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਅਜਾ ਸ੍ਵਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise neer kheer a(n)n bhojan khuvai a(n)t garo kaaT maarat hai ajaa savain kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a male off-spring of a goat, (a he-goat) is brought up by feeding him with milk and food, and at last he is killed by cutting his neck."}}},{"verse_id":210315,"page_no":null,"line_no":645,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਲਘੂ ਨੌਕਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੂਡਤ ਹੈ ਮਾਝਧਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਗਵਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bahu bhaar ddaareeat laghoo nauakaa maeh booddat hai maajhadhaar paar na gavan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a small boat is loaded with excessive baggage, then it sinks in the middle of a river where the water is more turbulent. It cannot reach the far bank."}}},{"verse_id":210316,"page_no":null,"line_no":645,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਤਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਮੈ ਅਰਪਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਭਵਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bur naar dhaar bharan si(n)gaar tan aap aamai arapat chi(n)taa kai bhavan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a prostitute adorns herself with make up and ornaments to excite other males for indulging in vices with her, she herself acquires disease and worry in life."}}},{"verse_id":210317,"page_no":null,"line_no":645,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਅਧਰਮ ਨਰ ਮਰਤ ਅਕਾਲ ਜਮ-ਲੋਕਹ ਰਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੬੩੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee adharam karam kai adharam nar marat akaal jama-lokeh ravan kau ||636||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an immoral person dies before his death by indulging in unrighteous deeds. And when he reaches Yamlok (abode of angels of death), he bears more punishment and pain.  (636)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41671,"next":41673}}
files.shabads/83/41673.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41673,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210318","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210318,"last_verse_id":210321,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210318,"page_no":null,"line_no":646,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਚੈ ਛੁਅਤ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਛਿਨਕ ਛੋਤ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise paakasaalaa baalaa bi(n)jan anek rachai chhuat apaavan chhinak chhot laag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman cooks many dishes in a kitchen but a small act of unholiness makes the food contaminated or sullied."}}},{"verse_id":210319,"page_no":null,"line_no":646,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਸਾਜਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਕੈ ਪੁਹਪਵੰਤੀ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tan saajat si(n)gaar naar aana(n)dh kai puhapava(n)tee hui pirayaa sihajaa tiaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman embellishes her body and enjoys the union with her husband, but if her menstruation is due, the husband refrains from sharing bed with her."}}},{"verse_id":210320,"page_no":null,"line_no":646,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਭ-ਧਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਲ ਮੈ ਗਰਭ ਛੇਦ ਖੇਦ ਨਿਹਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise grabha-dhaar naar jatan karat nit mal mai garabh chhedh khedh nihabhaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman makes every effort for the safety of her pregnancy, but if her menstruation re-starts, there is every fear of miscarriage. She then feels distressed and is called unfortunate."}}},{"verse_id":210321,"page_no":null,"line_no":646,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਤੂਲ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੬੩੭॥","translit_en":"taise seel sa(n)jam janam paraja(n)t keejai tanak hee paap ke'ee tool mai bajaag hai ||637||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, one should maintain disciplined life and piety of actions. But, if even a small sin is committed, it is like a dreadful fire in a bail of cotton. (One small wrong act destroys all the goodness that had been earned.)  (637)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41672,"next":41674}}
files.shabads/83/41674.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41674,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210322","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210322,"last_verse_id":210325,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210322,"page_no":null,"line_no":647,"gurmukhi":"ਚੀਕਨੇ ਕਲਸ ਪਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਜ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਖੇਤ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"cheekane kalas par jaise naa Tikat boo(n)dh kaalar mai pare naaj nipajai na khet jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a drop of water does not rest on a greasy pitcher and no seed grows in a saline soil."}}},{"verse_id":210323,"page_no":null,"line_no":647,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਿ ਪਰ ਤਰੁ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਅਫਲ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਤ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhar par tar se(n)bal afal ar bikhiaa birakh fale jag dhukh dhet jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as silk cotton tree is bereft of fruit on this earth, and just as a poisonous tree causes much trouble to the people."}}},{"verse_id":210324,"page_no":null,"line_no":647,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸੀਐ ਨਾ ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਮਲ ਮੂਤਤਾ ਸਮੇਤ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan subaas baa(n)s baas baas baaseeaai naa pavan gavan mal mootataa samet jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bamboo tree acquires no fragrance despite living near a sandalwood tree, and just as the air blowing over filth acquires the same bad odour."}}},{"verse_id":210325,"page_no":null,"line_no":647,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨ ਮੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਿਦੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨੋ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਲੇਤ ਜੀ ॥੬੩੮॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes paraves na mo ridhai bhidhai jaise maano savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh eh mukh let jee ||638||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru's sermon does not pierce my heart (it creates no ambrosial elixir). On the contrary, it feels as if a snake has just taken 'swati\" (first droplet of rain) drop in its mouth. (Swati drop in a snake's mouth can only become venom and not pearl). (638)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41673,"next":41675}}
files.shabads/83/41675.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41675,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210326","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210326,"last_verse_id":210329,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210326,"page_no":null,"line_no":648,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਬਸਿ ਬਾਂਸ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਆਨ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੂਰ ਭਏ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep bas baa(n)s mahimaa na jaanee aan dhrum dhoor bhe baasanaa kai bohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bamboo has not known the merits of a sandalwood tree having lived near it, but other trees though far away from it still acquire its fragrance."}}},{"verse_id":210327,"page_no":null,"line_no":648,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਮੈਂ ਜਾਨੇ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਹੀ ਬਿਮੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar sarovar mai(n) jaane na kamal gat makara(n)dh kar madhukar hee bimohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A frog knows not the goodness of a lotus flower though it stays in the same pond, but bumble bees are crazy of the nectar that is stored in these flowers."}}},{"verse_id":210328,"page_no":null,"line_no":648,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਗ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨ ਮਰਮ ਕਛੂ ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਤ੍ਰੀ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੇਤ ਸੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"surasaree bikhai bag jaanio na maram kachhoo aavat hai jaatree ja(n)tr jaatraa het sohe hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An egret living in the waters of river Ganges does not know the importance of that water, but many people come to the river Ganges on a pilgrimage and feel honoured."}}},{"verse_id":210329,"page_no":null,"line_no":648,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਕਟ ਬਸਤ ਮਮ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੀਨ ਦੂਰ ਹੀ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰ ਲੈ ਪੋਹੇ ਹੈ ॥੬੩੯॥","translit_en":"nikaT basat mam gur upadhes heen dhoor hee dhisa(n)tar ur a(n)tar lai pohe hai ||639||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, though I live near the True Guru, I am bereft of the knowledge of His advice whereas people from far off places come to the True Guru, obtain His sermon and abides it in their heart. (639)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41674,"next":41676}}
files.shabads/83/41676.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41676,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210330","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210330,"last_verse_id":210333,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210330,"page_no":null,"line_no":649,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਹਿਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਲੋਨੇ ਹੈ ਨ ਲੋਇਨ ਜੋ ਲਾਲਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"naahin anoop roop chitavai kiau chi(n)taaman lone hai na loin jo laalan bilokeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My looks are not attractive. Then how can I remember and conceive the beautiful? Lord the fulfiller of desires Lord? My eyes are not good looking; then how can I see the glimpse of that beloved Lord?"}}},{"verse_id":210331,"page_no":null,"line_no":649,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨਉ ਕੈਸੇ  ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਚਨ ਮਧੋਕੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa raseelee naeh benatee bakhaanau kaise  surat na sravanan bachan madhokeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My tongue is not ambrosial. Then how can I make an effective request to my beloved? I do not have such power of hearing that I can enjoy the honey-like words of my beloved Lord?"}}},{"verse_id":210332,"page_no":null,"line_no":649,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਰ ਮਾਲ ਕਰਉ ਮਸਤਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪਗ ਧੋਕੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g heen dheen kaise bar maal karau masatak naeh bhaag piray pag dhokeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am weak and imperfect in every part of my body. Then how can I make a superior rosary of remembrance of my Lord's name? I have no I can bank upon to wash the feet of my beloved."}}},{"verse_id":210333,"page_no":null,"line_no":649,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਵਕ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਹੁਚ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਸੇਵ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਸਮੋਕੀਐ ॥੬੪੦॥","translit_en":"sevak savaibhaav naeh pahuch na sakau sev naahin prateet prabh prabhataa samokeeaai ||640||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I do not have the temperament of service in my heart; so I cannot reach for the service of my beloved. Nor do I have that devotion through which I can become one with the greatness of the dear Lord. (The greatness of the Lord may reside in me.)  (640)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41675,"next":41677}}
files.shabads/83/41677.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41677,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210334","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210334,"last_verse_id":210337,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210334,"page_no":null,"line_no":650,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ਬਿਨ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"besavaiaa ke si(n)gaar bibhachaar ko na paaraavaar  bin bharataar naar kaa kee kai bulaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For immoral acts, there is no end for a whore to do up her ornamentation and embellishment. But without a husband, whose wife would she be called as?"}}},{"verse_id":210335,"page_no":null,"line_no":650,"gurmukhi":"ਬਗ ਸੇਤ ਗਾਤ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਕੇਤੇ  ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"bag set gaat jeev ghaat kar khaat kete  mon gahe dhiaan dhare jugat na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The looks of a heron are like that of a swan but it kills many living beings to eat them up. He silently sits in contemplation but such contemplation cannot reach one to the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":210336,"page_no":null,"line_no":650,"gurmukhi":"ਡਾਂਡ ਕੀ ਡੰਡਾਈ ਬੁਰਵਾਈ ਨ ਕਹਿਤ ਆਵੈ  ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਸੁਕੁਚਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"ddaa(n)dd kee dda(n)ddaiee buravaiee na kahit aavai  at hee ddiThaiee sukuchat na lajaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The shameless words and foul acts of a Bhand (low caste persons who entertain people on their happy functions) are beyond description. Due to their extreme impudence, they never feel shy of saying and doing anything. "}}},{"verse_id":210337,"page_no":null,"line_no":650,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ  ਪਤਿਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਈਐ ॥੬੪੧॥","translit_en":"taise par tan dhan dhookhanaa tiradhokh mam  patit anek ek rom na pujaieeaai ||641||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, like the incurable and deadly disease, I am infested with the ailments of looking at other's woman, other's wealth and slander. Sins of every hair of my body are more intense than the myriad sins of many sinners."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41676,"next":41678}}
files.shabads/83/41678.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41678,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210338","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210338,"last_verse_id":210341,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210338,"page_no":null,"line_no":651,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ  ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਸਊਤੈ ਸਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa kai naikaa anek ek se adhik ek  pooran suhaag bhaag suootai sam dhaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A beloved husband who has many wives and each one better than the other, each one enjoys all the love, attention of husband and other comforts of life."}}},{"verse_id":210339,"page_no":null,"line_no":651,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਨ ਹੁਇ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗ ਬਿਛੁਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਰਹੀ  ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਲਗ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਭਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maanan hui maan bha(n)g bichhur bidhes rahee  bireh biyog lag birahanee bhaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Separated from her dear husband and living far away from him, she feels her respect getting compromised, beside bearing the pangs of separation and thus is called separated."}}},{"verse_id":210340,"page_no":null,"line_no":651,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਥਲ ਸਮਾਨ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਸਕੇ ਨ ਰਿਝਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਦਇਓ ਹੈ ਦੁਹਾਗ ਵੈ ਦੁਹਾਗਨ ਸਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sithal samaan treeyaa sake na rijhai piray dhio hai dhuhaag vai dhuhaagan sanaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like lazy people, idle wife cannot please her husband and as a result she is known as one who has been abandoned by her husband."}}},{"verse_id":210341,"page_no":null,"line_no":651,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜੀਹ ਕਰ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ  ਪਰਸਿਓ ਨ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥੬੪੨॥","translit_en":"lochan sravan jeeh kar a(n)g a(n)g heen  parasio na pekhio sunio mero kahaa naam hai ||642||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have not felt my beloved with any part of my body. I have not seen Him with my eyes, not heard His praises with my ears, not uttered His name with my tongue nor have I done any service with my hands. Bereft of all these, with what name can I be called?"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41677,"next":41679}}
files.shabads/83/41679.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41679,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210342","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210342,"last_verse_id":210345,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210342,"page_no":null,"line_no":652,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਰ ਚੋਰ ਓਰ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਨ ਆਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਕਲ ਭੂਤ ਹੇਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jaar chor or herat na aaeh kouoo chor jaar jaanat sakal bhoot herahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in normal circumstances no one pays attention to a thief or a paramour, but once it becomes known, they look like demons."}}},{"verse_id":210343,"page_no":null,"line_no":652,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਮੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪੈਸਤ ਸੰਕਾਤ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhin samai aavaa gavan bhavan bikhai taahee gireh paisat sa(n)kaat hai a(n)dher hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one keeps going in and out of a house freely, but at night during darkness one feels scared of entering the same house."}}},{"verse_id":210344,"page_no":null,"line_no":652,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ  ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਭਇਆਨ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਹ ਤ੍ਰਾਹ ਟੇਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dharamaatamaa kau dhekheeaai dharamarai  paapee kau bhiaan jam traeh traeh Terahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the Yamraj (angel of death) is the King of righteousness for a righteous person at the time of his death, but the same Yamraj is a demon for a sinner who. appears to him as a demon and he shouts for help for his safety. "}}},{"verse_id":210345,"page_no":null,"line_no":652,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਪਨ ਰੂਪ  ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਫੇਰ ਹੀ ॥੬੪੩॥","translit_en":"taise niravair satigur dharapan roop  taiso hee dhikhaavai mukh jaise jaise fer hee ||643||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the True Guru is sans enmity, with a heart as clear and clean as a mirror. He wishes ill of no one. But with whatever type of face one turns towards Him, he sees the True Guru in the same form (For righteous people, He is love and for sinners he is a monster).  (643)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41678,"next":41680}}
files.shabads/83/41680.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41680,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210346","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210346,"last_verse_id":210349,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210346,"page_no":null,"line_no":653,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਸੁਧ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ  ਉਲਟ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਇਆਨ ਸੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dharapan soodho sudh mukh dhekheeat  ulaT kai dhekhai mukh dhekheeaai bhiaan so ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the image is real when the mirror is held straight and it becomes aberrated, when the mirror is held upside down. The face looks awful."}}},{"verse_id":210347,"page_no":null,"line_no":653,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕੌਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਉਰ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan taahee rasanaa sai piaaro laagai  kauarak sabadh sun laagai ur baan so ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sweet words uttered by tongue feel loving to the ears, but bitter words said with the same tongue hurt like arrow."}}},{"verse_id":210348,"page_no":null,"line_no":653,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਨੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਮਿਸ਼ਟ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮੁਖ  ਪੋਸਤ ਕੈ ਪੀਏ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਸਾਨ ਸੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhaano khaat gaat pushaT mishaT savaiaadh mukh  posat kai pe'ee dhukh biaapat masaan so ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as food eaten with the mouth leaves a good taste in the mouth and if poppy extract is consumed with the same mouth, it is distressing and one gets feeling of near death."}}},{"verse_id":210349,"page_no":null,"line_no":653,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ  ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਮਤ ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਭਾਨੁ ਸੋ ॥੬੪੪॥","translit_en":"taise bhirat ni(n)dhak savaibhaav chakiee chakor  satigur samat sahan seel bhaan so ||644||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a true servant of the True Guru and a slander are like the Chakvi and Chakor (Chakvi longs for the light of the sun while a Chakor desires setting of the sun). The True Guru's nature is like a sun that provides light to all equally. (644)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41679,"next":41681}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41681,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210350","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210350,"last_verse_id":210353,"source_english":"Bhai
