Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210350,"page_no":null,"line_no":654,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਟੇਰ ਹੇਰੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਵੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau papeehaa piray piray Ter herai boo(n)dh vaise patibrataa patibrat pratipaal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a rain-bird longing for a Swati drop keep wailing making sound of  ' Peeu, Peeu' similarly a faithful wife fulfills her wifely duties remembering her husband, "}}},{"verse_id":210351,"page_no":null,"line_no":654,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਪੇਖਿ ਜ੍ਵਾਰਾ ਜਰੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep dhipat pata(n)g pekh javaiaaraa jarai taise priaa prem nem premanee samhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a love-lorn moth burns itself on the flame of an oil lamp, so does a woman faithful in love lives her duties and religion (She sacrifices herself over her husband)."}}},{"verse_id":210352,"page_no":null,"line_no":654,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤ ਤਾਤ ਬਿਰਹ ਬ੍ਰਿਯੋਗ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਪੁ ਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal sai nikas jaise meen mar jaat taat bireh birayog birahanee bap haar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fish die immediately when brought out of water, so does a woman separated from her husband die of pangs becoming weak in his memory day by day."}}},{"verse_id":210353,"page_no":null,"line_no":654,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਕਰਨੀ ਕੈ ਐਸੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਉ ਨਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੬੪੫॥","translit_en":"birahanee prem nem patibrataa kai kahaavai karanee kai aaisee koT madhe koau naar hai ||645||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A separated faithful, loving and devoted wife who lives her life according to her religion is perhaps one in a billion.  (645)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41680,"next":41682}}
files.shabads/83/41682.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41682,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210354","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210354,"last_verse_id":210357,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210354,"page_no":null,"line_no":655,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸਮਸਰ ਨਾਂਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਰ ॥","translit_en":"anik anoop roop roop samasar naa(n)h a(n)mirat koTaan koT madhur bachan sar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many other beautiful forms may be there but none can reach near the effulgent form of the beloved True Guru nor millions of elixir-like items can reach the sweet words of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":210355,"page_no":null,"line_no":655,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਪਰ ਵਾਰ ਡਾਰਉ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੰਦਹਾਸੁ ਪਰ ॥","translit_en":"dharam arath koT kaamanaa kaTaachh par vaar ddaarau bibidh mukat ma(n)dhahaas par ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I sacrifice all four desires of life over a look of grace of my True Guru. I can sacrifice myriad salvations over a sweet smile of my True Guru. (Dharam, arth, Kaam and mokh are paltry over the smile and look of grace of the True Guru)."}}},{"verse_id":210356,"page_no":null,"line_no":655,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨ ਤੁਲ ਧਰ ॥","translit_en":"savairag ana(n)t koT ki(n)chat samaagam kai sa(n)gam samooh sukh saagar na tul dhar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Comforts of millions of heavens cannot match even a momentary meeting with True Guru and comforts on total meeting with Him are beyond the capacity of oceans."}}},{"verse_id":210357,"page_no":null,"line_no":655,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸਰ ਕਛੂ ਪੂਜੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਕਰ ॥੬੪੬॥","translit_en":"prem ras ko prataap sar kachhoo poojai naeh tan man dhan sarabas balihaar kar ||646||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one can reach the glory and loving elixir of the True Guru. I sacrifice my body, mind and wealth unto Him.  (646)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41681,"next":41683}}
files.shabads/83/41683.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41683,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210358","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":210358,"last_verse_id":210362,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210358,"page_no":null,"line_no":656,"gurmukhi":"ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਬਲ","translit_en":"achhal achhedh prabh jaa kai bas bisavai bal","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(A seeker woman asks her spiritual love-drenched friends.)"}}},{"verse_id":210359,"page_no":null,"line_no":656,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈ ਜੁ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਕੀਏ ਕਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"tai ju ras bas ke'ee kavan prakaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! that Transcendent one who cannot be deceived by anyone. He is unbreakable who with His power has subdued the whole world, With what elixir have you been able to enamor Him?"}}},{"verse_id":210360,"page_no":null,"line_no":656,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਆਲੀ ਕਵਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"siv sanakaadh brahamaadhik na dhiaan paavai tero dhiaan dhaarai aalee kavan si(n)gaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! He who has not even been realised by Sanak, Sananadan and those who have contemplated on Brahma, what embellishments and adornments have attracted Him to you?"}}},{"verse_id":210361,"page_no":null,"line_no":656,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਗਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੇਖ ਜੰਪਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਸ ਗਾਵਤ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"nigam asa(n)kh sekh ja(n)pat hai jaa ko jas tero jas gaavat kavan upakaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! the Lord whose praise is being said in different words by Vedas and Sheshnag, what merits have made Him sing your praise?"}}},{"verse_id":210362,"page_no":null,"line_no":656,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਹਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਨ ਖੋਜ ਪਾਵੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਪਿਆਰ ਕੈ ॥੬੪੭॥","translit_en":"sur nar naath jaeh khojat na khoj paavai khojat firat toh kavan piaar kai ||647||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God who has not been realised by gods, man and Naths who have laboured untiringly, what type of love has made Him search you?  (647)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41682,"next":41684}}
files.shabads/83/41684.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41684,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210363","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":210363,"last_verse_id":210367,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210363,"page_no":null,"line_no":657,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਗਹ ਗਹਿਓ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਿਓ ","translit_en":"kaise kai ageh gahio kaise kai achhal chhalio ","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(As in last Kabitt a friend who has reached Him is being asked)"}}},{"verse_id":210364,"page_no":null,"line_no":657,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਭੇਦ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaise kai abhedh bhedhio alakh lakhaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":" O friend! how have you acquired the Lord who cannot be seized? How have you tricked Him who cannot be deceived? How have you known His secret whose secret is not revealable? How have you realised Him who cannot be accessed?"}}},{"verse_id":210365,"page_no":null,"line_no":657,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਪੇਖ ਪੇਖਿੳ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਗੜ ਗੜਿਓ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਓ ਅਜਰ ਜਰਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaise kai apekh pekhi kaise kai agaR gaRio kaise kai apio peeo ajar jaraio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How have you seen the Lord who cannot be seen? One who cannot be installed at a place, how have you installed Him in your heart? Whose elixir-like name cannot be consumed by everyone, how have you consumed it ? How have you withstood the state produced by the power of elixir-like Naam?"}}},{"verse_id":210366,"page_no":null,"line_no":657,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਜਾਪ ਜਪਿਓ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਥਾਪ ਥਪਿਓ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਅਪਰਸ ਅਗਮ ਸੁਗਮਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaise kai ajaap japio kaise kai athaap thapio parasio aparas agam sugamaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who is beyond any words of description and repeated utterances, how have you meditated upon Him? How have you lodged Him (in your heart) who cannot be installed? How have you touched Him who is untouchable? And He who is beyond reach, how have you been able to reach Him?"}}},{"verse_id":210367,"page_no":null,"line_no":657,"gurmukhi":"ਅਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ  ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੬੪੮॥","translit_en":"adhabhut gat asacharaj bisam at  kaise kai apaar niraadhaar Thahiraio hai ||648||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose every aspect is so amazing, wondrous and beyond comprehension, how have you lodged Him in your heart who is infinite and without form?  (648)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41683,"next":41685}}
files.shabads/83/41685.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41685,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210368","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210368,"last_verse_id":210371,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210368,"page_no":null,"line_no":658,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਿਧੋ ਕਹਾ ਕੂ ਰਮਾ ਰੰਮ ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖੈ  ਐਸੀ ਕੌਨ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕਠਨ ਤੋਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kahidho kahaa koo ramaa ra(n)m poorab janam bikhai  aaisee kauan tapasiaa kaThan toh keenee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O beautiful Lakshami ! please tell us what strenuous penance had you performed in your previous births? And how had you performed it that you have defeated all other women in glory and praise?"}}},{"verse_id":210369,"page_no":null,"line_no":658,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਉ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਸਕਲ ਕਲਾ  ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਹੁਇ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕੀ ਛਬਿ ਛੀਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa te gun roop aau karam kai sakal kalaa  sresaT hui sarab naikaa kee chhab chheenee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The happy smile of the master of the Universe that is like Chintamani (a jewel that destroys all worries and fulfills desires) is the sustainer of the Universe. "}}},{"verse_id":210370,"page_no":null,"line_no":658,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗਤ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨ  ਮੁਖ ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਹਿਰ ਲੀਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jagat kee jeevan jagat pat chi(n)taaman  mukh musakai chitavat hir leenee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How have you obtained that jewel of happiness through meditation?"}}},{"verse_id":210371,"page_no":null,"line_no":658,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੇ ਨਾਯਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਭਈ  ਸਕਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੬੪੯॥","translit_en":"koT brahama(n)dd ke naayak kee naayakaa bhiee  sakal bhavan kee sirayaa tumeh dheenee hai ||649||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How have you become the mistress of the Master of millions of Universes? How has He bestowed the happiness of all the realms to you ?  (649)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41684,"next":41686}}
files.shabads/83/41686.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41686,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210372","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210372,"last_verse_id":210375,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210372,"page_no":null,"line_no":659,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਰੂਪ ਪਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਰ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"roop koT roop par sobhaa par koT sobhaa chaturaiee koT chaturaiee par vaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of beautiful faces, millions of praises over her praise and millions of wisdoms are sacrifice unto the wisdom of that woman;"}}},{"verse_id":210373,"page_no":null,"line_no":659,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰ ਵਾਰ ਡਾਰੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਪਰ ਧਰਿ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"giaan gun koT gun giaan par vaar ddaarai koT bhaag bhaag par dhar balihaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of virtuous knowledge and millions of fortunes are sacrifice unto the knowledge and fortune of that woman;"}}},{"verse_id":210374,"page_no":null,"line_no":659,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਲ ਸੁਭ ਲਛਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਸੀਲ ਲਛਨ ਕੈ ਲਜਾ ਕੋਟ ਲਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਜਾਇਮਾਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"seel subh lachhan koTaan seel lachhan kai lajaa koT lajaa kai lajaimaan maareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of praiseworthy traits associated with a well-bred, well-behaved person and millions of shames and modesties are sacrifices unto that woman;"}}},{"verse_id":210375,"page_no":null,"line_no":659,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਉ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਥ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕੈ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੬੫੦॥","translit_en":"preman patibrataa hoo(n) prem aau patibrat kai jaa kau naath ki(n)chat kaTaachh kai nihaareeaai ||650||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who is looked at with even a small look of grace by the Lord for her living a life commensurate with her feminine religion and duties.  (650)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41685,"next":41687}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41687,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210376","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210376,"last_verse_id":210379,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210376,"page_no":null,"line_no":660,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ  ਆਨੰਦ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਤੁਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan sukh pujai na samaan sukh  aana(n)dh koTaan tul aana(n)dh na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of comforts and millions of ecstasies cannot reach anywhere near the comforts and ecstasies that are experienced with His acquisition."}}},{"verse_id":210377,"page_no":null,"line_no":660,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜਿ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਸਰ  ਮੰਗਲ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਮ ਮੰਗਲ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj koTaan koT pujai na sahaj sar  ma(n)gal koTaan sam ma(n)gal na paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of equipoise states cannot reach the state of His stability, nor can millions of happy songs of praise can touch the bliss of the happiness blessed by Him."}}},{"verse_id":210378,"page_no":null,"line_no":660,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸਰ  ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਛਬਿ ਛਬਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan parataap na prataap sar  koTan koTaan chhab chhab na pujaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of splendours cannot match His splendour nor can millions of adornments reach His form."}}},{"verse_id":210379,"page_no":null,"line_no":660,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਸਮ  ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਨਾਹ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਬੁਲਾਵਈ ॥੬੫੧॥","translit_en":"arath dharam kaam mokh na koTaan sam  aausar abheech naeh sihajaa bulaaviee ||651||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of four desirable elements (dharam, arth, kaam and mokh) cannot reach him who has been blessed with His Naam and who gets an opportunity of the auspicious invitation of the Master calling the seeker on the nuptial bed of His heart.  (651)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41686,"next":41688}}
files.shabads/83/41688.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41688,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210380","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210380,"last_verse_id":210383,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210380,"page_no":null,"line_no":661,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਧੰਨ ਆਜ ਕੋ ਦਿਵਸ ਰੈਨਿ  ਪਹਰ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਔ ਪਲ ਪਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"safal janam dha(n)n aaj ko dhivas rain  pahar mahoorat gharee aau pal paae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My birth has become successful and fruitful today. This auspicious day, night, watch, moments that have provided me with moments of union with my Lord are worthy of admiration and salutation."}}},{"verse_id":210381,"page_no":null,"line_no":661,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ  ਆਂਗਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"safal si(n)gaar chaar sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog  aa(n)gan ma(n)dhar at su(n)dhar suhaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All my embellishments of Naam Simran are fruitful today, now that I am about to enjoy the spiritual bliss of union with my Lord on the bed-like heart. My heart-like courtyard and temple-like body are also becoming decorated. "}}},{"verse_id":210382,"page_no":null,"line_no":661,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਛਬਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਢਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jagamag jot sobhaa keerat prataap chhab aana(n)dh sahaj sukh saagar baddaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seas of comfort and bliss are leaping in my stable spiritual state as a result of union with my Lord on the bed of my heart. It is effulgent with divine light. It has blessed me with praise and glory, grandeur and splendour and a beautiful image."}}},{"verse_id":210383,"page_no":null,"line_no":661,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਲਾਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੬੫੨॥","translit_en":"arath dharam kaam mokh nihakaam naam prem ras rasik haivai laal mere aae hai(n) ||652||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lord's name that makes dharam, arth, kaam and mokh as no more desirable elements of pursuits; the meditation of that Naam has enamored my beloved Lord in the hue of my love who has now come and taken the seat on my bed-like heart.  (652)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41687,"next":41689}}
files.shabads/83/41689.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41689,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210384","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210384,"last_verse_id":210387,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210384,"page_no":null,"line_no":662,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਨ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਲਟੈ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਉ ਸੁ ਟੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"nis na ghaTai na laTai saseear dheep jot kusam baas hoo(n) na miTai aau su Tev sev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May this night of enjoying blissful union with my Lord not end, nor should the soothing light of the lamp-like moon recede. May the flowers remain laden with fragrance nor should the power of voiceless voice-meditation decrease from my heart."}}},{"verse_id":210385,"page_no":null,"line_no":662,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਘਟੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ  ਰਸਨਾ ਪਰਸ ਰਸ ਰਸਕਿ ਸਮੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj kathaa na ghaTai sravan surat mat  rasanaa paras ras rasak samev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May this spiritual stability not recede nor should the sweetness of sound decrease in my ears. With the absorption of the divine elixir, may the desire of my tongue to remain engrossed in that elixir not wane."}}},{"verse_id":210386,"page_no":null,"line_no":662,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਆਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਰੀਆ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"ni(n)dhraa na parai ar karai na aaras praves ridhai bareeaa sa(n)jog alakh abhev kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May the sleep not burden me nor should laziness effect my heart, because an opportunity of enjoying the inaccessible Lord has been formed (opportunity of enjoying the bliss of union with Lord exists)."}}},{"verse_id":210387,"page_no":null,"line_no":662,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਉਗੁਨੋ ਬਢੈ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ  ਦਇਆ ਦਸ ਗੁਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ॥੬੫੩॥","translit_en":"chaau chit chauguno baddai prabal prem nem  dhiaa dhas gunee upajai dhiaal dhev kee ||653||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bless me that this desire and enthusiasm of my heart becomes fourfold. May the love within me become more powerful and unbearable and the benevolence of the beloved effulgent Lord appear ten times more for me.  (653)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41688,"next":41690}}
files.shabads/83/41690.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41690,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210388","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210388,"last_verse_id":210391,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210388,"page_no":null,"line_no":663,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਸ ਨਿਸ ਪਰਮਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਲ ਪਲ ਮਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਯੰਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਬਿਥਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nimakh nimakh nis nis paramaan hoi pal pal maas praya(n)t haivai bithaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May every moment of my union with the Lord become night long and every second of this meeting become month long."}}},{"verse_id":210389,"page_no":null,"line_no":663,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖ ਬਰਖ ਪਰਯੰਤ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ  ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਮ ਜਾਮ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"barakh barakh paraya(n)t ghaTikaa bihai  jug jug sam jaam jaamanee piaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May each watch be a year long while each pehar (a quarter of a day) become equal to an epoch."}}},{"verse_id":210390,"page_no":null,"line_no":663,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਾ ਕਲਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kalaa kalaa koT gun jagamag jot sas prem ras prabal prataap adhikaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May each trait of the moon change into millions of traits and enlightens in bright radiance; and the grandeur of love elixir may become more and more powerful."}}},{"verse_id":210391,"page_no":null,"line_no":663,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੋਂ  ਆਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਜ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੪॥","translit_en":"man bach kram pirayaa sevaa sanamukh raho(n)  aaras na aavai ni(n)dhraa aj meree baaree hai ||654||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now that an opportunity of meeting with Lord on the heart like bed has come up in this invaluable life as a human being, then let me remain engrossed in the voiceless voice meditation of the Lord on account of my mind, words and actions. May I not sleep nor feel lazy.  (654)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41689,"next":41691}}
files.shabads/83/41691.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41691,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210392","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210392,"last_verse_id":210395,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210392,"page_no":null,"line_no":664,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸਰਦ ਨਿਸ ਤੈਸੇ ਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਸਿ  ਵੈਸੇ ਈ ਕੁਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੁਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiseeaai saradh nis taise iee pooran sas  vaise iee kusam dhal sihajaa suvaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the night of winter month is, so is the moon radiant this night. The fragrant buds of the flowers have adorned the bed."}}},{"verse_id":210393,"page_no":null,"line_no":664,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੀ ਏ ਜੋਬਨ ਬੈਸ ਤੈਸੇ ਈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ  ਵੈਸੇ ਈ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਗੁਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaisee e joban bais taise iee anoop roop  vaise iee si(n)gaar chaar gun adhikaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On one side is the young age while on the other side is incomparable beauty. Similarly there is adornment of Naam Simran on one side while on the other is plenitude of virtues."}}},{"verse_id":210394,"page_no":null,"line_no":664,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਈ ਛਬੀਲੇ ਨੈਨ ਤੈਸੇ ਈ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਬੈਨ  ਸੋਭਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise iee chhabeele nain taise iee raseele bain  sobhat parasapar mahimaa apaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On one side are attractive and shining eyes while on the other hand are sweet words full of nectar. (655)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41690,"next":41692}}
files.shabads/83/41692.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41692,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210396","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210396,"last_verse_id":210399,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210396,"page_no":null,"line_no":665,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਜਗਤ ਮਨ ਟਹਿਲ ਕਹੀ ਰਿਸਾਇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa dhin jagat man Tahil kahee risai giaan dhiaan koT jog jag na samaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The day Omniscient Lord felt pleased and ordered to perform service, millions of worldly knowledge, meditation, yoga became paltry on that auspicious day."}}},{"verse_id":210397,"page_no":null,"line_no":665,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭਈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਗਨ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਸਮ ਨ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa dhin bhiee panihaaree jagan naath jee kee taa sam na chhatradhaaree koTin koTaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The day I received the assignment of filling water for God, the master of the Universe, the comforts of millions of kingdoms cannot compare with that blessed day."}}},{"verse_id":210398,"page_no":null,"line_no":665,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਪਿਸਨਹਾਰੀ ਭਈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa dhin pisanahaaree bhiee jagajeevan kee arath dharam kaam mokh dhaasan dhaasaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The day I received the assignment of grinding the mill-stone of the Lord, the master of universe and all living beings, then the four much sought and desired elements of spirituality became slave of the servants."}}},{"verse_id":210399,"page_no":null,"line_no":665,"gurmukhi":"ਛਿਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਪੀਸਨਹਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੋ ਅਕਥ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੬॥","translit_en":"chhirakaaree panihaaree peesanahaaree ko jo sukh premanee piaaree ko akath unamaan hai ||656||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The love-lorn beloved who is blessed with the task of sprinkling of water, grinding of mill-stone and filling of water, to state her praise, comfort and peace is beyond description.  (656)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41691,"next":41693}}
files.shabads/83/41693.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41693,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210400","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210400,"last_verse_id":210403,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210400,"page_no":null,"line_no":666,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰੀ ਘਰੀ ਟੇਰਿ ਘਰੀਆਰ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਸੰਦੇਸੋ ਪਹਿਰ ਪਹਿਰ ਪੁਨਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gharee gharee Ter ghareeaar sunai sa(n)dheso pahir pahir pun pun samajhai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The clock is repeatedly and loudly conveying a message after every watch and every pehar (a quarter of a day/night, that the time is rolling by)."}}},{"verse_id":210401,"page_no":null,"line_no":666,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਬੂਡਤ ਹੈ  ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਪਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jaise jal bhar bhar belee booddat hai  pooran hui paapan kee naaveh harai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the water clock sinks repeatedly, 0 human being! you are also sinking your boat of life with ever increasing sins."}}},{"verse_id":210402,"page_no":null,"line_no":666,"gurmukhi":"ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਸੋਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਰੂਆ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਹਾਰੇ ਚਾਰੋ ਜਾਮ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chahoo(n) or sor kai paaharooaa pukaar haare chaaro jaam sovate achet na lajai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru is warning you repeatedly from all directions; O unattentive and senseless person! the four pehars of your night-like life are being spent sleeping in ignorance. You seemed to have no shame of your concern."}}},{"verse_id":210403,"page_no":null,"line_no":666,"gurmukhi":"ਤਮਚੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਹੀ ਉਘਾਰ ਆਂਖੈਂ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛਤਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੭॥","translit_en":"tamachur sabadh sunat hee ughaar aa(n)khai(n) bin piray prem ras paachhai pachhatai hai ||657||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O living being! be aware, open your eyes with the crowing of the cock, be attentive after attending to your body needs, taste the elixir of love with the Lord. Without relishing the Naam Amrit of beloved Lord's name, one would feel repentant ultimately.  (657)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41692,"next":41694}}
files.shabads/83/41694.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41694,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210404","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210404,"last_verse_id":210407,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210404,"page_no":null,"line_no":667,"gurmukhi":"ਮਜਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਰ ਚਾਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਤਮੋਲ ਰਸ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਾਜ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਬਿਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"majan kai cheer chaar a(n)jan tamol ras abharan si(n)gaar saaj sihajaa bichhaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bathing myself clean, wearing beautiful clothes, putting collyrium in the eyes, eating a betel and adoring myself with various ornaments I have laid the bed of my Lord. (I have prepared myself for union with my beloved God Lord)."}}},{"verse_id":210405,"page_no":null,"line_no":667,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਾਂਝ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਪਤ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤ ਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kusam suga(n)dh ar ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar maa(n)jh dheepak dhipat jagamag jot chhaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The beautiful bed is decorated with fragrant flowers and the beautiful room is lit up with radiant light."}}},{"verse_id":210406,"page_no":null,"line_no":667,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸਉਨ ਲਗਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਚਿਰਕਾਰ ਬਾਰੀ ਆਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sodhat sodhat saun lagan manai man baa(n)chhat bidhaan chirakaar baaree aaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have received this human birth after much effort for the union with the Lord God. (I have gone through many births to reach to this stage that is very auspicious)."}}},{"verse_id":210407,"page_no":null,"line_no":667,"gurmukhi":"ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਨੀਚ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਤ ਖੋਏ ਨੈਨ ਉਘਰਤ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੮॥","translit_en":"aausar abheech neech ni(n)dhraa mai sovat khoe nain ugharat a(n)t paachhai pachhutaiee hai ||658||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But losing this opportunity of favourable constellation position for a union with God in the sleep of hateful ignorance, one will only repent when one wakes up (because by then it would be too late).  (658)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41693,"next":41695}}
files.shabads/83/41695.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41695,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210408","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":210408,"last_verse_id":210412,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210408,"page_no":null,"line_no":668,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰ ਅੰਜੁਲਿ ਜਲ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੁ ਆਲੀ","translit_en":"kar a(n)jul jal joban praves aalee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(A woman who has met Him instructs a worldly woman)."}}},{"verse_id":210409,"page_no":null,"line_no":668,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"maan taj praanapat pat rat maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O! friend entering in youth! abandon all ego and take water (of humility) in your hand, worship the Lord husband the Master of all lives and lodge His love in your heart."}}},{"verse_id":210410,"page_no":null,"line_no":668,"gurmukhi":"ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਨਗਰ ਗਤਿ ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਲਭ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ga(n)dhrab nagar gat rajanee bihaat jaat aausar abheech at dhulabh kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like an imaginary world, this night-like life being imaginary is passing by. So consider this human birth as an invaluable opportunity that stars have favoured you with for meeting the Lord God."}}},{"verse_id":210411,"page_no":null,"line_no":668,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਕੁਮਲਾਤ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ  ਪੁਨਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਸਮੋ ਆਵਤ ਨ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa kusam kumalaat murajhaat  pun pun pachhutaat samo aavat na aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the flowers on the nuptial bed withers away, this invaluable time once gone past will not return. One will repent repeatedly."}}},{"verse_id":210412,"page_no":null,"line_no":668,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪਿਆਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਮਝ ਸਿਆਨੀ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥੬੫੯॥","translit_en":"soiee bar naar piray piaar adhikaaree piaaree samajh siaanee to so benatee bakhaaneeaai ||659||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O dear friend! I pray to you to be wise and understand this important fact, that she alone is supreme seeker female, who becomes dejure owner of her Lord's love and, ultimately becomes His beloved.  (659)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41694,"next":41696}}
files.shabads/83/41696.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41696,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210413","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210413,"last_verse_id":210416,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210413,"page_no":null,"line_no":669,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਨ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਬਦੋ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਿਆਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"maanan na keejai maan badho na tero siaan mero kahio maan jaan aausar abheech ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not consider wisdom in this pride. Listen to me and regard this human birth as the most auspicious and invaluable time to meet with the Lord. Make this chance a success by taking the initiation of Naam Amrit from the True Guru and practicing it."}}},{"verse_id":210414,"page_no":null,"line_no":669,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਆਈ ਬਾਰੀ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਸੰਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਹਠ ਨੀਚ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"pirayaa kee anek piaaree chira(n)kaal aaiee baaree leh na suhaag sa(n)g chhaadd haTh neech ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dear Lord has numerous beloved wives whose hearts are pierced with His ambrosial Naam. After wandering in many species, you have now got the turn to meet with the Lord through this human birth. Why don't you give up your arrogant obduracy and unite with your Lord husband?"}}},{"verse_id":210415,"page_no":null,"line_no":669,"gurmukhi":"ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਗਾਤ ਖੇਲਹੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਖ ਬੀਚ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"rajanee bihaat jaat joban si(n)gaar gaat khelahu na prem ras moh sukh beech ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This night-like human life is passing away. The youth, body and all its adornments will be left behind. Then why don't you enjoy and relish the loving elixir of your dear husband? And why are you wasting your night-like life in the false pleasures of maya? "}}},{"verse_id":210416,"page_no":null,"line_no":669,"gurmukhi":"ਅਬ ਕੈ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਥ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਡੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਚ ਕੋ ॥੬੬੦॥","translit_en":"ab kai na bheTai naath bahurio na aavai haath birahaa bihaavai bal baddo bhaiee meech ko ||660||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And if you fail to achieve union with your master Lord in this human birth, you will not get another opportunity. You will have to spend the remainder life in the separation of the Lord. The separation is far more painful than death.  (660)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41695,"next":41697}}
files.shabads/83/41697.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41697,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210417","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":210417,"last_verse_id":210421,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210417,"page_no":null,"line_no":670,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤ ਹੋਤਿ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਆਲੀ","translit_en":"jau lau dheep jot hot naahin maleen aalee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(Advice to a seeker to make the ambrosial hour a success)."}}},{"verse_id":210418,"page_no":null,"line_no":670,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨਹਿ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਕੁਮਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau neh sihajaa kusam kumalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! before dawn when the light of a lamp goes dim and the flowers on the decorated nuptial bed have not yet withered away,"}}},{"verse_id":210419,"page_no":null,"line_no":670,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਕਮਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਤ ਉਡਤ ਅਲਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਹੰਗਮ ਨ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਚੁਹਚੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau na kamalan prafulat uddat al birakh biha(n)gam na jau lau chuhachuhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Before the sunrise till the flowers bloom and the bumble bees are not attracted to them and before the dawn when the birds on the tree have not yet started chirping;"}}},{"verse_id":210420,"page_no":null,"line_no":670,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਭਾਸਕਰ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਨ ਅਕਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ  ਤਮਚੁਰ ਸੰਖ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau bhaasakar ko prakaas na akaas bikhai  tamachur sa(n)kh naadh sabadh na praat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Till such time, the Sun shines in the sky and the crowing of the cock and the sound of the conch blowing is not heard,"}}},{"verse_id":210421,"page_no":null,"line_no":670,"gurmukhi":"ਤਉ ਲਉ ਕਾਮ ਕੇਲ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ  ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੧॥","translit_en":"tau lau kaam kel kaamanaa sakal pooran kai  hoi nihakaam piray prem nem ghaat hai ||661||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Taking initiation from the True Guru, this is the invaluable time of obtaining and relishing the loving elixir of meditation on His name. (661)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41696,"next":41698}}
files.shabads/83/41698.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41698,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210422","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210422,"last_verse_id":210425,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210422,"page_no":null,"line_no":671,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਨਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਮਾਨ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"joiee milai aapaa khoi soiee tau naayakaa hoi maan ke'ee maanamatee paieeaai na maan jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman who sheds her ego and meets with dear husband, she alone is the loved wife of the husband. One cannot get honour and respect from the Lord if one feels haughty and egoistic."}}},{"verse_id":210423,"page_no":null,"line_no":671,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਨਹਰ ਬਰਸੈ ਸਰਬਤਰ ਸਮ ਉਚੈ ਨ ਚੜਤ ਜਲ ਬਸਤ ਨੀਚਾਨ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghanahar barasai sarabatar sam uchai na chaRat jal basat neechaan jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as clouds rain equally in all places, its water cannot climb up the mounds. Water always go and settles at lower levels."}}},{"verse_id":210424,"page_no":null,"line_no":671,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਹੈ ਬਢਾਈ ਬਾਂਸ  ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep jaise booddio hai baddaiee baa(n)s  aas paas birakh subaas paravaan jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bamboo stays in his pride of being high and lofty and remains bereft of the fragrance of sandalwood, but all big and small trees and plants absorb that sweet smell in themselves."}}},{"verse_id":210425,"page_no":null,"line_no":671,"gurmukhi":"ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਤੀਯ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਗਤਿ  ਪਾਵਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜੀ ॥੬੬੨॥","translit_en":"kirapaa si(n)dh piray teey hoi marajeevaa gat  paavat param gat sarab nidhaan jee ||662||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, to be the wife of the ocean of kindness-dear Lord, one has to sacrifice oneself and become a living dead person. Only then can one acquire the treasure of all treasures (God's name from the True Guru) and reach the supreme divine state.  (662)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41697,"next":41699}}
files.shabads/83/41699.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41699,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210426","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":210426,"last_verse_id":210430,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210426,"page_no":null,"line_no":672,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਹਿ ","translit_en":"sihajaa samai agiaan maan kai rasaae naeh ","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(A plea to make human life fruitful)."}}},{"verse_id":210427,"page_no":null,"line_no":672,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਰਿਸਾਇ ਉਤ ਕੋ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"tanak hee mai risai ut ko sidhaare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Due to my pride of youth, wealth and ignorance, I did not please my beloved Lord at the time of my meeting with Him. As a result He became cross with me and left me for some other place. (I was too preoccupied with enjoying my human life and paid no attention to meeting my Lord God)."}}},{"verse_id":210428,"page_no":null,"line_no":672,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰ ਮੀਜਿ  ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਧਿਕਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"paachhai pachhutai hai hai kar kar meej  moo(n)dd dhun dhun koT janam dhikaare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After realising the separation of my Lord, I am now repenting and grieving and beating my head, am cursing my millions births of separation from Him."}}},{"verse_id":210429,"page_no":null,"line_no":672,"gurmukhi":"ਅਉਸਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੋਂ ਬਿਲਲਾਉ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖਤ ਹੁਇ  ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਆਤਮ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"aausar na paavo(n) bilalaau dheen dhukhat hui  bireh biyog sog aatam sa(n)ghaare hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I cannot get this chance of meeting my Lord for ever anymore. That is why I am wailing, feeling the distress and perturbation. The separation, its pangs and its worry is torturing me."}}},{"verse_id":210430,"page_no":null,"line_no":672,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਲਾਲਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਦੀਜੈ  ਤੋ ਪਰ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਰਬੰਸ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਹੈਂ ॥੬੬੩॥","translit_en":"paraupakaar keejai laalan manai dheejai  to par ana(n)t saraba(n)s balihaarai hai(n) ||663||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend beloved of my Lord! do me a favour and bring around my separated Lord husband. And for such a favour, I will sacrifice all that I have many times over you.  (663)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41698,"next":41700}}
files.shabads/83/41700.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41700,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210431","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210431,"last_verse_id":210434,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210431,"page_no":null,"line_no":673,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਉਸੁਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨੀ  ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਨ ਅਪਨੋ ਈ ਮਾਨ ਖੋਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras aausur agiaan mai na aagiaa maanee  maan kai maanan apano iee maan khoio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In my human birth when it was time to acquire the elixir like love of my beloved Lord, I did not obey the command of my True Guru to toil and practice the teachings of the Guru. Becoming proud of my youth and wealth, I lost the respect that I had in the heart of my beloved Lord."}}},{"verse_id":210432,"page_no":null,"line_no":673,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਹੂੰ ਜੁ ਮਾਨੀ ਭਏ ਮਾਨਤ ਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਆਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taa(n) te ris maan praan naath hoo(n) ju maanee bhe maanat na mere maan aan dhukh roio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Due to my involvement in worldly pleasures, my Master beloved Lord has become angry with me. Now when I try to bring him around, I fail. 0 my pious friend! I have now come and expressed my distress before you."}}},{"verse_id":210433,"page_no":null,"line_no":673,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਕ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਦਤ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ  ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਲੁਨਤ ਸਹਸ ਗੁਨੋ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lok bedh giaan dhat bhagat pradhaan  taa(n) te lunat sahas guno jaise beej boio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is a primary axiom of all the folk tales and religious scriptures that one reaps what one had sown. Whatever good or bad we sow, we have to reap many times more than that."}}},{"verse_id":210434,"page_no":null,"line_no":673,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਗਤਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗਉ  ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਮਨਾਇ ਦੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗ ਜੋਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੪॥","translit_en":"dhaasan dhaasaan gat benatee kai pai laagau  hai kouoo manai dhai sagal jag joio hai ||664||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have searched the whole world, defeated. I have made myself the slave of the servants and approaching the slaves of the Lord, I go into their refuge and pray for any God-loved servant to unite me with my separated and angered beloved Lord. (664)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41699,"next":41701}}
files.shabads/83/41701.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41701,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210435","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210435,"last_verse_id":210438,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210435,"page_no":null,"line_no":674,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰਕਤ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਧਰ ਭੁਜਾ ਤਾਪੈ ਤਨ  ਮਨ ਮੈ ਅਉਸੇਰ ਕਬ ਲਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"farakat lochan adhar bhujaa taapai tan  man mai aauser kab laal gireh aavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With earnest desire of meeting my beloved Lord in my heart, my eyes, lips and arms are quivering. My body temperature is rising while my mind is restless. When will my dear beloved come to abide into my house-like heart?"}}},{"verse_id":210436,"page_no":null,"line_no":674,"gurmukhi":"ਨੈਨਨ ਸੈ ਨੈਨ ਅਰ ਬੈਨਨ ਸੇ ਬੈਨ ਮਿਲੈ  ਰੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਚੈਨ ਕੋ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"nainan sai nain ar bainan se bain milai  rain samai chain ko sihajaasan bulaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I have my eyes and words (lips) meeting with the eyes and words (lips) of my Lord? And when will my beloved Lord call me to His bed at night to make me enjoy the divine pleasure of this meeting?"}}},{"verse_id":210437,"page_no":null,"line_no":674,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰ ਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਉਰ ਉਰ ਸੇ ਲਗਾਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਅੰਕ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kar geh kar ur ur se lagai pun a(n)k a(n)kamaal kar sahij samaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will He hold me by my hand, take me into His embrace, in His lap, around His neck and plunge me into the spiritual ecstasy?"}}},{"verse_id":210438,"page_no":null,"line_no":674,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਆਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇ ਆਲੀ  ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੀ ॥੬੬੫॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat peeaai tirapatai aalee  dhiaa kai dhiaal dhev kaamanaa pujaavahee ||665||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my co-congregational friends! When will the beloved Lord make me drink the loving elixir of spiritual union and satiate me; and when will the effulgent and kind Lord become benevolent and appease the desire of my mind?  (665)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41700,"next":41702}}
files.shabads/83/41702.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41702,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210439","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210439,"last_verse_id":210442,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210439,"page_no":null,"line_no":675,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੁਰਛਾਤ ਭਏ ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਬਹਿਰਿਓ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan anoop roop dhekh murachhaat bhe seiee mukh bahirio bilok dhiaan dhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! seeing the beautiful form of the beloved, I had become unconscious. Seeing that radiant face again in my inner self, my inner consciousness has anchored on to the stable peace."}}},{"verse_id":210440,"page_no":null,"line_no":675,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਮੋਹੇ ਆਲੀ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੁਖ ਬੈਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat bachan sun sravan bimohe aalee taahee mukh bain sun surat samaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O friend! hearing whose ambrosial words, my ears had gone into raptures, now with the ambrosial words from the same tongue entering my consciousness, my inner self has become engrossed in His Naam Simran."}}},{"verse_id":210441,"page_no":null,"line_no":675,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਪੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨਿ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ ਤਾਹੀ ਕੇ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਪੁਨਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਉਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa pai benatee bakhaan jihabaa thakat bhiee taahee ke bulaae pun benatee uchaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The beloved Lord praying to whom my tongue had got tired, I am praying non-stop to call that Lord on the bed of my heart."}}},{"verse_id":210442,"page_no":null,"line_no":675,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਦ ਪੀਏ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਮਦ ਅਚਵਤ ਚੇਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੬॥","translit_en":"jaise madh pe'ee giaan dhiaan bisaran hoi taahee madh achavat chetan prakaar hai ||666||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as consuming some intoxicating substance, all awareness and consciousness is lost, (a man becomes unconscious), now drinking it in the form of Naam Amrit, it has become a means of inner consciousness.  (666)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41701,"next":41703}}
files.shabads/83/41703.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41703,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210443","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210443,"last_verse_id":210446,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210443,"page_no":null,"line_no":676,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਗਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਹਰੇ ਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sun piray gavan sravan bahare na bhe kaahe kee patibrataa pat brat paayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Why did my ears not turn deaf hearing the departure of my dear beloved? What type of faithful and loyal wife am I and what sort of husband-engrossed religion (life style) have I acquired?"}}},{"verse_id":210444,"page_no":null,"line_no":676,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਧਰੇ ਨ ਭਏ ਨੈਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਹੂੰ ਲਜਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirashaT piray agochar hui a(n)dhare na bhe nain kaahe kee premanee prem hoo(n) lajaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Why did I not go blind when my beloved was disappearing from my vision? What sort of beloved am I ? I have shamed the love."}}},{"verse_id":210445,"page_no":null,"line_no":676,"gurmukhi":"ਅਵਧਿ ਬਿਹਾਏ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਲਖਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"avadh bihaae dhai dhai birahaa biaapai kaahe kee birahanee bireh bilakhaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My life is waning and the separation of my Lord is chasing me and causing me distress. What type of separation is this? The pangs of separations have made me restless."}}},{"verse_id":210446,"page_no":null,"line_no":676,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਤ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਨਾਹਿ ਫੂਟਿਯੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਨਉ ਚੂਕ ਉੱਤਰ ਨ ਆਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੭॥","translit_en":"sunat bidhes ke sa(n)dhes naeh fooTiyo ridhaa kaun kaun ganau chook u'tar na aayo hai ||667||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Why has my heart not burst, receiving the message that my dear beloved will stay away from me in other place? What all blunders made may I count and recall, I have no answer of it.  (667)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41702,"next":41704}}
files.shabads/83/41704.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41704,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210447","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210447,"last_verse_id":210450,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210447,"page_no":null,"line_no":677,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਦਾਵਾਨਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਨ ਤਨ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bireh dhaavaanal pragaTee na tan ban bikhai asan basan taa mai ghirat parajaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The separation of my beloved is not only appearing in my body, like the fire of jungle, but all these dainty dishes and dresses instead of giving me comfort are acting like oil in raising the intensity of fire and consequently my sufferings."}}},{"verse_id":210448,"page_no":null,"line_no":677,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੇ ਧੂਮ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਦੁਸਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਹੀੇ ਤੇ ਗਗਨ ਘਨ ਘਟਾ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pratham prakaase dhoom at hee dhusahaa dhukh taahe'ee te gagan ghan ghaTaa a(n)dhakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Firstly, this separation, because of the sighs associated with it is appearing like smoke and thus unbearable and then this smoke is looking like dark clouds in the sky causing darkness all around."}}},{"verse_id":210449,"page_no":null,"line_no":677,"gurmukhi":"ਭਭਕ ਭਭੂਕੋ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਸਿ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਚਿਨਗਾਰੀ ਚਮਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhabhak bhabhooko hui prakaasio hai akaas sas taarakaa ma(n)ddal chinagaaree chamakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even the moon in the sky is looking like a flame. The stars are appearing to me as the sparks of that fire."}}},{"verse_id":210450,"page_no":null,"line_no":677,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾ ਸਿਓੁ ਕਹਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੮॥","translit_en":"kaa sio kahau kaise a(n)takaal birathaava(n)t gat moh dhukh soiee sukhadhaiee sa(n)saar hai ||668||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a patient nearing his death, whom should I tell this state that has resulted due to the fire of separation? All these things (moon, stars, dresses etc.) are becoming uncomfortable and painful for me, whereas all these are highly peace-giving and source of comfort for the whole world. (668)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41703,"next":41705}}
files.shabads/83/41705.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41705,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210451","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210451,"last_verse_id":210454,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210451,"page_no":null,"line_no":678,"gurmukhi":"ਏਈ ਅਖੀਆਂ ਜੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"eiee akheeaa(n) ju pekh pratham anoop roop kaamanaa pooran kar sahaj samaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These are the very eyes which used to see the extremely beautiful form of the beloved Lord and satisfying their desire would absorb themselves in the spiritual bliss."}}},{"verse_id":210452,"page_no":null,"line_no":678,"gurmukhi":"ਏੁਈ ਅਖੀਆਂ ਜੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਟਕ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਹੁਇ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"euiee akheeaa(n) ju leelaa laalan kee ik Tak at asacharaj hui herat hiraanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These are the eyes that used to go into raptures of bliss seeing the divine wonders of the dear Lord."}}},{"verse_id":210453,"page_no":null,"line_no":678,"gurmukhi":"ਏਈ ਅਖੀਆਂ ਜੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਪੀਰਾ ਕੈ ਪਿਰਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"eiee akheeaa(n) ju bichhurat pria praanapat bireh biyog rog peeraa kai piraanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These are the eyes that used to suffer the most at the time of separation of the Lord, the Master of my life."}}},{"verse_id":210454,"page_no":null,"line_no":678,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਹੁਤੀ ਏਹੀ ਅਖੀਆਂ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਗ ਮੈਂ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੯॥","translit_en":"naasakaa sravan rasanaa mai agrabhaag hutee ehee akheeaa(n) sagal a(n)g mai(n) biraanee hai ||669||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being bereft of beloved Lord's glimpse and His wondrous deeds, these eyes are perturbed and have become very weak. (669)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41704,"next":41706}}
files.shabads/83/41706.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41706,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210455","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210455,"last_verse_id":210458,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210455,"page_no":null,"line_no":679,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਟਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੁਤੇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੇ ਚਕੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਪਲ ਨ ਲਗਤ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"eik Tak dhiaan hute cha(n)dhrame chakor gat pal na lagat supanai hoo(n) na dhikhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I used to see my beloved Lord without a blink of the eye as a ruddy sheldrake looks at moon. There used to be no break. But now I don't even see Him in a dream."}}},{"verse_id":210456,"page_no":null,"line_no":679,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਮਾਨ ਤਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੰਦੇਸੋ ਪਥਕਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat bachan dhun sunat hee bidhayamaan taa mukh sa(n)dheso pathakan pai na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Previously, I used to hear the melody of my beloved's sweet words from His mouth, but now I do not even receive His messages even from the passers by coming or going this way."}}},{"verse_id":210457,"page_no":null,"line_no":679,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਨ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਤੋ ਹਾਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਹਾਰ ਓਟ ਭਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa samai na ur a(n)tar samaato haar anik pahaar oT bhe kaise jaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Previously, even the interference of the necklace around my neck was not tolerated between us at the time of our meeting on the nuptial bed, but now many mountain size customs have come up between us. How can I raise them down and reach my beloved Lord?"}}},{"verse_id":210458,"page_no":null,"line_no":679,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਹੁਤੇ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਲਲਾਈਐ ॥੬੭੦॥","translit_en":"sahaj sa(n)jog bhog ras parataap hute bireh biyog sog rog bilalaieeaai ||670||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Previously in my spiritual tranquility, I had the happiness and bliss of being near Him, but I am now crying with pangs of separation.  (670)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41705,"next":41707}}

॥","translit_en":"jaa kai ek fan pai dharan hai so dharaneedhar taeh giradhar kahai kauan baddiaaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God created Sheshnag who is believed to be supporting the Earth on one of his thousand heads, and he is called Dharnidhar, and if his creator is called by the name of Girdhar (lifter of Goverdhan mountain-Krishan) what sort of praise is his?"}}},{"verse_id":210460,"page_no":null,"line_no":680,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ ਤਾਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਜਨਾਥ ਕਹੈ ਕੌਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa kai ek baavaro kahaavat hai bisavainaath taeh birajanaath kahai kauan adhikaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The creator who has created a crazy (Shiv Ji) and is called Vishwanath (master of the Universe), if his creator is called Brijnath (master of Braj region-Sri Krishan) then what is so praiseworthy about him?"}}},{"verse_id":210461,"page_no":null,"line_no":680,"gurmukhi":"ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਂਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sagal akaar o(n)kaar ke bithaare jin taeh na(n)dh na(n)dh kahai kaun Thakuraiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The creator who has created this entire expanse, if that creator is called son of Nand-Krishan Ji, then what is so great about him?"}}},{"verse_id":210462,"page_no":null,"line_no":680,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਅੰਧ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੋਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੬੭੧॥","translit_en":"ausatat jaan ni(n)dhaa karat agiaan a(n)dh aaise hee araadhan te mon sukhadhaiee hai ||671||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(So by such type of worship) ignorant and blind of knowledge consider Lord's worship being performed, but instead, they are slandering Him. Remaining silent is far better than this type of worship.  (671)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41706,"next":41708}}
files.shabads/83/41708.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41708,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210463","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210463,"last_verse_id":210466,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210463,"page_no":null,"line_no":681,"gurmukhi":"ਨਖ ਸਿਸ ਲਉ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਗ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"nakh sis lau sagal a(n)g rom rom kar kaaT kaaT sikhan ke charan par vaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If I cut every part of my body from nails to the top of my head into the size of a hair and sacrifice them over the holy feet of the Sikhs of Guru'"}}},{"verse_id":210464,"page_no":null,"line_no":681,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ਫੁਨਿ ਪੀਸਨ ਪਸਾਇ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਲੈ ਉਡੈ ਪਵਨ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"agan jalai fun peesan pasai taa(n)h lai uddai pavan hoi anik prakaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And then these cut parts are burnt in fire, ground to ashes in a mill-stone and these ashes are blown all over by the wind;"}}},{"verse_id":210465,"page_no":null,"line_no":681,"gurmukhi":"ਜਤ ਕਤ ਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਧਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਤਾਹੂ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਾਰਗ ਮਹਿ ਭਸਮ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jat kat sikh pag dharai gur pa(n)th praat taahoo taahoo maarag meh bhasam kai ddaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Spread these ashes of my body on the paths leading to the door of the True Guru, that the Sikhs of the Guru take at the ambrosial hour;"}}},{"verse_id":210466,"page_no":null,"line_no":681,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਹ ਪਦ ਪਾਦਕ ਚਰਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਹੈ ਦਯਾ ਕੈ ਦਯਾਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੀਐ ॥੬੭੨॥","translit_en":"teh padh paadhak charan liv laagee rahai dhayaa kai dhayaal moh patit udhaareeaai ||672||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So that the touch of the feet of the Sikhs treading that path may keep me engrossed in the remembrance of my Lord. I may then pray before these Gursikhs to take me·-the sinner across the worldly ocean.  (672)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41707,"next":41709}}
files.shabads/83/41709.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41709,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210467","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210467,"last_verse_id":210470,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210467,"page_no":null,"line_no":682,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਚ ਬਾਰ ਗੰਗ ਜਾਇ ਬਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਾਗ ਨਾਇ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਏਕ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਵਾਏ ਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ch baar ga(n)g jai baar pa(n)ch praag nai taisaa pu(n)n ek gursikh kau navaae kaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Providing bathing facility to a Sikh and helping him bathe is an act that is equal to five visits to a place of pilgrimage to river Ganges and an equal number to Prayag."}}},{"verse_id":210468,"page_no":null,"line_no":682,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਪਿਲਾਇ ਪਾਨੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਰਖੈਤ ਅਸ੍ਵਮੇਧ ਜਗ ਫਲ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜਿਵਾਏ ਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"sikh kau pilai paanee bhaau kar kurakhait asavaimedh jag fal sikh kau jivaae kaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a Sikh is served water with love and devotion, then it is an act equal to visiting Kurukshetra. And if a Sikh of the Guru is served meal with love and devotion one is rewarded with blessing obtainable from an Aswmedh Yag. "}}},{"verse_id":210469,"page_no":null,"line_no":682,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਉਸਾਰ ਦੀਨੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਇਕ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਖਾਏ ਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"jaise sat ma(n)dhar ka(n)chan ke usaar dheene taisaa pu(n)n sikh kau ik sabadh sikhaae kaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a hundred temples raised in gold are given away in charity, its reward is equal to teaching one hymn of Gurbani to a Guru's Sikh. "}}},{"verse_id":210470,"page_no":null,"line_no":682,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਾਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੈਸਾ ਫਲ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਪਿ ਪਗ ਸੁਆਏ ਕਾ ॥੬੭੩॥","translit_en":"jaise bees baar dharasan saadh keeaa kaahoo taisaa fal sikh kau chaap pag suaae kaa ||673||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gain of pressing the feet of a tired Guru's Sikh and putting him to sleep is equal to seeing a noble and godly person a score of times.  (673)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41708,"next":41710}}

practitioner, and he administers medicine to each one of them according to their ailment."}}},{"verse_id":210472,"page_no":null,"line_no":683,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਲੋਗ ਆਵਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਮਿਤ ਜੋਈ ਜਾਹੀਂ ਜੋਗ ਤੈਸੀ ਟਹਿਲ ਬਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raaj dhavaiaar log aavat sevaa namit joiee jaahee(n) jog taisee Tahil bataaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as myriad people come to the door of the king to serve him, and each one is told to prefer service that he is capable and fit to do;"}}},{"verse_id":210473,"page_no":null,"line_no":683,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਰਥੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਆਵੈਂ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਜਾਚੈ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਖਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhaataa paas jan arathee anek aavai(n) joiee joiee jaachai dhe dhe dhukhan miTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many needy persons come to a kind-hearted donor and he gives them whatever each one asks, thus allaying distress of each one of them."}}},{"verse_id":210474,"page_no":null,"line_no":683,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਿਖ files.shabads/83/41711.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41711,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"210475","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":210475,"last_verse_id":210478,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":210475,"page_no":null,"line_no":684,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਜਾਤ ਰਾਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਆਗਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raag jaat raagee jaanai bairaagai bairaagee jaanai tiaageh tiaagee jaanai dheen dhiaa dhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A musician alone knows the modes of music and singing and their various forms. Only a renunciator who has given up his attachment with worldly goods know what a detached temperament is, a hermit alone knows what it involves and a donor would know what it is to be kind to a poor. "}}},{"verse_id":210476,"page_no":null,"line_no":684,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਬਖਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jog jugat jogee jaanai bhog ras bhogee jaanai rog dhokh rogee jaanai pragaT bakhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a Yogi knows the method of strenuous penances that are required to be practiced for realisation of God. A relisher would know how to enjoy the taste and enjoyment of worldly tastes and this can be emphatically stated that a patient alone knows the pain of another patient."}}},{"verse_id":210477,"page_no":null,"line_no":684,"gurmukhi":"ਫੂਲ ਰਾਖ ਮਾਲੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਨਹਿ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਗਾਂਧੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਜਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"fool raakh maalee jaanai paaneh ta(n)bolee jaanai sakal suga(n)dh gat gaa(n)dhee jaanau jaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A gardener knows how to take care of flowers, a betel leaf seller alone knows how to preserve betel leaves. One can learn the secret of scents from a perfume seller."}}},{"verse_id":210478,"page_no":null,"line_no":684,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨੈ ਜਉਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਪਹਿਚਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੭੫॥","translit_en":"ratanai jauhaaree jaanai bihaarai biauhaaree jaanai aatam preekhiaa kouoo bibekee pahichaan hai ||675||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only a jeweller knows how to evaluate and examine the genuineness of a jewel. A trader knows all aspects of business but he who can recognise the reality of spiritual virtues is a rare, wise and knowledgeable person who has imbibed the teachings of Guru in his mind .  (675)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41710,"next":null}}
